But a little thing like that... couldn't the depth of love overcome it?

つらいなー{12}

pages.en: {000C}Sigh... Life is hard.{0012}

pages.en: Mister, are you Manjimaru?
{000C}The Tengu of Mt. Mitake said you should drop by sometime.{0012}
Mt. Mitake is by the big pond way off to the east, so you can't miss it.{0012}
And, um... he said Buckwheat Dumplings make a good present.{0012}
{000C}Aw, you're a fake! Quit dressing like that and fooling kids!{0012}
Those creepy roots past the southern mountain... seems they're the roots of that flower blooming in Takayama.{0012}
I hear there's another one like it west of this village, but from what I hear, it's a different color.{0012}
Are they blooming in other places too? Honestly, can't anybody do something about a flower or two?{0012}
The Dark Orchid roots past the mountain south of the village are gone, but the ones to the west are still there!{0012}
Just how many Dark Orchids are there, anyway?{0012}
They say the Root Clan's prowling around here too. A body can't even take a walk in peace.{0012}
Oho, so you're the boy who beat the Root Clan? Why, you're the spitting image of me when I was young!{0012}
"Whoever reports the whereabouts of a child with purple hair shall receive a reward of 10 Ryo. -The Tycoon"{0012}

jp: ここは雑貨屋です　何かごようですか？

pages.en: This is the general store. What can I do for you?

jp: まいど　ありがとうございました{12}

pages.en: Thank you kindly!{0012}

jp: {0C}また　いらしてください{12}

pages.en: {000C}Please come again.{0012}
You Fire Clan folks have handy bodies, huh? I hear one night's sleep fixes anything. Poison, curses, doesn't matter?{0012}
Still, when you're heading somewhere dodgy, carrying a Cooling Pill or two is the secret to a long life.{0012}
They say a Cooling Pill puts you right back to normal, no matter what. The bad stuff and the good stuff.{0012}
Still, that spoiled son of the headman is a real headache.{0012}
Taking to his bed just because one woman ran off on him...{0012}
Is this Kabuki Danjuro really such a heartthrob?{0012}
The lord of Inuyama in Owari Province is raising an army to take on the Root Clan!{0012}
And get this! They're recruiting soldiers in Inuyama right now! Of course I'm going too!{0012}
If my mom lets me, that is.{0012}
I overheard something. Seems those flowers in Takayama and the Root Clan folks are connected somehow.{0012}
Didn't see it with my own eyes, but they say those guys pop right up out of the ground... Some folks have seen it.{0012}
About six months back, there was digging work out of Kyoto, supposedly on the Tycoon's orders.{0012}
They were paying good money, so I went. They found something like a sword and carried it off like it was precious.{0012}
Said they were taking it to Owari, I think. Where in Owari, I couldn't tell you. What, you going to steal it, kid?{0012}
So! That sword you stole from the Root Clan's castle, did it fetch a good price? So! How much'd you get?{0012}
They say the Root Clan got beaten by a single kid. Guess they weren't so tough after all.{0012}
Word is a castle made of bones suddenly appeared in Owari Province, just south of here. Big trouble, apparently.{0012}
And over here, I hear a ridiculously huge flower bloomed in Takayama. What in the world is going on?!{0012}
Head west beyond the mountain south of this village and you'll find the Tengu. I'm always his partner at Go.{0012}
But a huge root suddenly sprang up, and now I can't get to the Tengu's place.{0012}
Head west beyond the mountain south of this village and you'll find the Tengu. I'm always his partner at Go.{0012}
No matter how much flour I grind, thanks to those Root Clan folks I can't sell it to other villages.{0012}
What's so fun about picking on poor folks like us?{0012}
Turning... turning... The waterwheel turns...{0012}
Watching the waterwheel, I understand: in the end, everything turns. Me, you, even human history.{0012}
At least a waterwheel never spins in vain. That makes it better than us, and duller too. Interesting, isn't it?{0012}

jp:
こいつと　話すと　頭が痛くなるから
やめたほうが　いいっすよ{12}

pages.en: Talking to that one'll give you a headache. Best not to.{0012}

jp: 馬瀬村

pages.en: Maze Village
I was going to hurry through Jomon Cave to Inuyama when... that box lying there started moving!{0012}
Scared me so bad I hightailed it right back! Something's in there, I tell you...{0012}
Jomon Cave, see, nowadays it's just an underground passage linking Hida Province and Owari Province.{0012}
But they say it was originally the tomb of some ancient chieftain or other. Somebody went and turned it into a road.{0012}
Pretty sacrilegious fella, that. Probably some sneak thief out to rob the graves, I'd reckon.{0012}
You headed to Owari too? There's a road called Jomon Cave south of this village, but they say a monster's moved in.{0012}
It's none of my business, so I won't stop you, but you'd do best not to go. Can't do business if you're dead, eh?{0012}
For old-timers like us, Jomon Cave still feels like a mountain of treasure.{0012}
You hardly find anything these days, but just recently some fella picked up a shamisen or a lute or something and made a killing.{0012}
Takako...? Was there a woman like that? Your sweetheart, is she?{0012}

jp:
その恋文　今すぐ　お捨てなさい！
ろくなこと　起きないからね
{01}捨てる　　{01}捨てない

pages.en:
Throw that love letter away now!
Nothing good will come of it!
   {0001}Throw away   {0001}Keep it
{000C}Well, I warned you! Don't come complaining to me later, because I won't listen!{0012}
Take it from me: don't get mixed up with the man sleeping there.{0012}
{000C}Sometimes you set out to save someone else, and before you know it, you're the one beyond saving... Understand?{0012}
It's for the best for him that Takako's gone... Just between us, Takako's...{0012}
Though it may already be too late...{0012}

jp:
どなた様かは　存知ませんが
男と見込んで　頼みが　ございます{12}
実は　いいなずけに　逃げられました
尾張の犬山に　{k}カブキ{h}という男と
いるらしいのですが……{k}クソッ……{12}
{h}この手紙を　私のいいなずけの孝子に
渡しては　もらえませんか？

pages.en: I know not who you are, but you look like a man I can trust. I have a favor to ask.{0012}
The truth is, my betrothed ran away from me. They say she's in Inuyama in Owari, with a man named Kabuki... Damn it...{0012}
Would you deliver this letter to my betrothed, Takako?

jp: {10}１３０{0C}泥沼の恋文を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Tangled Love Letter!{0011}{004C}

jp: {0C}かたじけのう　ございまする{12}

pages.en: {000C}I am most grateful.{0012}
{000C}Ugh... Takako!{0012}
Snore... snore... Takako! You came back to me ☆☆... Snore... snore...{0012}
Halt! Wait right there! I cannot allow you through, Sengoku Manjimaru!{0012}
By order of the Tycoon himself, I am not to let you, of all people, through this checkpoint.{0012}
It is the Tycoon's command! You shall not pass! If we let you through, our lives are forfeit.{0012}
Out of a warrior's mercy, I'll tell you this much: the Tycoon is a womanizer without equal. Understand? Hurry to Ryomen Cavern.{0012}
Something unbelievable happened at the Takayama festival, they say... Everyone in town just vanished without a trace...{0012}
Well, Ryomen Cavern is way east of Takayama, and we're south of it, so it's a good long way off. I'm sure we're fine.{0012}
Follow the river south and you'll reach Maze Village. It's a village with waterwheels.{0012}
It's small, but it's where the peddlers hang out, so you can hear all kinds of rumors. It's fun!{0012}
We were thinking of heading to Takayama, but I heard things are bad there right now. Is it safe?{0012}
Huh?! The Tycoon and his most esteemed, esteemed party? They went south.{0012}
I hope they never come back! They just pile on extra work, like escort duty! What a pain!{0012}
Oh! Manjimaru, the Hero of Fire! Leave looking after the Tycoon by Jomon Cave to me!{0012}
I'll go dump water on his head every day!{0012}
Oh, you! I know you! You're the one who beat the monster in Ryomen Cavern... ......{0012}
Sorry! Can't remember your name! Gahahahaha! By the way, word is you...{0012}
...get your health and skills back just by walking around! Is that true? You'd never need an inn!{0012}
Ooh, that's it, that's it, Buckwheat Dumplings! Hand 'em over, Manjimaru! Mmm, delicious!{0012}
{000C}Come to think of it, there's a fellow called the Snake Hermit in Owari. There should be someone of the Fire Clan with him too.{0012}
{000C}By the way, Manjimaru, it's been a long time... Though I doubt you remember me.{0012}
Truth is, your father and I were friends. You've been here a few times yourself.{0012}
Ahh, that was good! Here, the Feather Robe scroll!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０羽衣の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Feather Robe scroll!{0011}{004C}
{000C}That one's a handy technique.{0012}
Give it your all, for your father's sake too! I'm counting on you!{0012}
{000C}Leave a scroll at the storehouse, then come back again. And one more thing, don't forget...{0012}
...to bring me Buckwheat Dumplings as a present.{0012}
{000C}The Root Clan must be hiding the seven Holy Swords of Fire inside their castles.{0012}
Without the Holy Swords, there's nothing we can do about that cursed Dark Orchid. Manjimaru, take back the Holy Swords!{0012}
That Dark Orchid you cut down... it's not just some big flower, you know. It's breathing something terrible.{0012}
{000C}By day, that flower soaks up every surge of violent human emotion: grief, rage, despair.{0012}
{000C}And it sends it all to Yomi, who's trying to awaken somewhere! Then when the sun goes down, it's the reverse!{0012}
{000C}At night it breathes out Yomi's aura. That's the nasty part. To the Root Clan, it's some kind of stimulant.{0012}
{000C}That's probably why those Root bastards only know how to fight like madmen who threw their lives away from the start.{0012}
Now, here's the Heat Haze scroll! Cut down every Dark Orchid and make Yomi sweat! Hurry! He'll grow big soon enough!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０陽炎の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Heat Haze scroll!{0011}{004F}
{000C}Here's a tip for you: before you visit a Tengu's house, make sure you've got room for another scroll!{0012}
You've probably been hit by them a few times already, but the Root Clan uses the same techniques as you, right?{0012}
Ever wonder how your enemies can use your own techniques so easily? Must make you angry a lot.{0012}
But listen! Hero of Fire... I hate the Root Clan, but I'll tell you the truth anyway.{0012}
{000C}It was the Root who devised most of those techniques! A thousand years ago, the Fire Clan just learned them the hard way in battle, and stole them.{0012}
Learning the hard way means, in the end, trading a pile of corpses for each scroll, one by one. That's what it comes down to!{0012}
{000C}Now, here's the Autumn Gale scroll! Hero of Fire, your power is not yours alone!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０野分の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Autumn Gale scroll!{0011}{004D}
Sorry, after you came all this way, but I can't give you the scroll. Why not, you ask?{0012}
Your scroll bag will tell you the answer. Think it over!{0012}
Welcome to {001A}!{0012}
We charge travelers {001E} Ryo, as is the rule. Will you be staying?

pages.en: Oharu... Oharu got carried off by a monster!{0012}
Manjimaru... those things said you're to come to Ryomen Cavern... D-don't tell me you're going...?!{0012}
...No use trying to stop you, I guess. Ryomen Cavern is way east of Takayama. ......Don't you dare die!{0012}
Manjimaru, it's terrible! Your mother vanished right before our eyes!{0012}
What in the world is going on?! Are we dreaming?!{0012}

jp:
お春さんが…　お春さんが…
{k}バケ物{h}に　連れていかれちまった…{12}

pages.en: Oharu... Oharu got carried off by a monster...{0012}
Oharu vanished like a wisp of mist!{0012}
Right before she vanished, she cried out "Manjimaru!" I'm sure she was calling to you for help!{0012}
Welcome home, Manjimaru!{0012}
After you set out, I was a little lonely on my own, but I'm all right now.{0012}
After all, I have the girl you left in my care to keep me company. So you needn't worry.{0012}
Win back peace for Jipang with your own hands, as soon as you can! Now, off you go...{0012}
Manjimaru………………{0012}
I'm so glad I gave birth to you... You are your mother's pride.{0012}
Now go, Manjimaru! Take back the seven Holy Swords and cut down the Dark Orchids!{0012}
Become the greatest ringleader in all of Jipang! And then...{0012}
...come home a man who surpasses your father!{0012}
That gave me chills, Boss. So you've been carrying a heavy destiny all along.{0012}
We can't help you at all, but while you're away, we'll all protect the village together.{0012}
Boss, it's terrible! Auntie Oharu suddenly vanished! It's chaos over at your house!{0012}
You're going all alone, Boss? But it's just for a little while, right? You'll be back soon, right...? *sniff*{0012}
I saw it! A black light came down from the sky onto your house, Boss, and inside it was a Grim Reaper, all bones!{0012}
That Grim Reaper went into your house, grabbed Auntie Oharu, and flew off to the east!{0012}
I hear you saved Oharu and the people of Takayama.{0012}
I always took you for just a neighborhood ringleader, but before I knew it, you'd grown into such a fine young man...{0012}
Come to think of it, your dad seemed to be friends with the Tengu of Mt. Mitake.{0012}
Why not start by asking the Tengu of Mt. Mitake for help? Mt. Mitake's in the southeast of this province.{0012}
The folks you rescued made it back to Takayama safe, I hear. Go show your face and cheer 'em up.{0012}
Brawler like you, I bet you won't lose to anybody! Go get 'em!{0012}
I nagged you plenty, but everyone in the village sees you in a new light now. Forgive us, will you?{0012}
We'll protect Oharu! Don't you worry about the village. Go give it your all!{0012}
Manjimaru! Go raise hell out there in the wide world! Make the name of Shirakawa's ringleader ring out across Jipang!{0012}
The Tycoon's lot went through the checkpoint south of Takayama into Owari Province, they say. Go after 'em and let 'em have it!{0012}
M-Manjimaru! Ryomen Cavern! Ryomen Cavern! The ones who took Oharu are waiting for you at Ryomen Cavern...{0012}
Of all places, to get carried off to a cave way out east like that...{0012}
You were always getting into one scrape or another, but it's lonely with you gone.{0012}
Come home to the village now and then.{0012}

jp:
卍丸！　おまえのお母さんが
消えちまったんだよ｜{12}

pages.en: Manjimaru! Your mother's vanished!{0012}
Your mother's a tough, sensible woman, but I'm sure she's sad with you gone.{0012}
Out there under the open sky, think of the mother you left back home now and then.{0012}
First your father disappears, and now your mother's vanished too?!{0012}
What on earth is going on?! Is your family cursed by some evil spirit or something?!{0012}
I heard Takayama was struck by some terrible disaster?!{0012}
Are the kids who were with you all right?!{0012}
You already beat Onikotsu Castle in Owari?! So! Was the Holy Sword there?{0012}
Then let me ask you one thing. Why's there still a Dark Orchid blooming in Takayama?! You didn't finish the job, Manjimaru!{0012}
The Takayama folks who were held by the Root Clan might know a little something about them.{0012}
Why not try Takayama first?{0012}
You cut down the Dark Orchid in Takayama? Next time I go to Takayama, I can brag about you!{0012}
Thanks to you cutting down the Dark Orchid, Hida's peaceful again. Thank you.{0012}
Oharu was taken to Ryomen Cavern, right?{0012}
Then try Ushikubi Village, east of Takayama! You might hear more there.{0012}
The Tycoon's lot went through the southern checkpoint, headed for Owari Province, they say.{0012}
He's gotta be holding the key to the Dark Orchid! Don't let him get away, Manjimaru!{0012}
Carrying off only Oharu... Damn you, Manjimaru! Did you go picking fights with monsters too?!{0012}
That creepy flower that sprouted in Takayama, and Oharu vanishing... they've got to be connected!{0012}
I mean, ominous things like this don't just happen one after another!{0012}
Boss, are you going away somewhere? It's sad, but if it's your decision, I'll see you off with a smile.{0012}
Boss, Auntie Oharu's gone, but please don't be sad.{0012}
When you're sad, Boss, I start to cry too... I'm gonna... gonna... Waaaaaaaaaah!{0012}
The Root Clan must be running roughshod over other provinces too. Manjimaru! Give it everything you've got!{0012}
For now, charge south full speed!{0012}
Gotta nab that Tycoon and get back those Holy Swords, or whatever they're called!{0012}
Say, Oharu was saying something about Holy Swords...{0012}
With those, could you beat the Root Clan?{0012}

jp:
高山に　事故が起こって　祭りが
ぶち壊しに　なったんだってな｜{12}

pages.en: I heard there was some disaster in Takayama and it wrecked the whole festival!{0012}
I wonder if the Tycoon is safe. If anything happened to him, there could be turmoil all across Jipang.{0012}
It's because the Tycoon went digging up ancient tombs!{0012}
That's why the curse struck, and Takayama ended up like that...{0012}
Manjimaru! Monsters are swarming outside the village! What's going to become of Jipang?!{0012}

jp:
火多の国の　南の尾張の国に
根の一族の城が　現れたらしいんだよ{12}

pages.en: They say a Root Clan castle has appeared in Owari Province, south of Hida.{0012}

jp:
やったね｜　卍丸｜
同じ村の者として　鼻が高いよ{12}

pages.en: You did it, Manjimaru! As someone from the same village, I'm so proud!{0012}

jp:
ああ！　地震の原因は
あの　{k}オバケ花{h}だったのね｜{12}

pages.en: Oh! So that monster flower was behind the earthquakes!{0012}
I heard a nasty rumor. That flower that bloomed in Takayama has turned up all over Jipang!{0012}

jp:
卍丸｜　大変なことになっちまったな
いるもんがあれば　半額でいいぜ！

pages.en: Manjimaru! Things are bad, huh? Anything you need, half price!

jp:
{0C}男だったら　命賭けで
必ず　母ちゃんを　助け出してこいよ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Be a man: risk your life and bring your mother back, no matter what!{0012}
{000C}You idiot! This is no time to be shy about it!{0012}
*cough cough*... I had a nightmare... Under a huge orchid flower, monsters were devouring crowds of people...{0012}
Such a horrid dream... Maybe hell's come to fetch me... I don't have long left myself, it seems...{0012}
Boss! Rumor has it the Dark Orchid can only be cut with the Fire Clan's Holy Swords. Good luck!{0012}

jp:
親分が　いなくなると
毎日が　退屈に　なっちゃうよ{12}

pages.en: With you gone, Boss, every day's gonna be so boring.{0012}
I'll think up some new pranks. When you get back, let's play again, Boss!{0012}

jp: {k}キューン　キューン{12}{0C}

pages.en: Whimper, whimper...{0012}
The peddlers were saying the Tycoon and his lot headed south. Be careful!{0012}
I won't tell Oharu you came back all battered like this. She'd only worry.{0012}
No matter how bad the wound, I'll nurse you back to health! You bring Oharu home, now!{0012}
It seems your destiny has begun to move in a big way.{0012}
Manjimaru, you're no small fry who'd settle for life in a little village like this.{0012}
Once you're ready for your journey, it's time to leave the village. I look forward to what lies ahead for you.{0012}
Fuho, fuho... So your mother's gone missing, I hear.{0012}
It seems your destiny has begun to move in a big way.{0012}
Manjimaru, you're no small fry who'd settle for life in a little village like this.{0012}
Once you're ready for your journey, it's time to leave the village. I look forward to what lies ahead for you.{0012}
They say you've got some important mission, but don't you go forgetting about Auntie Oharu!{0012}
Come home a bigger man than your father, Manjimaru.{0012}
Everyone in this village is praying you'll be safe.{0012}
They say everyone in Takayama vanished. Does that have something to do with Oharu disappearing?!{0012}
Even so, why was Oharu the only one from this village to vanish?!{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０卍丸は　聖剣　法水院紅丸で
１本目の暗黒{k}ラン{h}を　撃破した｜
{11}３０{10}１２９残り　あと　６本｜

pages.en:
{0010}{0090}Manjimaru destroyed the first Dark Orchid with the Holy Sword Housuiin Benimaru!
Six more to go!{0011}{012E}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０見たか！　卍丸｜
{11}３０これが　根の一族の力だ｜{12}

pages.en:
{000C}Did you see that, Manjimaru?!
This is the power of the Root Clan!{0012}
{000C}I could crush you right here and now, but I'll save the fun for later!{0012}
{000C}I've got your mother and the people of this town! If you want them back, come to Ryomen Cavern!{0012}
{000C}Ryomen Cavern, you hear!{0012}

jp: 家の中は　ぼろぼろだ{12}

pages.en: The house is in ruins.{0012}
Manjimaru stood before the Dark Orchid.{0012}
He gripped the Holy Sword Housuiin Benimaru and closed his eyes.{0012}
The Holy Sword began to tremble faintly...{0012}
Little by little, Manjimaru's heartbeat and the sword's pulse fell into resonance...{0012}

jp:
赤色の花びらの
巨大な暗黒{k}ラン{h}が　咲いている{12}

pages.en: A gigantic Dark Orchid with red petals is in bloom.{0012}
Ah... Manjimaru... I'm glad I made it back to the village, but my body feels so heavy...{0012}
Those creeps said... something like they're hiding a Holy Sword... at a place called Onikotsu Castle in Owari... I think...{0012}
Be... careful... Owari's to the south...{0012}
So that Dark Orchid was why my body felt so heavy. Thank you, Manjimaru.{0012}
"None shall stand in my way!"... Nice! Gives me chills! Now that's a man!{0012}
Come to think of it, I hear the Dark Orchid roots blocking Suzuka Pass in Owari Province are gone!{0012}
Keep it up, Manjimaru! All of Jipang's waiting on you!{0012}
Ahh, my family and my home, all gone... What am I supposed to live for now...{0012}
I'm so glad your mother's safe, Manjimaru... Truly glad. Take good care of her...{0012}
{000C}Manjimaru... I know it's a lot to ask, but I'm looking forward to the day you cut down this Dark Orchid...{0012}
"None shall stand in my way," huh... Watching you, I feel like I can start over again!{0012}
From now on, whenever things get hard, I'll say "None shall stand in my way!" a hundred times and keep going!{0012}
The floats we've always used are ruined now, but someday I'll make this festival just like it was. No, even grander!{0012}
Manjimaru! I heard everything from the geisha.{0012}
The Tycoon means to borrow that monster's power to conquer all of Jipang!{0012}
Chase down the Tycoon and put a stop to this madness!{0012}
Manjimaru, just who are these Root Clan people?! They were spouting crazy stuff about a wish a thousand years in the making.{0012}

Hurry back to Takayama! The people there are waiting only for the day you cut down the Dark Orchid!{0012}

お見事で　ござる｜
卍丸殿｜{12}

pages.en: Splendidly done, Sir Manjimaru!{0012}
A Root Clan castle named Onikotsu Castle suddenly appeared in the forest to the south.{0012}
Maybe because of the castle, every tree around it has withered... A pitiful sight. Don't you dare go near it.{0012}
With the Holy Sword you took back from the Root Clan, you can surely cut down the Dark Orchid.{0012}
Now, hurry back to Takayama, seal the Dark Orchid once more, and put the people's minds at ease.{0012}

jp:
みんな　おぬしのおかげじゃ｜
心から　礼を申しますぞ{12}

pages.en: It's all thanks to you! You have my heartfelt gratitude.{0012}
The old lady in this house was bragging she knows how to break down the gate of Onikotsu Castle!{0012}
Mind you, that old gal's a famous tall-tale teller, so I'd take it with a grain of salt.{0012}
In this attack on Onikotsu Castle, I intend to win distinction and, in time, enter service here.{0012}
Naturally, I'd like the thousand-ryo reward too... but I suppose it will go to Captain Kabuki.{0012}
I misjudged you, Sir Manjimaru. The thousand-ryo reward is yours, it seems.{0012}
Listen, in the next raid on Onikotsu Castle, I'm gonna rack up a huge victory and get made a real samurai!{0012}
Of course! I'm taking that thousand-ryo reward too!{0012}

jp: いかがでしたか？{12}

pages.en: What did you think?{0012}
Hey, that thing in your hand? What is it? Give it here!{0012}
Let's see...{0012}
Uh-huh, uh-huh...{0012}
Ugh! What is this?! "Love is eternal, my dearest Takako"?! This is a love letter to ME!{0012}
So?! You... for me...{0012}
So?! You've fallen for me!{0012}

{000C}So?! You've fallen for me!
So?! You've fallen for me!{0012}
Oh, that's rich! That's rich! I'm Kabuki Danjuro's woman! I don't bother with snot-nosed brats!{0012}
Oh, that's rich! That's rich! I'm Kabuki Danjuro's woman! I don't bother with snot-nosed brats!{0012}

jp: あたしに　気安く　話しかけないでよ{12}

pages.en: Don't you talk to me so familiarly!{0012}
Huh?! What do I do?! Eeek! I'm talking with my idol, Lord Manjimaru...{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! That letter you're holding says "Takako" on it... Could it be a letter for me?{0012}
Let's see...{0012}
Uh-huh, uh-huh...{0012}
Eeeeek! Oh, Lord Manjimaru! "Love is eternal, my dearest Takako"! To think you feel that way about me ☆☆☆{0012}
To think Lord Manjimaru cared for me this much... It's like a dream ☆☆☆{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! For Takako and for Jipang, defeat the Root Clan as soon as you can! Takako will write you letters of support!{0012}
Look forward to them! Check the storehouse now and then! Ooh la la ☆☆☆{0012}
Huh?! What do I do?! Eeek! I'm talking with my idol, Lord Manjimaru...{0012}
That Takako's sulking in the corner of the room all by herself again... I wish that gloomy girl would just leave.{0012}
Huh?! Kabuki? Was there somebody like that?{0012}
Ooh la la ☆☆☆ Lord Manjimaruuu!{0012}

jp: わたしの　{k}カブキ団十郎{h}さまーあん{12}

pages.en: My Lord Kabuki Danjuroooo!{0012}

jp:
{k}ウッフン☆☆☆
卍丸{h}さまーあん｜{12}

pages.en: Ooh la la ☆☆☆ Lord Manjimaruuu!{0012}
What are you to Lord Kabuki?! His retainer?{0012}
His servant?{0012}
His slave?{0012}
Spit it out! You're not much of a man, are you?{0012}
They say you took down Onikotsu Castle all by yourself!{0012}
Ooh la la ☆☆☆ Lord Manjimaruuu!{0012}
Don't tell me you've got your eye on Lord Kabuki too?! Oh no, don't bother hiding it!{0012}
A woman can tell.{0012}
Ooh la la ☆☆☆ Lord Manjimaruuu!{0012}
{000C}Will you ride in the ladies' festival palanquin too, Lord Manjimaru?
{000C}So modest! Oh, what a humble man you are! Ooh la la ☆☆☆{0012}

jp:
どーしても　俺様に
仲間になって欲しいのか？

pages.en: So you're just dying for me to join you, huh?
{000C}I get it! After all, the great Kabuki Danjuro is a million times stronger than you!{0012}
Tell you what... Go deal with Onikotsu Castle by yourself. Then maybe I'll change my mind.{0012}

jp:
{0C}変わんねぇかも　しれねぇけどな
{k}ガハハハハ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Then again, maybe I won't! Gahahaha!{0012}

jp: {0C}じゃ　消えな！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Now beat it!{0012}

jp:
いらはりませ！　武具屋でございます
ご利用くださいますか？

pages.en: Welcome! This is the armory. Can I help you?

jp:
{0C}毎度　ありがとうございます！
またのお越しを　お待ちしております{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you kindly! We look forward to your next visit!{0012}
That raid on Onikotsu Castle the other day... The castle folks talk it up, but truth is, it was a defeat.{0012}
On the march south toward Onikotsu Castle, most of the soldiers got cut down. Only a handful made it...{0012}
They made it all the way to the gate, all right, but push or pull, the gate wouldn't budge an inch, they say!{0012}
He showered gold coins down from the top of the castle keep! If you'd come a little sooner, you could've gotten your share!{0012}
You're a traveler from another province, aren't you? Then you'd best learn how to use Return Stones, Wind Talismans and Storm Talismans.{0012}
First, the Return Stone. It's for escaping when you're lost inside a cave or a building.{0012}
A Wind Talisman whisks you to any town or village you've visited in the province you're in. It doesn't work inside towns or villages, mind.{0012}
{000C}And then there's the Storm Talisman! You use it when you want to go back to another province you've been to before.{0012}
Oh, and to register a new province on the Storm Talisman, you've got to enter one of its towns or passes! Remember that!{0012}
Oho, so you're fighting the Root Clan! Then I must do my humble part! If you're ever badly hurt, let me tend to you.{0012}
Oho, the Fire Clan heals quickly, just as they say! But... don't be reckless. A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step, you know.{0012}

jp:
へい！　らっしゃい！　団子でも
何でも　買っていきやがれってんでぃ！

pages.en: Hey! Welcome! Dumplings, whatever, go on and buy somethin', why don'tcha!

jp:
{0C}今度　来るときは　この茶店ごと
買っていきやがれってんでぃ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Next time you come, go on and buy the whole teahouse, why don'tcha!{0012}
{000C}Here I am, a grown man swallowing my pride to run a teahouse, and you say no?! Why, you blockhead!{0012}

jp:
あたしゃ　旅の行商人ですわ
何か　買ってもらえまへんか？

pages.en: I'm a traveling peddler, see. Won't you buy something?
Thank you, Lord Manjimaru! Join forces with Lord Kabuki and bring peace back to Jipang!{0012}
They say the new captain, Lord Kabuki, beat Yato in a single blow with the Ice Blade scroll!{0012}
So dreamy ☆{0012}
Lord Kabuki's Blossom Storm technique deals 60 damage to every monster at once, they say!{0012}
They say the man who raised Lord Kabuki lives all alone in a cave somewhere to the south.{0012}
His name's the Snake Hermit, I believe. I hear he raised other fine samurai besides Lord Kabuki.{0012}

jp: 犬山町

pages.en: Inuyama Town
What?! You missed Kabuki's big gold giveaway?! Well, that's a real shame, so...{0012}
...I'll spare you 1 Ryo! Ain't I generous!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０卍丸は　１両　手に入れた…

pages.en: What, that's not enough?! Just what do you take other people's money for? Show a little restraint!{0012}
The lord here's got real guts! He's raising soldiers to wipe out those monsters they call the Root Clan.{0012}
Rumor is anyone who distinguishes himself gets a thousand ryo as a reward! Now that's a lord!{0012}
Must've been two months back... I went picking through Jomon Cave for the first time in ages, and found an unexpected treasure!{0012}
Just a grubby old lute, but some geezer I'd never seen around here bought it off me for good money.{0012}
You look like a greenhorn traveler. So I'll tell you this much: when people tell you things, write them down properly.{0012}
You've got to look after yourself. Nobody's going to talk just because it suits you.{0012}
Get yourself a proper notebook or something and take it seriously. Take it lightly and you'll be sorry!{0012}
When you ask someone the way and they say "East!" or "West!", don't just swallow it whole.{0012}
Sure, it may be east, but there could be mountains and rivers in between. It might even be east across the border.{0012}
Everybody's got their hands full with their own troubles. The rest is up to you: open a map and use your own head and feet.{0012}
Long ago, I heard that an instrument able to break evil seals lies sleeping in Jomon Cave.{0012}
Whether it's true is doubtful, but if such an instrument exists, I believe it could break even the gate of Onikotsu Castle.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, forgive us for leaving it all to you alone.{0012}
Honestly, between this town's punitive force and Kabuki, what were any of them doing...{0012}

jp:
この野郎！　{k}ガキ{h}のくせに　ここは
武具屋だ{k}ゼ！　{h}わかってんのかよ？

pages.en: Hey, you! You're just a kid, and this is an armory! You get that?
{000C}Slip up and cut your own foot off, and it won't be funny! Be careful, you little punk!{0012}
{000C}Figured as much!{0012}
They say the lord himself is choosing the men for the second raid on Onikotsu Castle, up at the castle.{0012}

jp:
結局　鬼骨城の討伐隊など
なんの役にも　立たなかったな{12}

pages.en: In the end, that punitive force against Onikotsu Castle was no use at all.{0012}

jp:
鉄さえ斬れる刀から　とうふも斬れない
刀まで何でもござれ！　見てくかい？

pages.en: Blades that cut iron, blades that can't cut tofu! Have a look?

jp: {0C}また　来てくれよ！　約束だよ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Come again! Promise!{0012}

jp:
{0C}あんたみたいに　商品も見てくんない
客が多いんだよな　どうしてだろ？{12}

pages.en: {000C}Lots of customers like you don't even look at the goods. Why is that?{0012}
I hear you're fighting the Root Clan. Then let me give you a word of advice.{0012}
When you take them on, if you worry about looking good, you'll run out of lives no matter how many you've got.{0012}
Take running past them! There's no shame in shaking off an enemy! Know that it's a fine tactic too.{0012}
And finding an enemy's weak point and hammering it is another good move! The point is, you just have to win!{0012}
The women all fawn over him, "Lord Kabuki, Lord Danjuro," like he's the only man alive...{0012}
But I can't stand that guy. I bet he's secretly glad the Root Clan showed up.{0012}
Sure, maybe he's the only one who can take on monsters. But he'd better not take on my wife too!{0012}
Well! So you're the Manjimaru who smashed Onikotsu Castle! Bet you can't wait for the lord's reward!{0012}
Coming to a run-down town like this... you're an odd one. Believe it or not, there used to be a lot more people here.{0012}
Only us farmers are left. We were born on this land. We can't abandon it.{0012}
Now that Onikotsu Castle thing's gone, the folks who ran off from this town will come back sooner or later.{0012}
But we've no intention of giving the castle back!{0012}
The lord here and the lord of Inuyama Town are brothers by blood.{0012}
The lord of Inuyama is gathering ronin to fight the Root, but our lord tucked his tail and ran!{0012}
Pathetic! I don't know where he is now, but I bet he's living a pathetic life.{0012}
The old lord of this town has probably dropped dead in a ditch somewhere. If you ever run into him...{0012}
...tell him gently: "Don't ever come back!"{0012}
Come to think of it, the other day the Kasa-iwa Hermit was walking around all happy, hugging a lute or something.{0012}
Some fine thing called the Pure Land Lute, I hear, but to me it just looked like a beat-up old lute.{0012}
But does that old master do music as well as drawing? Hermits must have a lot of free time.{0012}

jp:
鬼骨城を　倒してくれたのは
あんたなんだってね　ありがとよ｜{12}

pages.en: I hear you're the one who beat Onikotsu Castle. Thanks!{0012}
Hey, look! Aren't the eels cute?{0012}
After the lord left, everybody started raising eels in the castle moat.{0012}
They said it's so everybody can build up strength to fight the Root Clan!{0012}
We built up our strength on eels to fight the Root Clan, but then you went and beat Onikotsu Castle first, mister...{0012}
So now everybody's got too much energy, and they get nosebleeds over every little thing.{0012}
The samurai, who are supposed to protect the castle and the people, were the first to run. The swords at their hips are just for show.{0012}
But we won't run. Protecting the land is what farmers do! Even if the Root Clan kills us, we're not moving from here.{0012}

jp: うっ｜　鼻血が…{12}

pages.en: Ugh! A nosebleed...{0012}
Thanks to you, Manjimaru, peace has more or less returned to Owari. But I hear the Root's evil hand is reaching into other provinces...{0012}
Please hurry to them! You're the only one who can stop the Root Clan's outrages, Manjimaru!{0012}
You know the Snake Hermit in the western cave? That old geezer practices making flashy entrances in his hole every day.{0012}
And his pupil, that Kabuki, is an even bigger fool than the old geezer.{0012}
Honestly, those two are dragging down Owari's good name!{0012}
The Snake Hermit's...{0012}
They say the old Kasa-iwa Hermit swindled some greenhorn in Inuyama and got himself an amazing lute.{0012}
Something called the Pure Land Lute. One twang, and even evil seals just vanish, apparently.{0012}
Ooh! You've been to Benten Tower! Me, I like that quiet girl!{0012}
When the lord abandoned the town and ran, the merchants dropped their shops and went off somewhere too.{0012}
If you've got no place to stay, go to the castle. You can stay there for free.{0012}

jp:
「武士以外の者
　城への　立ち入りを禁ずる」{12}

pages.en: "None but samurai may enter the castle."{0012}

jp:
「堀の魚は　城の財産につき
　盗んだ者　厳罰に処する」{12}

pages.en:
"The fish in the moat are castle property.
Thieves will be severely punished."{0012}
I often hear beautiful lute music drifting from Benten Tower to the south. It must be Lady Benten playing.{0012}
I hear the Kasa-iwa Hermit got his hands on a beat-up lute too... but his playing must be worlds apart from hers.{0012}

jp:
ちぇっ｜　{k}シケ{h}た町だぜ｜
わざわざ　行商に　来たっつうのに
誰も　いねえじゃねえかよ｜{12}
あんた　この町の人じゃねえみたいだな
少しは　金もってんだろ？

pages.en: Tch! What a dead town! I came all this way to peddle my wares, and there's nobody here!{0012}
You're not from this town, are you? You've got a little money, right?

jp: {0C}あんがとよ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thanks a bunch!{0012}
So, how's Kabuki been since? Has he become any use at all?{0012}
Better keep a close eye on him, so he doesn't wander off chasing some woman's backside again!{0012}
Say no more... I know how you feel.{0012}
Let me teach you the secret to getting along with Kabuki! It's simple.{0012}
Endure!!{0012}
Hm? Kabuki's not with you.{0012}
Did he die?{0012}
Well, he's not the sort to die easily. Best to just leave him be.{0012}
Ah! Wait a moment! I'm not ready yet!{0012}
{000C}I'll start over, so could you step outside once more?{0012}
I am he, renowned as the handsomest man in all Jipang! The one, the only... Snake Hermit!{0012}
{000C}You're of the Fire Clan, aren't you? I can tell, because I had two Fire Clan pupils myself.{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０ひとりは　{k}オロチ丸{h}というてな
頭のきれる　{11}５出来のよい　弟子じゃ{12}

pages.en: One was named Orochimaru. A sharp, gifted pupil.{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０もうひとりは　{k}カブキ{h}という
見下げはてた　{11}５大{k}バカ者{h}じゃ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}The other is called Kabuki. A contemptible, utter fool!{0012}
{000C}He never listens, he does whatever he pleases, and on top of that, he's an outrageous skirt-chaser!{0012}
He won't train seriously in the arts, yet his clothes are oh so flashy. Honestly, who does he take after...{0012}
{000C}Never even dream of traveling with Kabuki... though I suppose there may be complicated circumstances.{0012}
{000C}Well, if you do team up with Kabuki, don't let him get to you! Best not to mind anything he says.{0012}
If you ever have trouble with Kabuki, come see me. I'll teach you something good!{0012}

jp: 恋の耳かきを見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found the Love Ear Pick!{0012}

jp: {0C}恋の耳かきをあきらめた{12}

pages.en: {000C}You left the Love Ear Pick behind.{0012}

jp:
卍丸は　美素団子を
地蔵の前に供えた{12}

pages.en: Manjimaru offered a Miso Dumpling before the Jizo statue.{0012}
I came meaning to cross to the other side of the mountain... but I clean forgot to buy a Miso Dumpling...{0012}
Going all the way back to Inuyama now is a pain. I'm at my wits' end...{0012}

jp: 地蔵がある{12}

pages.en: There's a Jizo statue.{0012}

jp:
旅のお供に　お団子は　どうです？
他にもありますが　いかがですか？

pages.en: Dumplings for the road? We've got more, too. What'll it be?

jp:
温泉がわいている{12}
ちょっと　ひと息……{12}{0C}

pages.en: A hot spring is bubbling here.{0012}
Time for a little breather...{0012}

jp: 美素団子を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Miso Dumpling!{0012}

jp: 風の護符を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Wind Talisman!{0012}

jp: {k}ヘタ{h}な絵が　堂々と並んでいる{12}

pages.en: Bad drawings are proudly on display.{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０{k}ヘタ{h}な絵を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: I am the Kasa-iwa Hermit!{0012}
You've come to hear my masterful and most edifying lute playing, haven't you?

jp:
{0C}そうか…　それは　残念至極｜
あの琵琶は　弁天が　ねだるんで
くれてやったのよ{12}
断っておくが　貢いだわけではないぞ｜
そこんとこ　男なら　わかるじゃろ？

pages.en: {000C}I see... How utterly regrettable. Benten begged me for that lute, so I gave it to her.{0012}
Mind you, it's not as if I was courting her with gifts! A man would understand, eh?
{000C}Still, having you come all this way only to send you home empty-handed... I couldn't bear it, as a man...{0012}
I have it! I shall bestow upon you one of my masterful and most edifying drawings!{0012}
{000C}...Or so I thought, but your item bag seems to be full. Hmm! How utterly regrettable!{0012}

jp: {0C}そうか…　それは　残念至極｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}I see... How utterly regrettable!{0012}
My drawings are very popular, you see, so I've set a limit of one per person...{0012}
Flaunt one's talent too much and the common folk grow resentful... Ah, genius is a lonely thing...{0012}
So, have you been to Benten's place yet? I went to the trouble of giving you a drawing of a boat, so be sure to go...{0012}
It's grrreat there!{0012}
Especially the quiet girl. Mmm...{0012}

jp: 乗りますか？

pages.en: Get on board?

jp:
卍丸は　{k}ヘタ{h}な絵を
地蔵の前に供えた{12}

pages.en: Manjimaru offered the Bad Drawing before the Jizo statue.{0012}
Before anyone noticed, some ugly castle went up right in the village.{0012}
Having a thing like that around ruins the look of the whole village. I can't stand it!{0012}
Have you met the Kasa-iwa Hermit who lives west of the village? He's a nice fella, but he can't draw to save his life.{0012}
He forces his bad drawings on everybody who visits. Wish he'd give it a rest!{0012}
There are Tengu north and west of this village. Have you called on them yet?{0012}
This village has a Jizo statue with wondrous powers. When folks here have a wish, they ask the Jizo.{0012}
If you've got a wish, you tell the Jizo too. Works like a charm!{0012}
Aren't you embarrassed, riding around in a ridiculous boat like that? Must be tough being a hero of justice!{0012}
It wasn't there when I went to bed, but when I got up in the morning, there it was! Strange things do happen!{0012}
Not only did my lord flee from the Root Clan, now he squats in this disgraceful castle!{0012}
I've had it with my lord! Starting tomorrow, I'll become a farmer and stake my life on growing vegetables!{0012}
The old man living in that weird castle says he's the great lord of Nagashino.{0012}
Who's got time for some senile old coot's nonsense, right?{0012}
Those monsters that show up a lot lately, they're called the Root Clan, right? I saw one down by the river the other day!{0012}
I went to do the washing and the water was bright red. I looked upstream in shock, and a monster was eating a person! It was blood!{0012}
I'm so scared, so scared... I can't even set foot outside the village.{0012}
Thank you, Manjimaru! I'm in awe of your courage, truly.{0012}

jp:
おいら　老中じゃ
頭が　高いぞ{12}

pages.en: I'm the senior councilor! Bow your head!{0012}

jp:
あたい　老中だよ
すごいでしょ{12}

pages.en: I'm the senior councilor! Pretty great, huh?{0012}
You know, the other day I was playing in the forest and I found the Tengu's house!{0012}
Um, um, I think... it was way off to the west!{0012}
Fighting the Root Clan, are you? Then let me tell you something good.{0012}
My granddad used to say a Tengu lives up the river.{0012}
There ain't no boats in this village, though, so nobody's ever gone to check.{0012}
Go down the river east of the village and you can reach Benten Tower! But nobody's ever been there.{0012}
Benten Tower is for women only, so they won't let men in! I'd sure like to meet Lady Benten just once.{0012}
I hear you went to see Lady Benten in that cool boat! She must've been surprised...{0012}

jp: 福島村

pages.en: Fukushima Village
They say the Root Clan is looking for something called the Pure Land Lute.{0012}
They mean to crush anything that might get in their way.{0012}
Thank you, Manjimaru! Keep protecting Jipang from the Root Clan from here on out. We're counting on you!{0012}
I saw it: a fleet of boats in some creepy color, heading down the river toward Benten Tower.{0012}
Benten Tower's closed to men, but those weren't the kind of boats women ride in... I hope nothing's happened to Lady Benten.{0012}
Lady Benten was safe? Well, that's good! And? ...Was it good?{0012}
Yomi! That's their king! No, better to call it their god! That's your true enemy! Don't forget it!{0012}
Well, well! There's still somebody around these days with Fire blood as thick as yours! The world's not done for yet!{0012}
After a thousand years, the Fire Clan sure turns out some polished types. Don't tell me you've been living among humans?{0012}
{000C}If so, you probably don't know much about yourself or them yet! I'll tell you just the most important thing.{0012}
Your real enemy isn't the small fry you're fighting now! Remember the name I'm about to tell you!{0012}
Yomi! That's their king! No, better to call it their god! That's your true enemy! Don't forget it!{0012}
Now, take my Will-o'-the-Wisp scroll! You should be able to master it. There's no time! Hurry!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０鬼火の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Will-o'-the-Wisp scroll!{0011}{0048}

jp:
えーっと　確か　犬山には
預かり所が　あったっけな？

pages.en: Let's see, Inuyama had a storehouse, didn't it?

jp:
{0C}じゃ　巻物を一本　預けてから来な
待っててやるからよ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Go leave one of your scrolls there, then come back. I'll wait for you.{0012}
{000C}You idiot! It does! I'm telling you to leave a scroll there and come back! Don't make me spell it out!{0012}
Have you been to Benten Tower? Well, having been born a man, you ought to go at least once, for your education.{0012}
Oho, you did well to find this place! I'd heard some rumors about you, you see, so I was worried.{0012}
Seems you're not as dumb as everyone says! I can hand over my scroll with peace of mind.{0012}

Lady Benten fled into her room on the third floor, so for the moment she is safe.{0012}

I saw a pink tornado heading into Iga Village. I wonder if Iga is all right...{0012}
They say Kikugoro's Jungle Castle is shaped like a single giant tree, surrounded by a man-eating forest!{0012}
Sob, sob, sob... A tree crushed my house, and now look how low I've fallen.{0012}

Their milk's green too, and it tastes nasty, like vegetable juice, so nobody'll drink it.{0012}
Matsusaka is a town that lives by selling its famous beef.{0012}
But with the cattle turned green like this, it's creepy, and nobody will buy.{0012}
None of us can even earn tomorrow's food. At this rate, we'll starve before the forest swallows us.{0012}
That Kikugoro's a creep, right? Dolls himself up like a woman. But he's really, really strong.{0012}
I saw it! Fifty, sixty Iga ninja dropping one after another, right in front of Kikugoro!{0012}

They say ogres lived in Jipang long ago. Going by the name, the Kuki family might descend from ogres.{0012}
Nobody could rule a place as big as Ise without an ogre's strength.{0012}
There used to be a village called Akame west of Jungle Castle, but not a word's come from it since.{0012}
My little sister married into that village... Did the jungle swallow it up? I hope she's all right...{0012}
Whoa, you came through Ise Shrine? You're just a kid, but you're brave! Aren't you scared of the Root Clan?{0012}

Eeek! The Great Buddha's moving! The Great Buddha's moving! Namu Amida Butsu!{0012}
Ever since the jungle started spreading, all travel to other villages has stopped completely.{0012}
I wonder what's become of Matsusaka and Shima Village, near Ise Shrine?{0012}
I came from Akame Village to the south, but the jungle blocked the road, and now I can't go home.{0012}
I'm worried about Akame Village... It's so small, if the forest closes in, it won't stand a chance.{0012}
The jungle is spreading fast toward the west. I'm sorry to say it, but Akame Village is surely gone.{0012}

For your own good, think first about staying at an inn and taking the gear off.{0012}

Some folks say they've seen a stone boat flying through the sky... but I haven't seen one yet!{0012}
My grandpa's gone senile. All he talks about is dreamy stuff like rocks flying in the sky.{0012}
My grandpa's so behind the times! He's never even seen a stone boat flying in the sky!{0012}
Everybody in Ise Province knows stone boats fly these days!{0012}
They say the Kuki Clan was based in what's now Shima Village.{0012}
There should still be Kuki descendants in Shima. If you want to know about the stone boats, why not go see?{0012}
It pains my heart to think what the villagers Kikugoro carried off must be going through...{0012}
With a Dark Orchid blooming at Ise Shrine, I can't go to pray.{0012}
A Dark Orchid bloomed at Ise Shrine, so everyone who came on pilgrimage is stuck in this town.{0012}

Until I pass on Kuki's last words to someone, I've got to keep my head in good shape!{0012}
"Play the flute upon the stone stage!"{0012}

They say long ago, the Kuki Clan's ancestors helped some people move to Kii Province.{0012}
My late father said they got the stone boat as thanks.{0012}
At this rate, Ise Province will be swallowed by the jungle. Someone must act, and soon...{0012}
Day and night I pray to the gods to destroy Jungle Castle...{0012}

Will my prayers never reach the heavens...?{0012}
All we can do here is pray...{0012}
We can only hope for a hero to appear, strike down the evil, and blow away the darkness...{0012}

The Great Buddha! You folks are riding around in something incredible!{0012}
With the Great Buddha on your side, the jungle's nothing to fear! On to Jungle Castle, go, go!{0012}
The jungle spreads further every day. It's too dangerous. We can't live here anymore.{0012}
I wanted to flee to the capital, Kyoto, but roots have blocked the road! All I can do is wait here to die!{0012}
They say the Kuki Clan of Shima Village used to fly through the sky in a stone boat.{0012}

How to get into the Negoro Tomb? Hmm, no idea at all.{0012}
Why not try Matsusaka? Loads of pilgrims to Ise Shrine pass through there, so you'll hear all sorts of stories.{0012}
You got into the Negoro Tomb? Well, good for you! But what's so fun about going somewhere that creepy?{0012}
That building next to the village, the Myoin... Even with my carpenter's eye, I can't tell what it's made of.{0012}
Well, I'll be! A Great Buddha under the ground! Blew my mind!{0012}
Even digging a cellar is hard work! To bury something that huge... no human did that!{0012}
Dark Orchid roots have blocked the mountain road south of this village.{0012}
Past there is Ikoma Pass, which leads to Naniwa Province, but the roots are in the way, so we can't even escape!{0012}
The other day I was diggin' in the backyard, and out came parts of some old contraption I'd never seen before!{0012}
Maybe my ancestors were contraption makers.{0012}
My son's too smart for his own good. I can't make heads or tails of what he says.{0012}
My dad thinks way too small.{0012}
It's more natural to think that long ago, a capital more advanced than anything today existed on this land.{0012}
A moving Great Buddha could only have been created by intelligent beings other than humans.{0012}
...Which means, surely, an advanced city once flourished on this land, and something other than humans lived there.{0012}

pages.en: There's a strangely shaped stone statue.{0012}
The founder of Kumano Shrine was called Lord Karasu, "the Crow". That's why the crow is this shrine's sacred object.{0012}
But this time, even that divine power seems to fall short.{0012}
The crows multiply along with the corpses, but the shrine only falls further into ruin.{0012}
The legends of Kumano say the founder, Lord Karasu, was not human, but something beyond human.{0012}
Judging by his name, could Lord Karasu have been one of the Ihika?{0012}
The monster is gone. Thank you, Fire Clan.{0012}
Perhaps you are messengers the gods sent to settle the chaos in this land.{0012}
So the legend was true?! The Kami-Tata really existed... And what an amazing ship it is!{0012}
A ship named Kami-Tata, once sailed by pirates, is said to be kept at Kumano Shrine...{0012}
That's the legend handed down in Kii.{0012}
May Lord Karasu, founder of Kumano Shrine, watch over you all.{0012}
For some reason, the main hall of Kumano Shrine has no entrance.{0012}
So no one has ever been inside, and no one knows what's in there.{0012}

With the Root Clan gone, more pilgrims will come to Kumano Shrine, I'm sure.{0012}

{k}イヒカ{h}のことだったのか{12}

pages.en: So the strange people who taught the pirates their skills were the Ihika!{0012}
They say the ones who taught the pirates to build ships were a strange people who moved from Ise to Kii.{0012}
Makes sense... No way our ancestors were smart enough to invent ships.{0012}
They say there's a coral island at Kushimoto. I'd love to get away from living in fear of the Root Clan and live on a beautiful island like that.{0012}
I haven't heard a thing about the Tycoon in Kyoto lately. I wonder how he's doing.{0012}
Long ago, the pirates offered up their ships, their very lives, to Kumano Shrine, they say.{0012}
Take the Kami-Tata our ancestors built and crush the Root Clan!{0012}
They say the Iga ninja are hard at work again.{0012}
Seems they're doing their utmost to help some folks called the Fire Clan.{0012}
All over Kii Province stand strange statues.{0012}
Some call them the pirates' guardian gods, but nobody knows what they really are.{0012}
I always thought they were Buddhas you pray to for an easy childbirth. Guess I was wrong!{0012}
This here's Kushimoto, a sleepy fishing village at the southern tip of Kii.{0012}
Thanks to those Root Clan bastards, we can't catch any fish. Sorry, but we can't offer you any hospitality.{0012}
Outta the way, outta the way! It's fishing season! It's our busiest time! Quit dawdling and work, work!{0012}
Oh, it's you folks! Thanks for your help back then! As you can see, we're swamped!{0012}
This village has a cluster of little rocks called the Hashigui Rocks.{0012}
They stand in a long line from the shore out toward the sea. It's an unusual sight, so you should go see.{0012}
Now, back to work! We've got to catch fresh fish and take it to the villages in need!{0012}
I lived in that place for a thousand years, so this is the first time I've ever seen fish. I wish I could show the real thing to the folks in the valley.{0012}
There's a funny person visiting the village. Looks at fish and cries tears of joy. Some hick from deep in the mountains?{0012}
Since the men can't fish anymore, we ama divers are working hard to make up for it.{0012}
But the work's getting harder, and more and more of us drown or wreck our health.{0012}
At this rate, we may have to abandon the village someday.{0012}

pages.en: Found Bronze Bell I!{0012}
Welcome to Shirahama, Kii's biggest hot spring resort! Enjoy our beautiful scenery and delicious food to your heart's content!{0012}
...Is what I'd like to say, but thanks to the Root Clan, our guests have really dried up.{0012}
That warship you were riding was so cool!{0012}
Long ago, rough-and-tumble pirates must have sailed the great wide ocean in that ship.{0012}
Thanks for smashing that rock. The truth is, my father was the last pirate in these parts.{0012}
It's not much of a thank-you, but... I'll tell you where my father hid the gear he used.{0012}
There's a place called Dragon God Cave to the northwest. There should be three or so things there. Grab 'em when you get the chance.{0012}

pages.en: I'm the cook at the hot spring inn, but thanks to that rock, we can't get fresh fish anymore.{0012}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you! I'll make it up to you!{0012}
Kii Province is land the pirates settled, you know.{0012}
There's no pirates left these days, but they say treasure they left behind is still somewhere in Kii.{0012}
Thank goodness the Root Clan's gone. The village chief seems to be resting easy now, too.{0012}
The village chief was carried off by the Root Clan and came back covered in blood. He's unconscious and in critical condition.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! Please, take good care of Lady Sandayu and the others!{0012}
Their skills are sharp, but they're still young girls, and often act without thinking.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, I am an Iga ninja. Ihika Village lies at the bottom of a vast valley, deep in the mountains south of here!{0012}
Kikugoro's men seem to be lying in wait in Kii Province too. Take the greatest care!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, I am an Iga ninja. Word has come that our chief has returned safely to the village!{0012}
The chief wishes to give you something important. Please hurry back to Iga!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I am an Iga ninja... Our clan's chief is still held captive by the Root Clan.{0012}
I hear you already have the stone boat. Then slipping into the Negoro Tomb, where the chief is held, will be easy.{0012}
The Negoro Tomb lies west of Iga Village. Fly there in the stone boat, and you will surely, surely reach it!{0012}
If you insist on going south to Kii Province first, I won't stop you, but...{0012}
Thanks to you folks, people will come back to this village. We're truly grateful.{0012}
Jungle Castle has left us few people for now, but Owase Village is meant to be the crossroads linking Ise Province to the north and Kii Province to the south.{0012}
A woman who says she lives in the Valley of Grief came by my place the other day. *Sniff, sniff*... She went around smelling me.{0012}
Without being asked, she even did my cleaning and laundry before she left. Strange woman. Not that I'm complaining.{0012}
You don't see women like that these days! She talked a bit funny, but I didn't mind her one bit.{0012}
Way down south, deep in the mountains, there's a huge valley. Us hunters call it the Valley of Grief.{0012}
They say you hear weeping there at night, or see figures down at the bottom. Anyway, there's lots of creepy stories.{0012}

jp:

思っていいかしら？

pages.en: Can I think of you as my real big brother, Manjimaru?

pages.en: I'm so happy! I'll hold on to those words and keep on living!{0012}

pages.en: Well then, I'll think of you as my little brother, Manjimaru.{0012}

jp: うーむ　それは　困った……{12}

pages.en: {000C}Hmm, that's a problem...{0012}
A little ways northeast, there's a big earthen mound.{0012}
Now and then some fella you never see around here plays a flute on top of it. Haven't seen him lately, though.{0012}
If you pick up something you don't recognize, don't go equipping it or eating it without thinking. It's for your own good.{0012}
The world's full of medicine that barely works and cursed junk lying around, you know.{0012}
Head way down south and there's a huge rift in the land called the Valley of Grief.{0012}
There's a basket called the yaen that crosses the valley, but they say it falls a lot, so don't ride it just for the novelty.{0012}
There are five Jizo statues in front of the shrine, and one of them has no head. It's kind of creepy.{0012}
But the legend says that Jizo has had no head ever since it was put up.{0012}
That's a mighty fine ship you've got! And that cannon on it is bigger than any I've ever seen!{0012}
They say Wakayama Castle has been taken over by a Root Clan fellow named Kikugoro.{0012}
Maybe he means to use that castle as a base to attack the villages of Kii.{0012}
Use your young strength to protect Jipang from the Root Clan's monsters! I'm begging you!{0012}

jp:

あると聞いてますわ{12}

pages.en: I hear there's a Tengu's hermitage beyond the mountains to the north.{0012}
Have you seen the strange statue standing beside the shrine?{0012}
It seems it was put up long, long ago, but no one in the village knows what it's a statue of.{0012}
So that strange statue has mysterious powers!{0012}
Oh, that's right! There were statues just like it in Shirahama Village and Kushimoto Village!{0012}

jp: {0C}またのお越しを　お待ちしとりまっせ{12}

pages.en: Come back and see us again!{0012}
When I get old, I want to soak in the hot springs at Shirahama Village, sip some sake, and look back on my life nice and slow.{0012}

pages.en: Found a Tidal Harpoon!{0012}
So the people who taught the pirates their skills were the Ihika...{0012}
Kii's got a long, deep history of its own!{0012}
Long ago, before Kii took shape as a province, pirates ruled this region.{0012}
They say the pirates kept the people in line with the might of a powerful warship called the Kami-Tata.{0012}
The other day I saw a pink tornado!{0012}
It had loads of monsters with it, and a voice from inside the tornado said, "Hurry and find the Bronze Bells!"{0012}
My heart was pounding, but I'm great at hide-and-seek, so they didn't find me!{0012}

jp:
お兄ちゃん
ときどき　遊びに来てね｜{12}

pages.en: Mister, come play sometimes!{0012}
Oho, that's an interesting ship you're riding! This must be fate. I'll give you what's in the treasure house!{0012}
Oho, that's an interesting ship you're riding! This must be fate. I'll give you what's in the treasure house!{0012}
...Or so I thought, but you've already helped yourselves, eh? That's the Heroes of Fire for you. Thorough, just like they say!{0012}
Long ago, before Kii took shape as a province, pirates ruled this region.{0012}
And they say the ones who taught the pirates to build ships were a strange-looking people who came over from Ise to Kii.{0012}
That's the legend handed down in Kii. True or false... it's all from long, long ago.{0012}
If you go on north between the mountains to the north, they say a great Tengu lives there.{0012}
They say a Tengu's house is on some island in this province's sea. Have you found it yet?{0012}
The Root Clan has started showing up in the forest behind the shrine.{0012}
Seems they're looking for something. They won't let villagers near. Be careful if you go into the forest.{0012}
There's a funny person visiting the village. Looks at fish and cries tears of joy. Must've come from way up in the mountains!{0012}
Have you seen the big valley to the north?{0012}
At night, creepy sobbing voices drift from that valley on the wind.{0012}
They say it's the voices of people who threw themselves into the valley. It's so scary, so scary...{0012}
Have you ever been to Kyoto? It's a huge city with shops lined up all the way to the horizon!{0012}
If you can open a shop there, you've really made it. Someday I want to run a fish shop in Kyoto!{0012}
They say the Hashigui Rocks are a bridge to a coral island.{0012}
I've never seen a coral island, but I'm sure it's beautiful.{0012}
Hey, hey, I hear you folks went to the coral island? Bet it's gorgeous, huh?{0012}
So, find anything valuable?{0012}
The Root Clan's gone?! Now that calls for a celebration!{0012}
All right! We're celebrating today! Boy! Go buy a whole sea bream, head and all!{0012}
*hic* Dammit... A fisherman who can't catch fish is like sushi with no fish on top!{0012}
Like takoyaki with no octopus in it!{0012}
Like kitsune udon with no fox in it!{0012}
Tch, there's never been any fox in kitsune udon! I'm so drunk I don't even know what I'm saying!{0012}
Dad's been drunk a lot lately, mumbling nonsense to himself.{0012}
Won't anybody bring me fish anymore?{0012}
When Dad says "sea bream," he means taiyaki, the fish-shaped cakes. He's a total cheapskate.{0012}
No point being a fisherman, so I figured I'd become a woodcutter...{0012}
But now the Root Clan's showing up even in the forest behind the shrine! Are they gonna torment us that much?!{0012}
With the Root Clan gone, even the fish are flapping their tails for joy! Gahahaha!{0012}

jp: 折れた銅鉾を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Broken Bronze Spear!{0012}
In Kii, there's a children's song that goes like this:{0012}

Round the Hashigui Rocks, round and round,
Round go your eyes, round goes your head{0012}

Round goes the spring, round goes life,
In the spring going round, a fragment of life{0012}
I don't know what it means, but don't you think it's a lovely song, with the weight of history in it?{0012}
They say there was quite a show at Wakayama Castle!{0012}
Right on top of the castle, two performers put on a grand play of monsters and shapeshifting!{0012}
Long ago, the pirates who ran wild in Kii later became fishermen and woodcutters and settled down here, they say.{0012}
If the wild blood of pirates still ran in us, we might have stood up to the Root Clan...{0012}
But with the passing years, it seems that blood has thinned.{0012}

jp: {k}ンガー　ンガー{12}

pages.en: They say the Root Clan is searching for the Bronze Bells hidden somewhere in Kii.{0012}
To learn where the Bronze Bells are, they kidnapped my husband, the oldest man in these parts, and did such terrible things... *sob*...{0012}
I see... So it was you who beat Kikugoro... Thank you for avenging my husband.{0012}
So you're the one who beat the Root Clan, mister! You've really got something!{0012}
Bet the girls won't leave you alone, huh? Yep! I get it! I get it!{0012}
The inn's hot spring suddenly went dry, and the old man soaking in it got such a shock his legs gave out!{0012}
The other day I was playing hide-and-seek at the shrine and found a statue like an ogre! I was so scared I wet myself a little!{0012}

jp:
ええ湯じゃ…
湯気が　のぼっとるのう{12}

pages.en: Ahh, what a nice bath... The steam's rising nicely...{0012}
{000C}...or so I thought, but there's no hot water!{0012}
{000C}All things born upon this earth will one day be called up to the heavens... just like this steam.{0012}
So it is with humans, so it is with the Root Clan... I seem to have soaked a bit too long. Got all philosophical there.{0012}
Head out to sea by boat and you'll see the little island where the Tengu lives.{0012}
Living out on the sea like that, that Tengu must really love the ocean.{0012}
Welcome, honored guests! You must be tired!{0012}
It's {001E} Ryo a night. Wash off the road in our hot spring?

jp:
{k}トホホホ…　{h}どうしたわけか
湯が　突然　渇れちまいまして…{12}
名物の温泉が　ないんじゃねぇ…
１両で　いいっす…　泊まって下さい

pages.en: Boo hoo... For some reason, the hot spring suddenly dried up...{0012}
With no famous hot spring... 1 Ryo is fine... Please, stay the night.

jp: 宿泊と記録で　ございますね？

pages.en: Stay and save, then?

jp:
お客様　温泉代が
少し足りないようですね…{12}

pages.en: Oh dear, you seem a little short for the bath fee...{0012}
You haven't even got 1 Ryo... When the hot spring dries up, even the customers go cheap all of a sudden...{0012}

jp:
お湯に　ゆっくりつかって
ぐっすり　お休みくださいな{12}

pages.en: Have a nice long soak and a good night's sleep!{0012}
Without a soak in the hot spring, you may not feel very rested... but please, make yourselves at home.{0012}

jp: お泊りだけで　ございますね？

pages.en: Just the stay, then?
While you're soaking, you can forget all about fighting. Please, rest well.{0012}

jp: 記録のみで　ございますね！

pages.en: Just saving, then!
Take a dip in a hot spring now and then and forget your silly worries! You'll live longer!{0012}
Yes... your journey is recorded. A guest coming all the way to Shirahama just to save... My father would weep if he knew...{0012}

jp: また　いらしてくださいね{12}

pages.en: Please come again!{0012}
I suppose so... Take the hot spring away from Shirahama, and all that's left is sand...{0012}

jp:
よく眠れましたか？
また　おいでくださいね！　卍丸様｜{12}

pages.en: Did you sleep well? Please come again, Lord Manjimaru!{0012}
............Did you dream of soaking in a warm bath? Please don't give up on us. Come again!{0012}

jp: 湯は　渇れている{12}

pages.en: The hot spring has dried up.{0012}

jp: 湯が　こんこんとわき出している{12}

pages.en: Hot water is welling up!{0012}

jp: 弐の銅鐸を見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found Bronze Bell II!{0012}
Kii Province to the south is all mountains and valleys. The terrain's a real maze, so if you get lost, check your map.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I hear you drove Kikugoro out of Wakayama Castle! I look forward to your deeds to come.{0012}
If you equip something cursed, the thing to do is stay at an inn or some such and rest up for a night.{0012}
Then it'll come off on its own. Don't rush it, don't force it... That's the best cure for a curse.{0012}
Kii is nearly all mountains. That's why every town and village clings to the narrow flatland along the sea.{0012}
First-timers get lost all the time. Walk a bit, check the map! Walk a bit, check the map! That's the trick.{0012}
My buddy says he saw a pirate ship off Shirahama! A pirate ship, in this day and age! Come up with a better lie!{0012}
The other day, a whole bunch of folks from Ihika Village showed up, asking strange questions again.{0012}
"Young lady! Have humans learned to fly yet?" So I told them...{0012}
"When a woman finds the right man, why, she floats right off the ground!" And then they said...{0012}
"Your science is far more advanced than ours." They even wanted to shake my hand!{0012}
Must've been about a year ago... Three nasty-eyed fellows came by and asked strange questions.{0012}
"Who does Jipang belong to now?" When I said it belongs to nobody, they suddenly cheered right up.{0012}
They were talking about going to Kyoto to get themselves an easy-to-work puppet, so they must be puppeteers or something.{0012}
I've quit woodcutting! I'll never cut a tree again! It's the least I can do for their souls.{0012}
I can never be a woodcutter again! The other day, up on the hill out back, I saw somethin' horrible!{0012}
I swung my axe into a tree like always, and the tree spurted bright red blood! My legs gave right out...{0012}
When I looked up at that tree, it had the face of a woodcutter I knew...{0012}
In Kyoto you can get just about anything! And the selection changes with the seasons!{0012}
Long ago, a people with amazingly advanced skills came from somewhere and settled around here, they say.{0012}
They taught shipbuilding and building, then vanished without a trace. Strange story, isn't it?{0012}
You're fighting that Root lot?! My help wouldn't amount to much...{0012}
I'd rather not think about it, but if you ever get badly hurt, remember me! I'd like to at least nurse you.{0012}
Phew... I was worried there for a while, but even amateur nursing pulls you through, huh?{0012}
Keep at it, Manjimaru! You're the only one we can count on!{0012}

jp:
{1A}は　四水の鏡を
石像に向けた！{12}

pages.en:
{001A} held the Four Waters
Mirror toward the stone statue!{0012}

jp: 何か　埋まっている{12}

pages.en: Something is buried here.{0012}

jp:
異形の石像がある
指を一本　立てている{12}

pages.en: There's a strangely shaped stone statue. It's holding up one finger.{0012}

jp:
{1A}は　石像の指に
嘆きの指輪をはめた！{12}

pages.en:
{001A} slipped the Ring of Lament
onto the statue's finger!{0012}
That fiery light in your eyes! You are the Fire Clan! At last... at last you've come...{0012}
A thousand years since that cursed war... Ah, at last the day has come when we can return to the land of light...{0012}
May Lady Mari's protection always be with you.{0012}
We Ihika are of the Root Clan too. We'd have no right to complain if you of the Fire Clan killed us...{0012}
But for a thousand years, we have been waiting for you.{0012}
Because only the Fire Clan can sever our cursed fate...{0012}
We Ihika are the descendants of scholars who fled the Root Kingdom during the war a thousand years ago.{0012}
Our ancestors made... humans, birds and beasts, mermaids and the ogre folk... and above all, the Fire Clan...{0012}
...their targets. To kill them...{0012}
They created countless arts and mechanical soldiers, and even altered their comrades' bodies to gain the smallest edge in war.{0012}
But growing afraid of their part in the war, they slipped out of the Root Kingdom and fled here.{0012}
Since then, so that Ihika knowledge would never be misused, we have lived in this valley for a thousand years, hidden from human eyes.{0012}
Never leave the valley... That is the law of the Ihika.{0012}
It is all our failing... I cannot apologize enough for Deron and the others...{0012}
The prophecy left by our forefather Kumana says this:{0012}
"When the Fire Clan descends upon this land and the Giant of Ihika stands, we shall see the light once more."{0012}
Believing in that prophecy, we have lived in this dark valley until now!{0012}
I went out to see the outside world right away! There are no walls, no ceiling! Honestly, I was amazed!{0012}
The Root Clan's Three Doctors you are fighting... the truth is, they came from this valley...{0012}
The three of them broke our law and left the valley, saying, "We'll change this foolish talk of fate with our own power..."{0012}
Deron, Beron, Deroren... Do not underestimate those three. The trouble with them is...{0012}
...they are nothing short of geniuses...{0012}
The truth is, Deron and the other Doctors weren't the first to break the valley's law.{0012}
About three years ago, a man named Toki boasted he would revive Masakado of the ogre folk, and then vanished.{0012}
They say Toki died in Bando...{0012}
Toki means "morning sun" in the Ihika tongue. Perhaps that's why he longed for the light of the surface more than anyone...{0012}
When Deron and the other two left the valley, we were certain the Root Clan would return.{0012}
To stand against them, we simply had to find the Fire Clan.{0012}
So we asked Momochi Tanba of Iga to search for the Fire Clan. And Tanba did not fail us.{0012}
The Hero of Fire has come to our valley at last!{0012}
Hurry! Even a Hero of Fire would stand no chance against a revived Yomi!{0012}
Deron and the others probably chose the Tycoon so they could find and pull out the Holy Swords of Fire efficiently.{0012}
I believe they've already found where Yomi sleeps, too. That much would be child's play for them...{0012}
All that's left is to gather human life force with the Dark Orchids, send it to Yomi, and wait for the revival... And their strategy can only be one thing...{0012}
To buy time! They'll use every means they have to hold you back.{0012}
Deron and the others think nothing of other people's lives. Even their own comrades' lives.{0012}
If need be... no, against the Fire Clan, there will be need... they'll even sacrifice the Root generals as pawns.{0012}
So take care not to be carried away by a passing victory.{0012}
They say that when our ancestors fled the Root Kingdom, they hid the weapons they took with them all over the land.{0012}
Perhaps the Giant of Ihika is one of those weapons...{0012}
If it's a weapon of science made by the Ihika's ancestors, Jungle Castle will be no match for it!{0012}
The forebear and goddess of the Fire Clan... Lady Mari! No one has ever confirmed her form!{0012}
If anyone could fight Yomi as an equal, surely it would be her alone... But where will she appear...{0012}
That's Lady Kumana's altar in the middle. Stand near it, and Lady Kumana's voice echoes in your heart.{0012}
It's a wonderful contraption that turns Lady Kumana's thoughts into a circuit. We could never make anything like it today.{0012}
I met a human man from the surface. Ignorant, barbaric, lazy and filthy! A hopeless bunch, all of them...{0012}
But they're lovable creatures. The powerful smell of the young specimens was especially striking and interesting.{0012}
I like that smell.{0012}
Manjimaru! They say a girl from Owase Village gained the power of flight by having a man's skin grafted onto her...{0012}
Not even our ancestors managed such advanced body modification! Humans are not to be underestimated!{0012}
It's working properly... I think. Step on one of the marks on the floor and you'll see.{0012}
I don't think it'll kill you.{0012}
Everyone in the village knows that pressing the button on the altar conveys Kumana's will.{0012}
But no one knows what the five marks on the floor there do. I think they're probably an escape device.{0012}
Today is a day to remember: the Hero of Fire has come to Ihika!{0012}
If you wish, shall I switch it on, just for you?
It's working properly... I think. Step on one of the marks on the floor and you'll see.{0012}
I don't think it'll kill you.{0012}
Probably...{0012}
{000C}I see... Then I'll try switching it on once the Giant of Ihika moves.{0012}
I AM KUMANA OF IHIKA.{0012}
{000C}HERO OF FIRE. THE FOUR BRONZE BELLS OPEN WITH THE FOUR WATERS MIRROR.{0012}
{000C}HARD, AND SOFT. HOT, AND COLD. WITHIN ALL LIFE.{0012}
{000C}WITHIN ALL LIFE.{0012}
I AM KUMANA OF IHIKA. HERO OF FIRE. WHERE IS MARI?{0012}
{000C}WHERE IS MARI?{0012}
From now on, you'll come by all sorts of vehicles in all sorts of places!{0012}
So let me give you one important warning. Remember it!{0012}
Most vehicles, whether made by you of the Fire Clan or by us Ihika, have a simple automatic return device.{0012}
If you ever lose track of your vehicle, don't panic! Search the place where you first found it! It should have gone back there!{0012}
You are the Hero of Fire! Welcome, welcome! I am the elder of the Ihika.{0012}
Our forefather Kumana said: "When the Root Clan appears once more, the Giant of Ihika shall stand."{0012}
The Giant of Ihika will surely help you take Jungle Castle. Sir Manjimaru, please find the Giant!{0012}
Legend says the Giant of Ihika is sealed deep underground by four colored Bronze Bells.{0012}
But we do not know where the four colored Bronze Bells or the Giant of Ihika are hidden.{0012}
Kumana's altar may hold some record. You'd do well to examine the altar.{0012}
I have a favor to ask of you! The truth is, Deron, Beron and Deroren are my sons.{0012}
By rights, I should deal with my sons with my own hands, but lately I can barely even walk...{0012}
I beg you, wipe those wretches from this world with your own hands! Otherwise I can't die in peace!{0012}

Defeating the Root Clan with the power of the Giant of Ihika...{0012}
With that, our atonement for the Ihika's part in the war a thousand years ago will be complete...{0012}
That must be what Lady Kumana's prophecy is telling us.{0012}

jp:
あなた様の上に　いつも
{k}マリ様{h}のご加護が　ありますように{12}

pages.en: May Lady Mari's protection always be with you.{0012}
You must be the Fire Clan.{0012}
Won't you at least let me restore your strength?

{01}やめる

   {0001}Cancel

pages.en: Thank you! Now, please get some sleep.{0012}
Take care! May Lady Mari's protection always be with you.{0012}
Cautious as ever, I see... If anything here catches your eye, please, take it.{0012}
If you ever find a red treasure chest somewhere, you must never open it.{0012}
It's one of the deadliest traps our ancestors ever made. It's called the Box of the Hundred Demons' Night Parade...{0012}

And what a color for the walls! This is the height of bad taste! Ugh, I'm getting dizzy...{0012}
"A portrait of Kikugoro... He wears a smirk that seems to sneer at the world."{0012}

jp:
「菊五郎の銅像だ…
　明らかに　本人より　足が長い｜」{12}

pages.en: "A bronze statue of Kikugoro... The legs are clearly longer than the real thing!"{0012}
I don't know what good it does to tell you now, but... about the treasure chest in the basement...{0012}
If you go right from the town entrance, all the way around to the back of the castle, there are stairs...{0012}
Not much point telling you now, though...{0012}

ＧＵＯＤ　ＢＡＹ　ＢＥＢＹ｜{12}
つづりが間違ってい…{12}

pages.en: GUOD BAY BEBY!{0012}

ＧＵＯＤ　ＢＡＹ　ＢＥＢＹ｜{12}
つづりが間違っている{12}
