The spelling is wrong.{0012}

jp: やせて　見える鏡だ｜{12}

pages.en: A mirror that makes you look thinner!{0012}

jp: {0C}花柄の{k}パンツ{h}を手に入れた！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Got the Floral Underpants!{0012}
Kikugoro seems to be the type who can't do anything unless someone's watching or listening.{0012}
Just thinking about another night coming makes me feel like I'll go mad.{0012}
There's nothing left in this world that scares me anymore.{0012}
What do you make of this statue? If you ask me, anyone who gets a statue while he's still alive is no good.{0012}

jp:
ほー　あんたが　菊五郎を成敗したんか
そりゃあ　お手柄じゃ｜{12}
で　こんどは　あんたの銅像を
ここに　建てて欲しいわけかな？

pages.en: Oho, so you're the one who punished Kikugoro! Well done!{0012}
So now you want your own statue put up here?

jp: あんたも　ろくな者じゃ　なかね{12}

pages.en: Then you're no good either.{0012}
I see! Well then, maybe I'll put up a statue of myself instead! Hahahahahaha!{0012}

jp: 金髪がつらを　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Blond Wig!{0012}

jp: 花柄{k}パンツ{h}を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found Floral Underpants!{0012}

jp:
どなたか　存じませぬが　私たちを
お助けくださいませ…{12}

pages.en: I don't know who you are, but please, save us...{0012}
It's strange... The ones who died in the cell were Number One and Number Five, Satsuki and Ofumi...{0012}
But there was never anyone called Number Three in that cell. Who on earth was Number Three?{0012}
That Kikugoro doesn't think of us as human. He calls us by numbers, not names.{0012}

jp:
さすがに　他の女たちは　殿に
お暇を　いただいたようですわ…{12}

pages.en: It seems the other women have finally been released by the lord...{0012}

jp:
よ　よ　夜が　こわい！
このままでは　体が　こわれてしまう{12}

pages.en: N-n-nights are terrifying! At this rate, my body will give out!{0012}

jp: やつは　{k}ケダモノ{h}よ………{12}

pages.en: He's an animal...{0012}

jp:
私の名前は　桜の局よ｜
八番じゃないわ｜{12}

pages.en: My name is Lady Sakura! Not Number Eight!{0012}

jp:
早く　助けてくだされ｜
もう　二人も　ここで　死にました{12}

pages.en: Please, save us quickly! Two have already died in here!{0012}
So even Kikugoro takes Sundays off. Friday's "4 and 7"... Monday's "3"...{0012}
Oh dear, oh dear, pardon me...{0012}
This chart and the meaning of "Number Three" have nothing whatsoever to do with you, Sir Manjimaru. I cannot explain, even if asked.{0012}
In any case, for now, think only of peace for Jipang and defeating the Root Clan.{0012}

Mon:3 Tue:6 Wed:2 Thu:8
Fri:4 and 7 Sat:9 Sun:none{0012}
It looks like some kind of schedule.{0012}

jp:
難しい本ばかりだ
だが　{k}ページ{h}を開いた形跡は　ない{12}

pages.en: Nothing but difficult books. But there's no sign anyone ever opened them.{0012}

jp: 枕もとに　長い髪が落ちている{12}

pages.en: A long hair lies by the pillow.{0012}
Not my place to lecture a fine Fire Clan fellow like you, but you can't carry any more scrolls!{0012}
There's that handy thing called a storehouse, right? Come back later!{0012}
It's them, isn't it? This latest mess is the Ihika lot's doing? Right? I know it!{0012}

jp:
ほらよ！　俺の巻物を　渡すぜ！
冬枯の巻物だ！　しぶい術だぜ！{12}

pages.en: Here! I'm handing over my scroll! It's Winter Wither! A slick technique!{0012}

jp: 冬枯の巻物

pages.en: Winter Wither scroll
Just how do you plan to carry any more scrolls, huh? Mister Fire Clan!{0012}
Were the folks in the Valley of Grief doing all right?! It's been over a thousand years since I parted with 'em...{0012}
Well then, take it and be grateful! It's the Forget Mother scroll! I'm counting on you, Fire Clan! Let's make this the last war!{0012}

jp: 母忘の巻物

pages.en: Forget Mother scroll
Hya hya hya! Looks like your scroll bag is full! I can't give you a scroll like that!{0012}
Hya hya hya! Welcome, welcome! How many years has it been since I talked to a person...{0012}
Hya hya hya! Fire Clan, are you? No wonder. No normal person would come to a place like this... So! What do you want?{0012}
Mine's good! Real good! It's called Mud Worm, a nasty little scroll! Here, take it!{0012}

jp: 泥虫の巻物

pages.en: Mud Worm scroll
Looks like you can't carry any more scrolls, but mine's really useful, so don't forget to come back for it!{0012}
Welcome, Fire Clan! Let's get right to it! I'm handing over my scroll! It's Ebb Tide!{0012}

jp: 引波の巻物

pages.en: Ebb Tide scroll
{000C}Argh, I can't stand it! We got through a thousand years in peace, and now this! Root and Fire are SO out of fashion!{0012}
Damn it, give me a break! Mountains of weak little humans are gonna die bawling all over again, aren't they?{0012}
Can't you do something, Mister Fire Clan? Sorry it's always the same, but now it's come to this, you're the only ones we can count on!{0012}
{000C}That's right! The other Tengu may not have said a word about it, but we were Root Clan ourselves, once upon a time!{0012}
Tch! You've been gratefully taking our scrolls all this time without noticing? The Fire Clan never changes!{0012}
{000C}Hya hya hya! Don't say it! Don't say it! I know without you saying it! It's that, right? Eh? It's that, right?{0012}
{000C}The escape scroll you must never forget when you storm an enemy's lair! It's handy! Only thing is...{0012}
...the Fire Clan used it so shamelessly a thousand years ago that the Root folks came up with a countermeasure.{0012}
So! There are caves where this scroll's effect is sealed. Use it carefully!{0012}
You're lucky you came to this village! A real beauty is visiting right now!{0012}
To think that girl was a Root Clan monster... You can't judge a woman by her looks. Fearsome creatures!{0012}
They say Jungle Castle has fallen! Now the Root Clan won't come to the village anymore.{0012}
Have you seen the girl who came to the village lately? Have you? She's a total knockout! Her green hair is so exotic!{0012}
The Root Clan made this village so gloomy, but just having her here has everybody walking on air!{0012}
That ship you're on looks just like the pirates' Kami-Tata my granddad told me about long ago!{0012}
They say that long ago, Jipang had two giant ships: the Kami-Tata and the Otata.{0012}
The Root Clan attacked Mt. Koya, to the north!{0012}
We fought with all we had, but were defeated in the end and fled all the way here.{0012}
They say four Tengu live in Kii. Have you met them?{0012}
They say a man named Saikaku is writing "The Life of an Amorous Man" about Kabuki!{0012}
Every rose has its thorns, as they say! A beautiful woman always has a dangerous side.{0012}
Maybe it would've done the men of this village good to have their lovestruck heads eaten by Princess Kuchinawa, don't you think?!{0012}
What's with the men in this village?! All of them mooning around! Pathetic!{0012}
Sure, that girl's cute, but she's got such cold eyes! What a nasty woman!{0012}
It's terrible! Kikugoro of the Root Clan has taken over the castle!{0012}
The lord and his men were all driven out and scattered!{0012}
Anyway, the lord's been able to go back to his castle, so for now the townsfolk can breathe easy.{0012}
Past the mountains to the east there's a big valley the hunters and woodcutters call the Valley of Grief.{0012}
They say lots of pages and women are still trapped inside the castle. I hope nothing terrible's happened to them.{0012}
What were you folks doing up on the castle roof?! The whole town was watching!{0012}
Well, you drove Kikugoro out, so I've got no complaints, but couldn't you fight a little more seriously?{0012}

jp:
あんた　火の勇者だろ
わかるさ　その血のにおい……
修ら場を　抜けてきた奴の　においだ{12}
ところでよ　火の勇者と見込んで
頼みが　あるんだけどよ
おやじが　ちょっと　わけありでよ{12}
引き受けてくれるなら　ここを　どくぜ
どうだい　頼まれてくれるかい？

pages.en: You're the Hero of Fire, right? I can tell from the smell of blood... That's the smell of someone who's been through the thick of battle.{0012}
Say, trusting you as the Hero of Fire, I've got a favor to ask. My old man's in a bit of a situation.{0012}
If you'll take it on, I'll get out of the way. How about it? Will you do it?

jp:
{0C}悪いな　とりあえず　中へ入って
おやじの様子を　見てやってくれよ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thanks. For now, go inside and check on my old man.{0012}
{000C}Tch! So the Hero of Fire's just another human after all! I misjudged you! Go get eaten by dogs!{0012}
Tch! The shrines and temples humans build are no use at all!{0012}
I heard Lake Biwa in Omi Province turned the color of blood or something... Surely not...{0012}
Surely not, but ever since the Root Clan started moving, one unthinkable thing after another keeps happening.{0012}
Sharp as you are, you've probably been already, but there's a Tengu past Ibuki Pass to the east.{0012}

jp:
ねぇ　ぼくたち　みんな
死んじゃうの…♀{12}

pages.en: Hey... are we all gonna die...?!{0012}
North of Otsu there's a holy mountain called Hakusan. They've been digging there for about six months on the Tycoon's orders.{0012}
"Ponpokorin!" They say saying that makes old customers from Bando happy. Wonder why?{0012}

jp: {k}クゥーン　クゥーン……

pages.en: Whimper... whimper...
{000C}Hm! Why, this is a letter from Kinu! Let's see...{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０大江山が　根の一族に
見つかってしまいました…{12}

pages.en: {000C}"Mt. Oe has been discovered by the Root Clan...{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０危険ですので　お近づきに
ならないでください{12}

pages.en: {000C}It is dangerous, so please do not come near.{0012}
{000C}Please think of Kinu as someone who was never there, and fulfill the Fire Clan's mission on your own.{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０{k}シロ{h}のことは　よろしく
お願いします…　さようなら…{12}

pages.en: {000C}Please take good care of Shiro... Farewell..."{0012}
{000C}Whoa! Manjimaru! Don't you think we'd better hurry to Mt. Oe?!{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０女に　いいとこ見せる
絶好の機会だぞ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}It's the perfect chance to show off for a girl!{0012}
{000C}Save Kinu, and it'll be "Oh, Manjimaru, you're wonderful!" Smooch! Just like that!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０{k}シロ{h}が　仲間に加わった｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Shiro has joined the party!{0012}

jp: 「酒呑童子と　その妻　綾の墓」{12}

pages.en: "Grave of Shuten-doji and his wife, Aya"{0012}
Have you seen the horror in Kyoto? The fate of this land now rests with you all!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! The people of Jipang, for better or worse, are a fickle lot...{0012}
Try going back to a province you saved from the Dark Orchid and talking to the people there again.{0012}
Nine times out of ten, I'd wager, they'll have changed their tune completely.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! Protect Jipang! Yomi must not be revived!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru... I hear you fell into a vixen's trap. My condolences...{0012}
Well, everything's experience! Fertilizer for a long life! ...That's not much comfort, is it?{0012}
Manjimaru, that woman in Kyoto, "Omiru"... Something smells fishy about her.{0012}
Be careful, just in case. It may be best not to get involved at all.{0012}

jp:
あんたらと戦う　根の一族に
同情しちまいそうだよ……{12}

pages.en: I'm starting to feel sorry for the Root Clan, having to fight you lot...{0012}
You're Manjimaru? With that tiny body, you've been going toe to toe with Root monsters?!{0012}
The Fire Clan really is something! I thought I understood it in my head, but seeing it in front of me still amazes me!{0012}
And you'll get even stronger, right? Come to think of it, you Fire Clan are way more monstrous than they are...{0012}
I'm starting to feel sorry for the Root Clan, having to fight you lot...{0012}
Now, I'm handing over the Thunderbolt scroll! I think you'll find it mighty handy!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０雷電の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Thunderbolt scroll!{0011}{004D}

jp:
{0C}京都の預かり所に　巻物を一本な！
預かってもらってから　また　来なよ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Leave one scroll at the storehouse in Kyoto! Then come back!{0012}
Go east from here and there's nothing but a grubby little hut! Makes for a nice stroll, though!{0012}
Long ago a traveler told me there's a mermaid village over in Echizen. Now there's a dreamy story for these times... Uhoho.{0012}
Hida Province is just to the east, but Dark Orchid roots had the road blocked till lately. Real pain, that was.{0012}
This is Fujiwara Pass, on the border of Hida and Kyoto Province.{0012}
East is Hida Province. West is Kyoto Province.{0012}
Manjimaru, it's terrible! A Dark Orchid has bloomed in Kyoto!{0012}
They say there's a little shrine past the mountains to the north. Maybe a Tengu lives there?{0012}
You came from Ise, did ya? Then the roots on the border must be gone! Well, that's grand!{0012}
Kyoto! Kyoto's been crushed by the Dark Orchid! Wiped out without a trace!{0012}
Kyoto Province has Kyoto, the greatest city in Jipang. Loads of temples and shops, and lively as can be!{0012}
The tower on Lake Biwa has started giving off an eerie light lately. Is something out there...?{0012}
Huh? You want to buy some items? Sorry, I'm sold out right now!{0012}
I'm just heading to Kyoto to stock up on goods.{0012}
There's loads of armories and item shops over there, after all. Never any trouble restocking!{0012}
The sound of the Dark Orchid flattening the city and the shrieks and wails of the people carried all the way here...{0012}
My lottery ticket lost again this year!{0012}
Just you watch! Next year I'll hit the jackpot, be a millionaire, and live it up!{0012}
It's about time for the lottery tickets to go on sale in Kyoto. I'd best go buy some.{0012}
Sixty years I've been chasing the big lottery win! This year I'll win it on sheer willpower! Kieeeeeeeeei!{0012}

jp:
ねぇ　どうしたの？
なんで　みんな　悲しい顔してるの？{12}

pages.en: Hey, what's wrong? Why does everybody look so sad?{0012}
He was dressed in rags and said "Gimme food," so I gave him a pickled plum.{0012}
He took one bite and made a huge fuss!{0012}
I cannot abandon this capital, which has prospered since ancient times, and flee to some poorer land.{0012}
I'll await heaven's will here in peace. When it's time to die, we all die anyway.{0012}
Kyoto is guarded by countless gods and Buddhas. To monsters, it's forbidden ground, you might say.{0012}
No Dark Orchid could ever get in here! Wahahaha!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! Kyoto is already wiped out! They say the whole city has been drowned in a sea of blood!{0012}
But my tanuki's intuition tells me the city folk are still alive somewhere.{0012}
Please, Sir Manjimaru, use your power to save the people of Kyoto!{0012}

jp:
どうも　ありがとうございました
おかげ様で　平和に暮せますよ{12}

pages.en: Thank you so very much. Thanks to you, we can live in peace.{0012}

jp:
おぬしの巻物袋は　いっぱいのようじゃ
何か　預り所に　預けてきてくだされ{12}

pages.en: Your scroll bag seems to be full. Please leave something at the storehouse.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I'm truly sorry to have troubled you with my request. It's not much of a thank-you, but...{0012}
I shall give you this Embers scroll!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０卍丸は　残火の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Manjimaru got the Embers scroll!{0011}{0068}

jp:
{0C}この巻物を　使うたびに　信楽村のことを
思い出してくれると　嬉しいのぉ{12}

pages.en: {000C}I'd be glad if you remembered Shigaraki Village every time you use this scroll.{0012}
Whew, looks like my power's back! Well? How do you like this young lady's form? Quite something, eh?{0012}
But this form actually takes a whole lot out of me... Pardon me while I change back into something comfier.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I'm truly sorry to have troubled you with my request. It's not much of a thank-you, but...{0012}
I shall give you this Embers scroll!{0012}
{000C}...or so I thought, but your scroll bag seems to be full. Please leave something at the storehouse.{0012}
I'm not in any particular hurry, but it is awfully inconvenient, so please buy that Century Ginseng as soon as you can.{0012}

jp:
お恥ずかしいかぎりじゃ……
わしのような古狸が　この姿を
人目に　さらすなどとは……{12}
わしも　もうろくしたのか
近頃　思うままに　化けれんように
なってきたんですわ{12}
京都で売っている　百年人参さえ
飲めば　霊力がもどると　思うんじゃが
なにしろ　京都は　犬が多くて……{12}
あんた　すまんけど　京都へ行って
百年人参を　買ってきてくれんか？

pages.en: How shameful... For an old tanuki like me to be seen in public like this...{0012}
Maybe I'm getting senile. Lately, I can't shapeshift the way I want to.{0012}
If I could just take the Century Ginseng they sell in Kyoto, I think my spiritual power would come back, but... Kyoto has so many dogs...{0012}
Sorry to ask, but could you go to Kyoto and buy me some Century Ginseng?
{000C}Really? Thank you! Here's the money for it! Keep the change! Consider it my thanks!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０卍丸は　{1E}両　手に入れた！

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Manjimaru got {001E} Ryo!
{000C}So you're no good with dogs either, eh? I understand... Sad or happy, they bite no matter what!{0012}
We went to all that trouble to build a village just for tanuki, and thought we could finally live in peace...{0012}
...but with a Dark Orchid out there, we'll have to move away from here too.{0012}
Us tanuki have never gotten along with dogs... No matter how old we get, being barked at still scares us silly.{0012}
We live by making use of humans, yet we're helpless against dogs, who live by being made use of. Isn't that a joke?{0012}
I can just picture you battling swarms of dogs to the death, risking your life to bring back the Century Ginseng!{0012}
Hey, Manjimaru! It's bad! A huge, gigantic Dark Orchid has bloomed in Kyoto!{0012}
Well, if you're serious about living alongside humans, keep as low a profile as you can, like us.{0012}
No matter how much you do, humans only fuss over you in the moment, after all.{0012}
You're Fire Clan, right? Then you're closer to us than to humans, if anything.{0012}
Truth is, everybody in this village looks like this, but none of us are human. We're tanuki! Good disguises, huh?{0012}
Well, dealing with humans is a lot of trouble, right? They judge you by your looks right away.{0012}

jp:
つまんない物しか　売ってないんですよ
それでも　いいでしょうか？

pages.en: We only sell boring stuff here. Is that all right?

jp: {0C}こりずに　また来てくださいね{12}

pages.en: {000C}Please don't give up on us. Come again!{0012}

jp: {0C}すんまへんなぁ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Sorry about that.{0012}
*Cough! Cough!* The pollen the Dark Orchid gives off is far too strong for us tanuki! *Cough! Cough!*{0012}
In Omi Province there's a legend that a god's ship called the Otata is enshrined on top of some mountain.{0012}
No idea why anyone would haul a ship all the way up a mountain, but that's legends for you.{0012}
Well, I'll be! That ship really is the Otata! So it really existed!{0012}
Wh-what should we do?! With Kyoto like that, where can we run to?!{0012}
Ah, you're Manjimaru, aren't you? I came from Hida. I've heard all about you!{0012}
With the Dark Orchid roots west of Hida gone, the road over Fujiwara Pass is handy again, like it used to be!{0012}
Help us, Manjimaru! Only you can cut down that Dark Orchid!{0012}
They say this village's chief is so terribly sick he can't take a single step outside his house.{0012}
He's done me plenty of favors in business, so I went to visit, but they wouldn't let me see him. He must be in a bad way.{0012}
It seems the chief's gotten over his illness, so I'll have to ask him for some business favors again. He's a total pushover for women.{0012}

jp:
行商もこれで　けっこう　きついんや
何か買ってくれると　助かるわぁ？

pages.en: Peddling's tougher than it looks. Buy somethin', would ya?
The fate of Jipang now rests with you!{0012}
I'm counting on you, Manjimaru!{0012}
Manjimaru, it seems you are the key that will open Kinu's fate. Please, take good care of her.{0012}
Oho... so it's you...{0012}
No, no, it's nothing. Pay it no mind, Sir Manjimaru. But let me tell you just this much.{0012}
It's a little too early for you to come here. We shall meet again in time.{0012}
Oho... That purple hair... You must be Manjimaru!{0012}
Ho ho ho! So what Kinu said was true!{0012}
I know why you've come.{0012}
Now, give these prayer beads to Kinu.{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０卍丸は　純潔の鎖を　手に入れた！

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Manjimaru got the Chains of Purity!{0011}{005D}
{000C}This is the family temple where Kinu's parents are laid to rest.{0012}
Kinu often comes to this temple to visit her parents' graves.{0012}
When she came last autumn, she said to me...{0012}
{000C}...that soon, a purple-haired boy named Manjimaru would come to this temple.{0012}
And that by then, I should make a chain of prayer beads to bind her arm, and give it to you when you came...{0012}
It seems that child has the gift of seeing what's to come.{0012}
She probably knows her own fate as well.{0012}

jp:
大事なものを　渡したいのじゃが
武具袋が　いっぱいのようじゃな{12}

pages.en: I have something important to give you, but your equipment bag seems to be full.{0012}
Lightning strikes all the time in the mountains across the river to the east. Rumor has it a Tengu's behind it.{0012}
The ghosts of a woman and a dog appear here, I tell you! I saw them, right there on those stone steps! When I tried to call out, they just vanished.{0012}

jp:
なにに　なさいます
おしながきを　ご覧になりまっか？

pages.en: What'll it be? Care to see the menu?

jp: {0C}また　どうぞ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Come again!{0012}
They say this temple has an ogre's grave. Because souls are all the same once you're dead... But you wouldn't want your grave lined up next to it, would you?{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! When you buy gear, what do you buy first? A sword, I suppose?{0012}
For us ninja, footwear comes first! It visibly helps both attack and defense, and above all, it's cheap!{0012}
Besides, for weaklings like us, whether we can break away from a fight is a matter of life and death.{0012}

jp:
いらっしゃいませー！
何か　ご入り用ですか？

pages.en: Welcome! Anything you need?

jp:
{0C}ありがとうございましたー！
道中　お気をつけてー！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you very much! Safe travels!{0012}
I hear there's an old hermitage if you head east, but whose it is, I couldn't tell you...{0012}
Head way east from here and there's a village called Maze, famous for its waterwheels. Know it?{0012}

jp: 山城村

pages.en: Yamashiro Village
Manjimaru! Weren't there supposed to be seven Dark Orchids?! Why?! Why is an eighth one blooming?!{0012}
Kyoto Province got surrounded by Dark Orchid roots, so fewer pilgrims have been coming to Kyoto...{0012}
...but now the roots toward Ise are gone, so the traffic'll pick up again!{0012}
You've used up all seven swords that can cut a Dark Orchid, haven't you?!{0012}
Then there's no way left to cut down the one in Kyoto?{0012}
Hello, small boy!{0012}
The people of Kyoto seem at ease because no Dark Orchid blooms in this province, but that's a big mistake.{0012}
In the provinces surrounding Kyoto, the Root Clan is spreading its power fast.{0012}
In fact, I hear something serious is happening at Lake Biwa, the largest lake in Jipang, in Omi Province north of Kyoto.{0012}
There's no telling when the Root Clan might come pouring into Kyoto too.{0012}
You... you smell of blood. Looks like you've cut down a good many Root Clan to get this far.{0012}
But someday, you'll lose... When that happens, come to this old granny. I'll treat you right.{0012}
Well, I suppose there are times a man has to stand his ground. But there's no glory in dying, you know.{0012}
The shops in Kyoto change their goods every season.{0012}
I want a spring kimono. I wish spring would hurry up and come!{0012}
Damn it, damn it! If only I were bigger, I'd beat the Root Clan myself!{0012}
Waah... My big sister was going to see Kyoto at New Year's, and the Root Clan attacked her...{0012}
Manjimaru, please avenge my sister! Please!{0012}
My big sister only cares about looking pretty. Girls her age are so innocent and cute.{0012}

jp:
{0C}京都は　何でも　{k}バカ高{h}いから
{k}ウチ{h}で　買ってくほうが　いいですよ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Everything in Kyoto costs a fortune, so you're better off buying here!{0012}
I thought the Root Clan was gone, but they'd been storing up this much power...{0012}
When you buy things, don't let the price fool you... If you're unsure, save first, then buy.{0012}

jp:
仏様　どうか　京を　お救いくだされ
なんまんだぶ　なんまんだぶ！{12}

pages.en: Blessed Buddha, please save Kyoto! Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu!{0012}
If you're going to Kyoto, leave this village, head west, then north... Ah, what a bother!{0012}
Forget the details and open your map! There should be a big square near the top left. That's Kyoto! It's huge!{0012}
Kyoto's gone?! That's a lie! Right?! Tell me it's a lie!{0012}
They say the Root Clan's running wild in the provinces around Kyoto. Terrible business.{0012}
But here in Kyoto Province, no Dark Orchid blooms, and the Root Clan hardly ever shows up.{0012}
It's all thanks to the protection of Kyoto's temples. I'm truly glad I live in Kyoto Province!{0012}
A band of five odd-looking merchants came to Kyoto. Called themselves the Something-or-other Brothers.{0012}
Hey, welcome!{0012}
It's {001E} Ryo a night! You're staying, right?

jp: 宿泊と記録だな｜

pages.en: Stay and save, then!

jp: 宿代もねぇのかよ！

pages.en: You haven't even got money for a room?!{0012}

jp: よーし｜　{k}ガーガー{h}と寝ちまえ｜{12}

pages.en: All right! Go snore your head off!{0012}

jp: 泊るだけで　いいんだな！

pages.en: Just the stay, then!

jp:
宿代もねぇのかよ！
そこいらで　野宿でもするんだな{12}

pages.en: You haven't even got money for a room?! Guess you'll be sleeping rough out there.{0012}

jp:
夜ふかしは　体に毒だぜ｜
とっとと　寝ちまえ｜{12}

pages.en: Staying up late's bad for you! Get to bed already!{0012}

jp:
記録だけなら　{k}タダ{h}だと思いやがって…
記録するぞ！

pages.en: Think saving's free, do ya... Fine, I'll record it!

jp: 今度は　ちゃんと　泊れよな！{12}

pages.en: Next time, stay the night properly!{0012}

jp:
犬死にすんなよ！　卍丸｜
とりあえず　応援してっからな｜{12}

pages.en: Don't go dying for nothing, Manjimaru! I'm rooting for you, anyway!{0012}

jp: 今日は　持ち合わせがないようですね{12}

pages.en: {000C}It seems you're a bit short today.{0012}
You must be Lord Manjimaru! We've heard all about you!{0012}
Please stay the night in our village.

jp: 宿泊と記録で　ござるな？

pages.en: Stay and save, then?

jp:
確かに記録したでござる
安心して　お体をお休めください{12}
宿泊だけで　ござるな？

pages.en: Just the stay, then?

jp: では　お体をお休めください{12}

pages.en: Then please rest well.{0012}

jp: 記録だけで　ござるな？

pages.en: Just saving, then?

jp:
また　いつでも　お立ち寄りくだされ
お待ちしておりますぞ！{12}

pages.en: Do stop by again anytime! We'll be waiting for you!{0012}
The Root Clan grows stronger by the day, it seems. Lord Manjimaru, please take the greatest care!{0012}

jp:
卍丸様｜
なにとぞ　三太夫様のかたきを｜{12}
こよいは　この里でお泊りになり
明日の鋭気を　養ってくだされ｜

pages.en: Lord Manjimaru! I beg you, avenge the Sandayu!{0012}
Stay the night in our village and gather your strength for tomorrow!

jp:
必ずや　根の一族を倒し
{k}ヨミ{h}を打ち破ってくだされ｜{12}

pages.en: Defeat the Root Clan and crush Yomi, without fail!{0012}
So that the Sandayu's deaths will not be in vain, bring peace to Jipang with your own hands, Lord Manjimaru, as soon as you can!{0012}
One lottery ticket, endless dreams! 10,000 ryo could be yours!{0012}
Tickets are limited, so if you want one, hurry to our shrine! Winners will be announced on New Year's Day!{0012}
Kyoto is the holy land where all the gods of Jipang gather.{0012}
If you pray here, any wish at all will come true!{0012}
A good man... a good man... Good looks, fame, a life of luxury... Tall, owns land, life insurance...{0012}
It's no exaggeration to say the head temples and shrines of all Jipang are gathered here!{0012}
It's the face of Jipang's soul, you might say! Beautiful! Nothing like the shrines and temples back in your sticks, eh?{0012}
I've come to this temple to pray for the Root Clan to be quelled! This temple works best of all!{0012}
...Mind you, if you skimp on the offering, the Buddha will see right through you.{0012}
Did you buy a lottery ticket, dear?{0012}
The drawing's at New Year's. I do hope you win.{0012}
Tch! Hell's bells! I came all the way from a faraway village to buy a lottery ticket, and they're already sold out?!{0012}
I came here dead set on winning that 10,000-ryo first prize! With 10,000 ryo, the whole world changes!{0012}
Before all the gods and Buddhas of this capital, not even a Dark Orchid would dare show itself!{0012}
Kyoto is a land beloved by the gods and Buddhas! Even if Jipang falls, Kyoto is eternal! Waha! Waha!{0012}
Ahh, Kyoto is nice. So peaceful and soothing. And good dentists too.{0012}
Here, the Root Clan, the Dark Orchid, even my cavities all seem like a passing dream.{0012}
This is the center of all the temples and shrines in the land. For rumors in that line, this is the quickest place to hear 'em.{0012}
Lately everybody's saying Eiheiji in Echizen got hit by a Dark Orchid.{0012}
Don't let that old woman fool you. She's a plant for this temple. Lots of shills around here, so watch out.{0012}
Let me tell you something good! The shrine next door! Toss a thousand ryo or so in the offering box there, and you can't go wrong!{0012}
Why, if it isn't Manjimaru! I'm from Ise. Thank you for your help back then.{0012}
I got lost right away!{0012}
Truly, it's like an everlasting paradise! Nothing like my tiny little village!{0012}
Those flashy clothes, that flashy face! That's Kabuki behind you, isn't it? A pair of young girls were looking for him.{0012}
They said they had a present ready for Kabuki. I saw them over by the market a while ago.{0012}
From daily necessities to weapons, we've got every kind of shop! Do your shopping here!{0012}
We let dogs roam free to guard the goods from thieves, but they won't bark at customers, so don't worry.{0012}

jp: {k}キャン　キャン{12}

pages.en: Yip! Yip!{0012}

jp: {k}クーン　クーン{12}

pages.en: Whine... whine...{0012}

jp: {k}ペロ　ペロ{12}

pages.en: *lick lick*{0012}
Did you check out the shop you wanted? So much stuff, it's hard to choose, right?{0012}
But if you think this is all they'll ever stock, you're no Kyoto expert yet!{0012}
Kyoto shops change their goods every season. Drop in on them often.{0012}
Perfume... kimono... rings...{0012}
Oh, what should I buy?! Kyoto has so many lovely things, I can't make up my mind!{0012}

We'll give one to each of you...{0012}
Oh no! Eek! We had them all ready... but we can't give them unless you both have a free slot in your item bags ☆{0012}
They say five beautiful princesses once lived in Lord Ikeda's mansion here. The four eldest married into families in Kyoto...{0012}
...but the youngest, Princess Aya, was to be married off to the backwoods of Kanazawa, and was carried off by an ogre on the way, they say.{0012}
Rumor has it Princess Aya had a different mother from the other four, and was shunned for it. Well, that was twenty years ago.{0012}
That mansion there changed owners at some point, and the one who moved in is supposed to be a real beauty!{0012}
They say she's the daughter of some provincial merchant or samurai family... and get this! She came to Kyoto looking for a husband!{0012}
Hehehe, it's not every day us commoners get a shot at marrying rich! I'm going for it!{0012}
The old man here collects Golden Beetle Eggs, they say. He'll buy them for 10,000 ryo apiece!{0012}
I've heard you can get pure gold out of Golden Beetle Eggs. I wonder if any are lying around somewhere.{0012}
When I went to the market district just now, I saw a band of five with weird hairdos, kind of girly-looking.{0012}
All kinds of folks come to Kyoto, huh?{0012}
From a guy with purple hair to a guy with a flashy flag on his back... really, all kinds come.{0012}
That huge building at the back of the city is the Tycoon's residence. They call it the Flower Palace.{0012}
Built a thing like that with our hard-earned taxes, just for his own vanity! It makes my guts boil!{0012}
Whoa there, mister! First time in Kyoto? Then let me fill you in!{0012}
Kyoto's split into four districts! This here's the district where people's homes are.{0012}
Then there's the district full of temples and shrines, the district where the shops line up, and the district where the poor folk live.{0012}
And then there's the Tycoon's Flower Palace. All of it lumped together makes up the capital called Kyoto!{0012}
My, my, wearing such a dusty kimono! You must have come from some faraway village.{0012}
Kyoto has ever so many stylish kimonos. Why not buy one as a keepsake?{0012}
You look like you're fresh from the country, so I'll let you in on something: Kyoto shops...{0012}
...rip you off! Especially when you buy something pricey, compare with other towns first.{0012}
Well, well. What brings you to these slums?{0012}
The city folk loathe us and won't come near. You're an odd one.{0012}
This is where the drifters wash up: folks who've thrown away their work and homes and cut ties with the world.{0012}
Life is poor, but everyone lives as they please.{0012}
Hey, a newcomer? Looks like we'll get along! Nice to meet you!{0012}
But to live here, you don't need swords or fine clothes. First thing you need is health and guts!{0012}
Sitting around the fire with friends, shooting the breeze... that's when I'm happiest.{0012}
Come, come. If your heart is cold, warm yourself up here!{0012}
The hottest topic right now has got to be the Dark Orchid that bloomed in Echizen!{0012}
A huge one shot up right over Eiheiji in Fukui Village, and the whole province is in an uproar, they say!{0012}
The elders here are all fired up about becoming your strategists, mister, and they're gathering information.{0012}
It's old folks' doing, so I doubt you'll hear anything big, but show your face now and then, will you?{0012}
They seem pretty serious about it, and just meeting you will give them a story to take to the grave.{0012}
A foreigner called Hoteimaru is staying with the elders.{0012}
I hear he's looking for the Heroes of Fire. Isn't that you folks? He's under the bridge! Why not take a look?{0012}
The city folk are all cold-hearted! They look at us like we're filth!{0012}
They figure as long as Kyoto's at peace, the other provinces don't matter! Heaven's gonna punish them one of these days!{0012}
If everyone could do what they love and live just as they please, that'd be the greatest happiness.{0012}
That's why we hate the Root Clan, who bind people with fear!{0012}
We'll lend you our strength! You live free too. You and us, we've got something in common!{0012}
You must not think of death as misfortune.{0012}
Life is, after all, suffering.{0012}
And death is a longing for the Pure Land.{0012}
Fight without fear of death.{0012}
The Buddha will surely lead you to paradise in the Pure Land.{0012}
Just to be clear, it won't work with another temple's Buddha.{0012}
The priest's teachings are so uplifting! I was tired of life, but now I feel the will to live again!{0012}
You must be the honored Fire Clan who saved Ise Shrine!{0012}
Just as I imagined... bulging with muscles... er, not really... with a strong sense of justice... er, not that either...{0012}
...It must be this! Our prayers reached the heavens, and the gods lent you their strength!{0012}
Ever since the rumor spread that what the Tycoon was digging up Hakusan to find was the Otata...{0012}
...every temple and shrine around, smelling publicity, has been claiming "Our god made it!" or "Our Buddha rode in it!"...{0012}
As a man of the cloth, I find it simply deplorable... Let me tell you honored Fire Clan the real truth!{0012}
The Otata is, of course, a holy ship made by OUR god. No, really, I mean it!{0012}
Those who believe shall be saved!{0012}
Sorry, the lottery tickets are sold out. Too bad. You look lucky, too. You might've won the 10,000-ryo first prize!{0012}
In Omi Province, north of Kyoto, there's a holy mountain called Hakusan, where a ship called the Otata is enshrined.{0012}
The god of this shrine rode that ship all over Jipang, you know. All over Jipang, the god of THIS shrine!{0012}
That Tycoon! What a sacrilegious thing to do!{0012}
That man dared to lay hands on our holy mountain, Hakusan! He dug it up and then sealed it off!{0012}
Hakusan is a pilgrimage site for the devout! Will that man not even permit the people their humble prayers?!{0012}
I wonder why the Tycoon sealed off Hakusan.{0012}
Is there something up there that mustn't be seen?{0012}
Being the Tycoon, someone close to him probably put him up to it.{0012}
In Omi Province is our temple's mountain, Hakusan, and there rests the Buddha's ship, the Otata.{0012}
I hear some evil curse has fallen on Lake Biwa. By all means, use the Otata!{0012}
No, no, no need to hold back. It's all the Buddha's guidance. Only...{0012}
...once you've safely crossed Lake Biwa, do announce to the world that you had our temple's help! Hahahaha!{0012}

{000C}I'm so happy, Lord Manjimaru! Why, it's a Tack Wrapping Cloth! I'll make it my treasure!{0012}
{000C}Oh, Lord Manjimaru... I'm head over heels for you...{0012}

pages.en: {000C}...please don't do anything to make me sad, Lord Manjimaru.{0012}

{000C}I'll wait for you, and only you, forever, Lord Manjimaru...
☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆{0012}
If you let my old man sweet-talk you into hunting for these Golden Beetle Eggs, that's your business, but...{0012}
...they say when those things hatch, something awful happens, so be ready for it.{0012}
Whatever happens, don't come barging in here yelling at me, okay?{0012}
You look like a traveler. If you ever find a Golden Beetle Egg, I'll buy it for 10,000 ryo, so keep it in mind.{0012}
Mind you, I mean the eggs! Once they're grown, they're worthless junk, so don't mix them up!{0012}

jp:
あんた　黄金虫の卵を
お持ちのようじゃな♀{12}
ひとつ　一万両で　引き取るが
売ってくれるじゃろ？

pages.en: Looks like you've got a Golden Beetle Egg!{0012}
I'll take each one for 10,000 ryo. You'll sell, won't you?
{000C}Much obliged! If you find more, bring them to me!{0012}
{000C}Manjimaru got {001E} Ryo.{0012}
{000C}I see. Too bad! Take a little stroll around, and you might lose your mind... I mean, change your mind!{0012}
Sigh... Is Aya still alive, I wonder? If only I hadn't let those around me talk me into marrying her off to Kanazawa...{0012}
...that ogre would never have stolen Aya on the way there... I still regret it every time I remember...{0012}
This year, the Tycoon suddenly sent a force to Mt. Oe to subdue the ogre, and so...{0012}
...my master keeps remembering Princess Aya, stolen by the ogre twenty years ago, and spends every day sighing...{0012}
The Tycoon sent a punitive force to Mt. Oe, but not a word has come of it since. What became of them?{0012}
Dark Orchid roots have appeared north of Kyoto, so perhaps they simply can't get back. Or else...{0012}
No matter how many skilled samurai they gathered, I suppose they were no match for Shuten-doji after all.{0012}
Lots of folks are fleeing to relatives in Kyoto from the provinces, saying it's safe because the gods and Buddhas protect it.{0012}
Thanks to that, the dialects are all mixed up, and our beautiful Kyoto speech is going all to pieces, y'all, don'tcha know, reckon!{0012}
The Tycoon went to Takayama to see the festival and never came back. Whatever happened to him?!{0012}
And his precious Flower Palace reeks of something fishy...{0012}
How is the Tycoon's daughter, Princess Katsura, getting along all alone in the Flower Palace? I'm worried.{0012}
The Tycoon is the younger brother of the Shogun in Edo, who rules the eastern half of Jipang.{0012}
That's how he got to govern the western half of Jipang.{0012}
But that's not enough for him, it seems. He hasn't got it in him, yet he wants to rule all of Jipang alone.{0012}
Dangerous... When someone with no ability and twice the ambition takes power, that's what brings a land to ruin.{0012}
We fled here from Echizen. It happened just as we'd crossed into Omi Province.{0012}
The border got blocked by Dark Orchid roots, and they say the Root Clan put a spell on Lake Biwa, so the waterway's no good either.{0012}
I've made my peace with maybe never going home again. Know of any good jobs?{0012}
Ooh, so you're a Hero of Fire? There's a legend about the Heroes of Fire in Echizen, where we used to live.{0012}
I'm young, though, so I don't know the details.{0012}

jp:
兄ちゃん　琵琶湖のほうへ
行くんなら　道　教えたるで

pages.en: Hey, mister, if you're headed for Lake Biwa, I'll tell you the way.
{000C}First, leave town and go south a little, then follow the river north through the forest to the northeast, all the way! Got it?{0012}
{000C}Here I am, kindly explaining things! A bumpkin acting like a know-it-all won't get far in this town!{0012}
Be a little more honest, mister.{0012}
Today the inn's garbage bins were full of guests' leftovers!{0012}
Dinner's sea bream heads stir-fried with napa cabbage cores! And there's one more thing, though it might be a little risky...{0012}
It's all about guts! Let's try the pufferfish innards too! Tonight's a feast!{0012}

jp:
わーい　わーい｜
ごちそうだ　ごちそうだー｜{12}

pages.en: Yay, yay! A feast! A feast!{0012}
Pufferfish innards, huh? Tonight takes some serious guts! It's all about guts! Gahahahaha!{0012}
You've probably noticed by now, but the folks living in Jipang are seriously unreliable.{0012}
So unless you make yourself a notebook and keep track of what people tell you, you'll lose track of what's what in no time.{0012}
Kyoto's the perfect example. Take it from me: hardly anything you hear here will be any use to you, except what I tell you.{0012}

jp:

聞いとるよ　伊勢や尾張での活躍！

pages.en: You're the Fire Clan, aren't you? We've heard about your deeds in Ise and Owari! Don't underestimate our network!{0012}
We want to help you too, as best we can, so we've been gathering information from all over the land.{0012}
How about it? Will you make us your strategists, Manjimaru?
{000C}Oh! You will! How wonderful! Now, as for strategy, first...{0012}
..."Listen to the old man next door!" Carry out this strategy!{0012}
{000C}What?! Boring! I could've given you the best strategy of anyone here!{0012}

jp:
おー　あんたが噂の　卍ちゃんかぇ
とりあえず　この{k}ババ{h}と　卍ちゃんの
初対面を　記念して　握手じゃ｜{12}
握手してくれるかの？

pages.en: Ooh, so you're the famous little Manji! First, to celebrate the first meeting of this old granny and little Manji, a handshake!{0012}
Will you shake my hand?
{000C}Mmm! A fine, manly hand, with hot blood running through it! Young skin really is something special.{0012}
Anyway, little Manji, the province you should head for next is Echizen, no doubt about it!{0012}
Thanks to the Dark Orchid roots, Jipang's roads are wrecked right now. But that province, you can reach by water!{0012}
That means Lake Biwa! Get a boat in Omi Province, sail north up Lake Biwa, and land at Kanazawa!{0012}
{000C}Young people these days are so unkind to the old. Ah, at this rate, this land has no future.{0012}
My name is Julie of Kawaramachi!{0012}
...Mind you, I doubt anyone outside Kyoto gets the joke in that name, but I just wanted to say it!{0012}
Now, Sir Manjimaru! According to our information, the Tycoon was digging up Hakusan, searching for something.{0012}
Well, the Tycoon himself disappeared before they found it, so it seems the search has been called off.{0012}
But it seems the Root Clan is still inside Hakusan, stubbornly searching for something.{0012}
The Freemen Guild promise you ALL ZIPANGU INFORMATION SERVICE, yes!{0012}
Please you drop by sometime! I sure I can give you very much useful help, yes yes!{0012}
The Tycoon sealed off Hakusan. They say the Root's Three Doctors put him up to it. What are they doing in a place like that?{0012}
That's a hairstyle with real guts! I haven't washed my hair in about two months, but you've got me beat!{0012}
Look close and your hair's even changed color! Man, I could never go that far. Doesn't it itch?{0012}
Ah... ah... ACHOO!{0012}

pages.en: Winning numbers: First prize, 34{0012}
If you hold a winning ticket, see the lottery attendant at our shrine. Redeem by the end of April.{0012}
By the shore of Lake Biwa, I met a most unusual gentleman... soaking wet, as if he'd swum across the lake...{0012}
"Miss! Do you know why I'm so wet?! It's because, miss... I am..."{0012}
"...a man so fine, I'm dripping with it! Gahahahahaha!" ...he said! He mentioned he was going to Maizuru Village.{0012}
Lost the lottery again this year! If you bought a ticket, they're announcing the winners at that shrine.{0012}
Well, don't get your hopes up, but go have a look. First prize was three-something, I think. Who could've won 10,000 ryo?{0012}
The children are having a calligraphy contest at the temple school. So very New Year's!{0012}
You had a year of growing up last year too, mister, or rather, all sorts of hardships nobody else would understand...{0012}
Not that I'm superstitious, but telling your fortune for the year with a fortune slip is a nice way to start the year.{0012}
Tch! Great Luck again?! Just because it's New Year's, this shrine's fortunes are all Great Luck...{0012}
Anybody who draws Great Misfortune has to be either super unlucky or super lucky, right? I'd like to see their face.{0012}
Maybe it's the Root Clan... Not many people came for the New Year's shrine visit this year.{0012}
Well, clinging to the gods now probably won't change a thing anyway...{0012}
I suppose Dark Orchids bloomed out San'in way too... We still can't get word from the provinces west of Kyoto...{0012}
This year, please work hard and do something for those provinces too! I'm rooting for you!{0012}

jp:
卍丸さんも　そこの宿に　初夢を
見に来なすったんで♀
火の勇者も　縁起をかつぐんですね{12}
やっぱ　卍丸さんも　若いし　男だから
あっち関係の夢を　ご所望でしょうね

pages.en: So you came to that inn for your first dream of the year too, Manjimaru? Even the Hero of Fire believes in luck, huh?{0012}
Well, you're young, and a man, so I bet you're hoping for a dream of THAT sort, eh?

jp: {0C}さすが｜　火の勇者だ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}That's the Hero of Fire for you!{0012}
Step right up, step right up! The whole year starts with your first dream!{0012}
Stay at our inn and dream a dream of perfect happiness! Right now, just 88 ryo!{0012}
Heard the rumor about that inn? They say every guest who stays there at New Year's has a first dream!{0012}
And they say the dream tells your fortune for the year. It's quite popular! Why not try staying there?{0012}
Lord Ikeda's daughter died, they say, right at New Year's. How sad...{0012}
Omiruuu! Where did you go, leaving me all alone?!{0012}
I'm gonna use my New Year's money to buy Omiru an amazing present too!{0012}
Then Omiru will be head over heels for me! After that, with my youthful charm, I'll have Omiru...{0012}
...squealing! Gehehehehe! How about that, mister? Jealous, right?{0012}
Here we are enjoying New Year's without a care, but out San'in way, I bet they've got no time for that.{0012}
I hear two Dark Orchids are blooming there... There must be a Root Clan castle too...{0012}
Teehee! I got a New Year's card from Kabuki...{0012}
It said, "I'll chop down Izumo's Dark Orchids and make the biggest bouquet in the world for you!"{0012}
He's getting a boat ready in Maizuru Village, up in Omi, to prepare! So dependable!{0012}
Ever since he heard about Lady Aya, Lord Ikeda has been confined to his bed, they say. Poor man...{0012}
Those creeps called the Ashimoto Brothers are waiting at the inn, wanting to give you their New Year's greetings, Manjimaru.{0012}
But maybe you'd better not go. Seeing that lot right at the start of the year will ruin your luck.{0012}
We only hear rumors of the samurai who supposedly wiped out the ogres of Mt. Oe. No one knows what became of them.{0012}
If it were me, I'd march back to Kyoto in triumph first thing. Where could they have gone into hiding?{0012}
Hey, you're Manjimaru? I've heard all about your deeds in the Koshi provinces!{0012}
If you'd joined that do-or-die squad at Mt. Oe, maybe Lord Ikeda's Princess Aya could've been saved too... Too bad.{0012}
I didn't know, but one of the daughters of that mansion was carried off by an ogre twenty years ago, they say.{0012}
And after twenty years, the ogre who took her has been slain, they say, but the daughter...{0012}
Lord Ikeda is an unlucky man... The ogres of Mt. Oe were beaten at last, only for Princess Aya to die...{0012}
They say the Tycoon sent ogre-slaying experts to Mt. Oe about six months ago...{0012}
Anyway, the ogre slaying itself succeeded, they say...{0012}
Well, I can say it now, but Princess Aya, Lord Ikeda's youngest, the one who took Shuten down with her...{0012}
...actually had a different mother from the other daughters... Princess Aya's mother was originally just a shrine maiden...{0012}
...but she had tremendous powers of foresight, and Lord Ikeda took a liking to her, they say.{0012}

jp:
正月早々　葬式を出さねば　ならんとは
池田様んとこも　運がねぇな{12}

pages.en: Having to hold a funeral right at New Year's... Lord Ikeda's family sure has no luck.{0012}
Well, well, what brings you to these slums... Why, if it isn't Manjimaru!{0012}
The elders have been looking forward to your visit! Hurry on over!{0012}
Well, if it isn't Manjimaru! When did you get back? Say, how was Koshi?{0012}
Same as ever here. Only thing that's changed is the Dark Orchid roots up north are gone.{0012}
Thanks to that, I can go out west of Lake Biwa to earn a living now.{0012}
Why, it's Manjimaru! I've heard all about your deeds in the Koshi provinces! In the short time you were gone, you've become so...{0012}
...grown-up, I was gonna say, but two or three months isn't gonna change anybody! Gahahahahahaha!{0012}
Lord Ikeda's Lady Aya, was it? Such a pity... Just when she was finally going to see her family again...{0012}
They say she took Shuten-doji down with her. That's the Fire Clan for you! Huh?! You didn't know?!{0012}
Lady Aya was Fire Clan, same as you folks! Everybody around here knows it!{0012}
It must've been about twenty years ago...{0012}
...when Lord Ikeda's youngest daughter was carried off by an ogre on her way to be married. It caused quite a stir back then.{0012}
About that business at Lord Ikeda's... Something smells fishy. Why now, of all times?{0012}
I don't think it's the kind of thing the Tycoon would dig up again now and send troops over.{0012}
Sorry to Lord Ikeda, but it's just one woman, right? Would they really go all that way? There's something behind it!{0012}
Happy Noo Yeah! Old Hoteimaru says I've got the best pronunciation of anybody!{0012}
There's an inn in the market that sells New Year's dreams. They say it rips you off for 88 ryo just for one night!{0012}
I've never seen a fortune like 88 ryo in my whole life, but dreams? I've got enough to sell!{0012}
Eating white rice! Eating sea bream! Eating dumplings! Eating rice cakes! That's my dream, roughly!{0012}
I hear Dark Orchids are blooming out San'in way too.{0012}
And on top of that, they say the Root Clan buried Inaba Province in sand... What's going to happen...{0012}
Right after the New Year holidays, we're holding the funeral for Lord Ikeda's daughter.{0012}
Ah, Manjimaru! Someone called Hoteimaru was looking for you over in the slums.{0012}

一回　十両で　おみくじは　いかが？

pages.en: "New Year's, a time to try your luck," as the song goes! How about a fortune slip for 10 Ryo?

jp: {0C}よく　当たるのに…{12}

pages.en: {000C}And they're so accurate, too...{0012}
{000C}If you haven't even got 10 Ryo, you don't need a fortune slip to know your future!{0012}

jp:
{0C}あら　やめるの？
度胸がないわね！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Oh, backing out? No nerve at all!{0012}
{000C}The fortunes are written in hard words you probably won't understand, but don't worry, they don't mean anything.{0012}
The fortune I drew was Small Luck. Great Luck always sounds kind of fake, but Small Luck is so plain, I can believe it.{0012}

jp:

当りくじを　お持ちですか？

pages.en: Lottery prizes are paid out here. Do you have a winning ticket?

jp:
{0C}残念ね！
来年こそ　きっと　当たるわよ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Too bad! I'm sure you'll win next year!{0012}
{000C}Oh my, two winning tickets! Amazing! Here's your prize money: 10,008 ryo!{0012}

jp:
{0C}使い方に　困ったら　いつでも
相談に乗ってあげるわよ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}If you can't decide how to spend it, come talk to me anytime!{0012}

jp: {0C}はい　賞金の　８両よ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Here's your prize money: 8 ryo!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０卍丸は　８両　手に入れた！

pages.en: {000C}Here's your prize money: 10,000 ryo!{0012}
{000C}This money is a gift from the gods, so think hard before you spend it!{0012}
{000C}Your prize money is 100,000,000 ryooo!{0012}
...Just kidding. Now, now, don't tease the grown-ups.{0012}
It's in times like these that people should pray to the gods, yet the crowds just won't come.{0012}
I was counting on raking in the offerings... Is this another harsh trial the gods have given me?{0012}
Oh gods... I'm finished! Rice... wheat... beans... salt...{0012}
Most years, I'd pour the offerings into the New Year market rally, and by now I'd be living it up in the pleasure quarter...{0012}
Namu namu namu... This year, please let all the other temples and shrines perish, and let this temple prosper!{0012}
The monks in the back are holding some important prayer. Don't go bothering them by talking to them.{0012}
Today the children are doing their first calligraphy of the New Year. Please, take a look!{0012}
Hey, hey, look at my calligraphy! The theme is "Happy New Year," of course! Ain't it cheery!{0012}
Oh, Manjimaru! The New Year's wish I wrote in my calligraphy has already come true!{0012}
I wrote: "This year I'll meet Manjimaru...{0012}
...and he'll be so taken with my charms that he'll give me five million ryo, just like that!"{0012}
I wanted to do a cool New Year's greeting in English, but...{0012}
...is it "Happy Birthday"?{0012}
Kinga shinnen... kinga shinnen... What were the characters again?{0012}
Ah, I remember! "Gold Is Faith"! That's got to be it!{0012}
Here's my calligraphy!{0012}
"None shall stand in my way!" That's how a man should be!{0012}
No matter how meaningful your fortune slip sounds, don't let it bother you.{0012}
After all, the shrine maiden who sells them just scribbled the words down the night before.{0012}
Teehee! I struck it big on the market! Giving lots of offerings at the shrine really paid off!{0012}
What a rotten mood! A dream's a dream, no matter where you dream it, right?!{0012}
Just so you know, I'm not staying at this inn because I can't afford 88 ryo! Got that?!{0012}
Want to hear the first dream of the year that loud guy next door had? Don't laugh!{0012}
He dreamed he was staying at the other inn! How pathetic is that...{0012}
I came from Kameoka Village. The Dark Orchid roots north of Kyoto are gone, so I could come.{0012}
On the way, at Lake Biwa, I saw a really lively gentleman. Swimming, in this cold...{0012}
When he spotted me, he waved a red flagpole around and flashed me his best smile.{0012}
I dreamed Kyoto was dyed bright red! It must be the sunrise! A sign of Kyoto's glory, surely!{0012}
I dreamed of Susanoo slaying the eight-headed Orochi! A brave dream right at New Year's, that's lucky, right?{0012}
Only, I woke up right after he cut off the seventh head! I'm going back to dream the rest now!{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３０おやっ！　卍の大将｜

{000C}Lord Hoteimaru has headed for Naniwa too. As fast as you are, little Manji, you'll surely catch up to him on the way.{0012}
My name is Julie of Kawaramachi!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, I'm glad to see you looking so well. Today, let me tell you an old tale of Tanba.{0012}
Long ago, Tanba had villages and towns to rival any other province. But one day...{0012}
{000C}...two giants held sumo bout after sumo bout in Tanba Province.{0012}
And so every village and town in Tanba Province was crushed flat, they say.{0012}
In the end, neither won... The two giants fell wounded, and turned into mountains just as they lay.{0012}
Well? Funny old tale, eh? Still, if it's true, what a nuisance for everyone!{0012}
The other day Hoteimaru gave me a ride in Steel Castle! Landing right in the middle of Kyoto in that thing feels great!{0012}
I overheard something. Seems some guy named Pepe is after you.{0012}
But with a name like Pepe, he doesn't sound very tough. Well, he's after you, apparently, so...{0012}
Tanba Province is a whole lot of nothing! There's just one village way down south, and the rest is all mountains!{0012}
If you're not real careful, you'll use up all your strength on the way and collapse by the roadside.{0012}
{000C}So you've finally dragged me all the way to a place like this. Manjimaru, you're one hell of a guy!{0012}
{000C}Yomi, huh... must be strong... Getting this far was rough enough, so it'll be even stronger...{0012}

jp:
{0C}{10}１３１けど　わしも男だ｜
{11}５０どこまでも　{10}１３２つき合ってやるぜ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}But I'm a man too! I'll stick with you all the way!{0012}

pages.en: {000C}My life is in your hands!{0012}
{000C}If we join forces, we'll manage somehow! No! We HAVE to manage!{0012}
{000C}I'm counting on you, Manjimaru! Use your Holy Sword to give the Root Clan their final send-off!!!{0012}

Hey, Manjimaru! There's just one thing I'm sooo disappointed about!{0012}
We're about to beat the Root boss and have our big finale, and there's no audience!{0012}
Being a Hero of Fire is such a thankless role! Maybe I'll just go home...{0012}
Just kidding! I was trying to ease everybody's nerves. Thoughtful of me, huh?{0012}

jp:
{10}１３１{0C}さあ　行く{k}ゼ｜　{11}３０卍丸｜
{11}４０{h}どんな手を使っても　勝とう{k}ゼ｜{12}

pages.en: Now let's go, Manjimaru! Let's win, whatever it takes!{0012}

jp: {10}１３２{0C}どーせ　{10}１３１誰も　見てねぇんだからよ{12}

pages.en: Nobody's watching anyway!{0012}
Manjimaru... I can feel it... A terribly evil power...{0012}
Yomi is there. Waiting beyond this door...{0012}
But strangely, I'm not afraid at all. It must be because you're with me, Manjimaru.{0012}
You've always fought great enemies, Manjimaru. And every time, you've shown us a miracle.{0012}
This time will be no different! I believe in you!{0012}
Ah, so you are Sir Manjimaru of the Fire Clan... It is too late to undo it now, but... please, forgive the Tycoon.{0012}
The Tycoon was deceived! Look at us, in this wretched state... We are miserable hostages.{0012}
The others were carried off somewhere. If only Princess Katsura, who escaped, is safe...{0012}
Ah, so you are Sir Manjimaru of the Fire Clan... Go to Hakusan! It is the only way to open the road! I believe...{0012}
...the permit to enter Hakusan is in the treasury inside this palace... but Princess Katsura took the key with her when she fled...{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I believe Princess Katsura is still hiding somewhere inside this palace!{0012}
Please, find Princess Katsura! And if you can, save her! I beg you!{0012}

pages.en: Understood?! It's the flowerbed next to the bedchamber! Now, off you go! You needn't worry about me!{0012}
I am not like my father! I rely on no one! I shall escape from here by my own strength alone!{0012}
Eeek! Have mercy!{0012}
Oh? You're not of the Root Clan?! I am Katsura, daughter of the Tycoon!{0012}
Have you come to rescue me?
{000C}I see! But I shall not thank you! I don't recall asking for any such thing!{0012}
Instead, I shall grant you a useful piece of knowledge! Search the flowerbed next to the bedchamber!{0012}

pages.en: {000C}We came into some unexpected money out Bando way, see...{0012}
{000C}...and a sly little crook named Jiraiya wouldn't stop tailing us, so we came over here to lie low.{0012}
{000C}Let's meet again somewhere! Let's each do our best for the justice we believe in! Boss Manji!{0012}
{000C}Hiii, Manjimaru! Nice to meet-o you! Me, Hoteimaru, missionary, yes!{0012}
{000C}Me so moved by you Fire Fighters' great work! Wonderful, yes!{0012}
{000C}Everybody here in Freemen Guild say you are GREAT, yes yes!{0012}
The Freemen Guild promise you ALL ZIPANGU INFORMATION SERVICE, yes!{0012}
Please you drop by sometime! I sure I can give you very much useful help, yes yes!{0012}

　西の夜久野峠から　どうぞ」{12}

"To green and lovely Inaba Province,
please go by Yakuno Pass to the west"{0012}

jp:
紫色の　小さな花がついた
暗黒{k}ラン{h}の根が　道をふさいでいる{12}

pages.en: Roots of the Dark Orchid, with small purple flowers, block the path.{0012}
{000C}Manjimaru! Kyoto! Me have idea to break the Root castle! Brilliant, yes!{0012}
{000C}Hurry, please get on! Leave it to Hoteimaru, yes!{0012}
No way! L-L-Lake Biwa's water... it's all gone!{0012}

jp:
京都が　暗黒{k}ラン{h}に
やられちまった｜{12}

pages.en: Kyoto's been wrecked by the Dark Orchid!{0012}
Lake Biwa's back the way it was! How about that? Isn't the blue lake beautiful?{0012}
Just like my heart!{0012}
Lake Biwa... Beautiful Lake Biwa has turned blood red!{0012}
It's a curse! It's gotta be the color of the vengeful blood of everyone the Root Clan killed!{0012}

jp: 琵琶湖の…　琵琶湖の…　水が…{12}

pages.en: Lake Biwa's... Lake Biwa's... water...{0012}
*Cough! Cough!* The Dark Orchid's stench is drifting all the way here! *Cough!*{0012}
At this rate... *cough!*... my body won't hold out... *cough! cough!*{0012}
Lake Biwa's water has turned blue again, but the dead fish won't come back.{0012}
War is a cruel thing. It wipes out even the creatures that have nothing to do with it.{0012}
Ever since Lake Biwa turned red, all the fish have died, and every boat that goes out sinks.{0012}
It's hell... just like the Lake of Blood in hell. The Root Clan means to turn Jipang into hell.{0012}

jp:
いったい　この{k}ジパング{h}は
どうなってしまうんだぁぁぁぁぁ｜{12}

pages.en: What on earth is going to become of Jipang?!{0012}
Kyoto at New Year's is lively and fun! People come from all over Jipang!{0012}
I want to party wild and forget about the Root Clan, even just for a while!{0012}
Cross Lake Biwa north and you're in Hokuriku, in Echizen! There's the huge Kanazawa Castle there too. It's a real fun place!{0012}
Want to give it a try? Risk your life crossing Lake Biwa?{0012}
You, I'd bet the fate of Jipang on! I believe in you, Sengoku Manjimaru!{0012}
It's hopeless...{0012}
If Kyoto got crushed that easily, we don't stand a chance anyway.{0012}

jp:
大{k}タタ{h}の船って　大昔の{k}ボロ船{h}だろ？
よく沈まずに　動いたなあ{12}

pages.en: The Otata's just some ancient wreck, right? Amazing it moved without sinking!{0012}
The sacred ship on Hakusan is called the Otata, and they say a god used to ride in it long ago.{0012}
My grandma told me that story over and over ever since I was little.{0012}

jp:
京都を血の海に変えた　狂人どもに
思いしらせて　やってください｜{12}

pages.en: Make those madmen who turned Kyoto into a sea of blood pay for it!{0012}
Huh? Is that Gokuraku Taro of the Fire Clan, the one who was in Echizen?!{0012}
Some folks badmouth him as just a fat glutton, but I really respect him, honest!{0012}
The only ones who can take on the Root Clan are those Fire Clan folks, right?!{0012}
They say there were Fire Clan folks in Echizen, so why won't they come out?! Useless bastards!{0012}

jp:
琵琶湖ってさ　赤くなったり
青くなったり　人の顔みたいだよね{12}

pages.en: Lake Biwa turns red, then blue... It's like a person's face, isn't it?{0012}
*sniff, sniff*...{0012}
There were lots of fish floating in Lake Biwa, so I brought some back and gave them to my cat, Kenta...{0012}
...and Kenta suffered and died...{0012}
Looking at your face, I just remembered something!{0012}
There's an old legend that a great capital lies sunk at the bottom of Lake Biwa.{0012}
The center of ancient Jipang, a city teeming with people at the height of its glory...{0012}
A great disaster struck it, and it sank into the lake, but they say it still keeps its shape under the water.{0012}
On the far shore of Lake Biwa, there's a cave called Saikyo Cave.{0012}
Funny name, eh? "Western Capital Cave," yet it's north of Kyoto!{0012}
This is it at last! Give it everything you've got and fight for this land! We're counting on you!{0012}
Lake Biwa is stirring... I've watched that lake for a long time, but I've never seen anything like this.{0012}
It's a stirring as if it's waiting for someone...{0012}
You rode the ship from Hakusan?!{0012}
They say that ship can only be steered by someone special, someone the gods have chosen.{0012}
It seems you folks are those special people.{0012}
Hakusan is a holy mountain, worshipped throughout this region.{0012}
Its sacred object is a revered ship the gods are said to have ridden.{0012}

jp:
きっと　勝ってね
きっと　生き残ってね　約束よ！{12}

pages.en: Win, okay? Make it out alive, okay? Promise!{0012}
Hey, hey! They say Genmu Castle has appeared in Echizen!{0012}
Huh? You already beat it?! Oh no, I'm so behind on the news!!{0012}
Go a little north of the village and there's Hakusan. They say the gods dwell on that mountain, but does the Root Clan show up there too?{0012}

jp:
預かり所に　ようこそ！
ご利用になりますか？

pages.en: Welcome to the storehouse! Will you be using our services?

jp:
いらはりませ！　武具屋でございます
ご利用くださいますか？

pages.en: Welcome! This is the armory. Can I help you?

jp:
はい！　いらっしゃいまし
何か道具が　ご入り用かな？

pages.en: Yes! Welcome! Need any items?

jp: {0C}また　来ておくんなはれ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Come again now!{0012}
Just now, some young fella with a flashy banner on his back swam across Lake Biwa in nothing but a loincloth!{0012}
He said, "I'll polish my manhood in Biwa's cold waters!" But swimming across Lake Biwa? What a reckless idiot.{0012}
He's probably drowned by now.{0012}
Looks like a Dark Orchid bloomed in Echizen too.{0012}
The other day I felt a big rumble, and then I saw a creepy flower writhing up from the direction of Echizen.{0012}
See? You can just make it out from here, right? What, you can't? Guess you're too short.{0012}

jp:
もう何も　言わないわ！
とにかく　がんばってね｜{12}

pages.en: I won't say another word! Anyway, good luck!{0012}
Have you seen Kyoto's Dark Orchid?! It's bigger than all the others, no comparison!{0012}
The hut in the middle of Lake Biwa seems to be under a strong seal. We can't get near it.{0012}
It seems only someone with special powers can get in.{0012}
There's a peculiar little hut standing in the middle of Lake Biwa.{0012}
Who on earth would build a hut in a lake that deep, and why? It's a mystery.{0012}
Hmmm... I see a great building sunk beneath the water.{0012}
Strangely enough, it seems to be resonating with you.{0012}
You want to know what it is, don't you? Hm. I don't know either.{0012}
Lake Biwa is sacred water, a mirror that shows the future of Jipang.{0012}
For Lake Biwa to turn crimson... something terrible is surely about to happen.{0012}
To get to the west side of Lake Biwa, you have to go back toward Kyoto first. It's so inconvenient for traveling!{0012}
I thought I'd visit Hakusan while I was in Kyoto, but the Tycoon sealed it off.{0012}
What does the Tycoon gain by closing that mountain, anyway? People in power are always so selfish.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! Please avenge my parents in my place! I'll do anything for that!{0012}

jp:
火の勇者の卍丸殿と　お見うけいたす
実は　この娘　根の者によって
身寄りを　失い　天涯孤独でござる{12}
ぶしつけながら　火の勇者殿に
この娘を　お預けしたいのでござる
もちろん　この娘も　承知の上！{12}
いかがでござる
ひきとって　いただけるかな？

pages.en: You must be Sir Manjimaru, Hero of Fire. The truth is, this girl lost her family to the Root and is all alone in the world.{0012}
Forgive my boldness, but I wish to entrust this girl to you, Hero of Fire. She has agreed to it, of course!{0012}
What say you? Will you take her in?

jp: 大津村

pages.en: Otsu Village
They say the roots blocking the road to Inaba belonged to Izumo's Dark Orchid.{0012}
It blooms so far away, yet its roots stretch all the way out here! What a tough flower!{0012}
The Dark Orchid has blocked Yakuno Pass, so we can't get to Inaba in the west.{0012}
There's no Dark Orchid in this province... but the roots keep spreading...{0012}
So does that mean... a Dark Orchid's blooming in Inaba?!{0012}
Tanba, south of Inaba, is all mountains. Not a place I care to go peddling.{0012}
Are you the Fire Clan, the ones they say are Mister Kabuki's underlings? That's what Mister Kabuki said when I went peddling in Maizuru.{0012}
Mister Kabuki? Seems he borrowed a boat in Maizuru to cross over to Inaba.{0012}
I hear the Tengu lives on the far side of the river that flows west. Have you been yet?{0012}
On windy days, sand and dust blow in from the direction of Inaba.{0012}
But Inaba is green, lush country. There shouldn't be any sand. How strange.{0012}
Good thing those Dark Orchid roots disappeared. But who knows when they'll sprout up again.{0012}
I'll stay inside the village for a while.{0012}
Just as I got back from hunting in Inaba, the Dark Orchid roots came sprouting up!{0012}
Like a giant snake rearing its head, smashing through the ground and racing along like crazy!{0012}
Oh! You crossed to Inaba and cut down the Dark Orchid!{0012}
That's the Hero of Fire for you! A thousand of us together couldn't come close!{0012}
So you are the Fire Clan, the righteous warriors subduing the Root Clan across the provinces.{0012}
But I fear your valiant campaign ends here. There's no road to Inaba, sad to say.{0012}
Unless you can borrow a boat in Maizuru to the north, but in times like these, would any fisherman put out to sea...{0012}

jp:
お客さん！　何かお捜し？
うちなら　だいたい　何でもそろうわよ

pages.en: Customer! Looking for something? We've got just about everything!

jp:
{0C}ありがとうございました！
また　ごひいきに{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you kindly! Come again!{0012}

jp: {0C}間違いのない　品ばかりなんやけどね{12}

pages.en: {000C}And everything's guaranteed good, too...{0012}
Hey! You! Kabuki! Get lost! Stay away from my mom!{0012}
Huh? Kabuki? That fool! He went north.{0012}
That skirt-chasing creep even tried to sweet-talk my wife, so I dumped a bucket of manure on him and ran him off!{0012}
Mister Kabuki... I'm glad you feel that way, but I'm still another man's wife. It's a love that can never be, y'know.{0012}
Oh, stop it, Mister Kabuki! "Love, only for you..." So corny! It's embarrassin', y'know!{0012}
Mister Kabuki went off north to Maizuru Village, but I wish he'd come back again.{0012}

jp: 亀岡村

pages.en: Kameoka Village
Oh! You must be the Fire Clan, the idols of all us martial artists!{0012}
Then have you met the old man of Shigaraki? They say he owns a scroll with a tremendous technique.{0012}
They say he's bedridden with a grave illness... Why not have him pass that technique on to you? It would be for the good of Jipang.{0012}

jp:
ああ　早く　根の一族が
この世から　いなくなってほしいわ{12}

pages.en: Ahh, I wish the Root Clan would vanish from this world soon.{0012}
They say a Tengu somewhere in Omi Province has a scroll called Breath of Life that restores lots of strength.{0012}

jp:
お旅にんさん　わしの手作りの団子の
他にも　いろいろあるが　どうじゃな？

pages.en: Traveler, besides my homemade dumplings, I've got all sorts of things. What'll it be?

jp:
{0C}わしの手作りの団子は　ほっぺたが
落ちるほど　うまいぞよ{12}

pages.en: My homemade dumplings are so good, your cheeks'll fall off!{0012}
{000C}Oh, come on! My homemade dumplings are so good, your cheeks'll fall off!{0012}
Mister Kabuki... Hurry and beat the Root Clan and come back to me.{0012}
Ahh, Mister Kabuki...{0012}
"Once I beat the Root Clan, I'll come back to you," he said...{0012}
I'll wait for you forever...{0012}
They shay Inaba had a big shandbox called the Desert! I wanted to dig tunnelsh and play in it!{0012}
A mishter in a flashy kimono came by a while ago! Said hish name wash Mishter Tabuki!{0012}
He wash talking to my big shishter really hard. Ish he shomeone you know?{0012}
We've heard of the Fire Clan's exploits! Mowing down hordes of monsters, smashing castles, moving islands!{0012}
Are you folks even human?{0012}
They say somewhere there's a mountain called Mt. Oe where ogres live.{0012}
Just ogres showing up is enough to make us live in fear, and now it's the Root Clan too?!{0012}
Ohh, I'm getting a headache!{0012}
Ahh, my Lord Kabuki... Please defeat the Root Clan as soon as you can. I'll be waiting for you always.{0012}
You lot better help Lord Kabuki properly too! Got it?!{0012}
Ahh, Lord Kabuki has gone... May he defeat the Root Clan soon and come back to me...{0012}
You pray for it too!{0012}
This was a good while back, but I saw a band of samurai chasing some badly wounded ogres off toward the northern cape.{0012}
Killed by those samurai, or threw themselves into the sea... either way, the ogres must all be dead.{0012}
Come to think of it, the samurai's leader was a woman. Us men could never be that thorough or that cruel...{0012}

jp:
大丈夫じゃ｜　おのれを信じて
がんばりなされ｜{12}

pages.en: You'll be fine! Believe in yourself and do your best!{0012}
Oho, so that's the girl... Kinu, is it? A fine name! Live strong, now!{0012}
So you're the famous Fire Clan, eh? Mister Kabuki's companions!{0012}
I've got no more boats to lend, but instead, let me tell you something useful!{0012}
Shuten-doji's child, born to a Fire Clan woman, is still alive on Mt. Oe, all alone, they say.{0012}
There's a village called Ayabe at the foot of Mt. Oe. The Aya in Ayabe comes from Princess Aya's name, they say.{0012}
I've been there a few times, and the villagers and ogres seemed to get along pretty well.{0012}
Shuten-doji and Princess Aya looked like a happy couple to me. They had a cute daughter, too.{0012}
They say a Tengu lives on the peninsula way, way, way off to the east.{0012}
Honestly, that daughter of mine! Mooning over some no-good drifter named Kabuki!{0012}
That man swindled away the one and only ship in the whole village, our pride and joy! I can't face the villagers...{0012}
Dad and the village men are just jealous of Mister Kabuki.{0012}
He said he needs a ship to save the people of Inaba Province from the Root lot, so of course we should help. It's only human!{0012}
So I don't think my daughter did anything wrong! ...But I wish he'd have come to me instead.{0012}
I hate to say this to you, Manjimaru, just back from a defeat, but...{0012}
...try not to drag my Lord Kabuki down, okay?{0012}

jp: 舞鶴村

pages.en: Maizuru Village
They say the daughter of a Kyoto noble carried off by Shuten-doji of Mt. Oe had Fire Clan blood.{0012}
That's the Fire Clan for you! A woman, and she took Shuten-doji down with her! A splendid end, they say.{0012}
I heard it from the samurai who went to Mt. Oe to slay the ogres, so I think it's true.{0012}
And rumor has it that bastard Shuten-doji got Princess Aya, the woman he carried off, pregnant...{0012}
If that child's still alive, it's a tragedy. Father and mother killed each other, and on top of it, the kid's half ogre...{0012}
I couldn't go on living... Even if I did, there'd be nothing to enjoy.{0012}
You're Heroes of Fire, just like Lord Kabuki! If you're ever badly hurt, please come by without a second thought.{0012}
Thank you, mister! When I get to your house, I wonder if I'll make friends with the village folks right away. I'm worried...{0012}

jp:
ねぇ　卍のお兄ちゃん…
人は死んだら　どこに行くのかしら？{12}

pages.en: Hey, Manji mister... where do people go when they die?{0012}

jp:
だんな！　何でも揃ってますよ！
とりあえず　品を見てってくださいよ
