驚くなよ……{12}

pages.en: Listen... Don't be shocked...{0012}
...about ten Root castles sprang up all at once, they say! It's just a rumor... I think it's just a rumor.{0012}

Yeah, I suppose so.........................
Couldn't be helped, I guess...............{0012}
Oho, you're from Hida? Before the Dark Orchid showed up in Fukui, it was just next door if you went south.{0012}
I hear you folks took care of the Dark Orchid! Now Hida's close again!{0012}
If you want out of this town, you'll have to persuade the lord. He's raised the moat bridge.{0012}
Oh, "persuade" him, nothing! Even I could fool a sheltered lord like him!{0012}
Lord Kabuki has already gone! He said he'd cut down the Dark Orchid for me, even if it costs him his life!{0012}
He said he's going to Toyama first. By the time you get to Toyama, the Dark Orchid may be gone!{0012}
Did you cut down the Dark Orchid properly? Lord Kabuki beat Genmu Castle all by himself, didn't he?{0012}
He said he left the little chores to his underlings, but I hope you did it right. Oh, yes, just so you know...{0012}
Lord Kabuki proposed to me! Which means you and I are his lordship's wife and retainer! Understand?{0012}
The lord seems to think the Root Clan can't attack as long as he raises the moat bridge...{0012}
...but I know that won't work. Because I saw it. The Root lot flying through the sky...{0012}
So you're going off to fight the Root Clan... They say the lord of Toyama is someone you can rely on.{0012}
The other provinces must be in ruins too. It'll be hard for you, but hang in there!{0012}
The lady in this house... her only son is training to be a monk at Eiheiji.{0012}
But Eiheiji's over Fukui way, right? With the Dark Orchid there, she must be worried sick.{0012}
The lady's son... they say he was struck by the Dark Orchid's poison in the middle of praying, and died...{0012}

jp:
越中国に　幻夢城っていう
根の城が　突然　現れたらしいよ{12}

pages.en: They say a Root castle called Genmu Castle suddenly appeared in Etchu Province.{0012}
I hear the Genmu Castle lot work with illusions and mirages, but nobody knows what they really are yet.{0012}
I heard from a guy named Kabuki that the lord of Genmu Castle was a real knockout of a princess!{0012}
She was such a looker, he said he thought, for her, he might even give his life!{0012}

jp:
預り所に　すべての武器　防具　巻物
預けてこられたであろうな？

pages.en: You've left all your weapons, armor and scrolls at the storehouse, I trust?
Truly! If we find you hiding anything, it will be confiscated at once!{0012}
Ever since the Root Clan appeared, by the lord's order, only the unarmed may enter the castle.{0012}
Sorry for the bother, but go to the storehouse, leave your gear, your scrolls and, if you can, your items, and come back.{0012}
Yes, pardon us! We're in a hurry, so we'll be going on ahead! So long, Boss Manji!{0012}

jp:
「立山峠と　富山町
　ここより東」{12}

pages.en:
"Tateyama Pass and Toyama Town
East of here"{0012}

jp:
「西　海岸そば　押水村
　北　輪島村」{12}

pages.en:
"West: Oshimizu Village, by the coast
North: Wajima Village"{0012}

jp:
{0C}何じゃ　こりゃ♀
笑わせて　くれるじゃねぇか{12}

pages.en: What the hell is this?! Don't make me laugh!{0012}
{000C}Are the Root Clan serious? Do they think a pebble like this blocks the road?{0012}

jp:
{0C}さがってな｜　卍丸｜
すぐに　片してやるからよぉ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Stand back, Manjimaru! I'll clear it in a jiffy!{0012}
By the way, Manjimaru! You've been fighting the Root with strength like THAT?{0012}
{000C}Amazing you've survived this long! So here's my proposal!{0012}
How about this? Watch how strong I am, then decide whether you'll be my retainer!{0012}

jp: どーだ？

pages.en: Well?
{000C}My, aren't you obedient! Good attitude! As of now, you're my retainer!{0012}

jp:
{0C}じゃあ　{k}ワシ{h}が　決めてやろう！
あんたは　今から　わしの家来だ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Then I'll decide for you! As of now, you're my retainer!{0012}

jp: 巨大な岩が　道をふさいでいる{12}

pages.en: A huge boulder blocks the road.{0012}
Did you come to visit Eiheiji? You can't anymore. A Dark Orchid bloomed in the village!{0012}
It's dangerous! Hurry and get away! We're running too!{0012}
So you're Manjimaru, who beat Onikotsu Castle and Jungle Castle!{0012}
I never thought the Fire Clan would be just a kid like you. But looking closer, you're kind of cute!{0012}
{000C}Sir Manjimaru! I am a ninja come from Iga.{0012}
Northeast of Fukui, in a place hidden from prying eyes, lies our hidden village. Stop by anytime!{0012}
{000C}Sir Manjimaru, I have new information!{0012}
It seems someone of the Fire Clan named Aya lives on Mt. Oe in Omi Province.{0012}
If you're just here to sightsee, it's far too dangerous. Leave at once.{0012}
We mean to stay here to the very end, praying to the Buddha for the Root Clan to be subdued.{0012}
One of our brothers has lost his life.{0012}
He put his whole soul into his prayers, and his spirit must have left his body. Such a sorrow.{0012}
Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu! In exchange for my life, destroy our hated foe, the Root Clan!{0012}
They say there are oni on Mt. Oe in Omi.{0012}
I've heard the Fire Clan and the oni share some kind of deep bond.{0012}
Well, not that I'm one to talk.{0012}
It's almost New Year's. I never thought we'd see the year out safely this time. Thanks, Manjimaru.{0012}

jp: がんばってくれよ　卍丸さん{12}

pages.en: Keep at it, Manjimaru!{0012}
Something terrible seems to have happened in Etchu Province to the east.{0012}
It seems a swarm of countless castles called Genmu Castle covered the whole province in a single night.{0012}
New Year's in Kyoto is awfully lively, you know.{0012}
They sell lottery tickets, and if you win, you get a dream of a fortune. How gorgeous!{0012}
It seems the Root Clan keeps getting stronger. Can the Fire Clan really beat them?{0012}
Oh, Manjimaru! Hahaha! That was just an old man talking to himself. Pay it no mind.{0012}

jp:
黄色の花びらの
巨大な暗黒{k}ラン{h}が　咲いている{12}

pages.en: A giant Dark Orchid with yellow petals is in bloom.{0012}
{000C}You're of the Fire Clan, aren't you? I can see many fire spirits surrounding you.{0012}
They say the Fire Clan once lived in Oshimizu Village to the northeast too.{0012}
But that was a thousand years ago. Surely none of their descendants are left now.{0012}
In all the wide land of Jipang, there must still be others of the Fire Clan.{0012}
When all of the Fire Clan have gathered around you, the Root Clan's schemes will be crushed.{0012}
{000C}When the Dark Orchid bloomed, a woman calling herself Princess Hamaguri came out from inside the flower.{0012}
It seems that Princess Hamaguri is the lord of Genmu Castle.{0012}
They say the Root Clan makes its kind stronger by crossbreeding again and again with other creatures.{0012}
Princess Hamaguri may be one more poor victim of those experiments.{0012}
Hey, hey! A really cool guy named Kabuki came to the village a while ago!{0012}
He begged me, saying he needed money to defeat Genmu Castle, and I thought, "For him, anything!" so I lent him 100 ryo.{0012}
He went east to Etchu Province, but I want him to hurry back to me!{0012}

jp: あぁ　{k}カブキ{h}さん…　☆☆｜{12}

pages.en: Ahh, Mister Kabuki... ☆☆{0012}
Mister Kabuki came by a while ago and said this:{0012}
"My purple-haired retainer will be along later. Get your 100 ryo back from him."{0012}
You're Mister Kabuki's retainer, right?

jp:
{0C}そう！　じゃあ　百両
返してちょうだい！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Right! Then give me back my 100 ryo!{0012}
{000C}Don't lie to me! Who else has purple hair besides you?!{0012}
Now, pay back my 100 ryo!{0012}

jp: 卍丸は　百両　とられた{12}

pages.en: Manjimaru had 100 ryo taken!{0012}
{000C}What? You don't even have 100 ryo!{0012}
Mister Kabuki's retainer, and you're this broke! Well, you can pay me back when you make it big!{0012}
Not that you look like you'll ever make it big.{0012}
It feels like... the flower is sucking out my life force...{0012}
I'm feeling better! I thought I didn't have long, but I've gone and lived on again.{0012}
I mean to spend the rest of my life writing the biography of the purple-haired boy who saved the village.{0012}
First, the opening line: "The boy was the spitting image of me in my youth..." How's that?{0012}
The lord of Toyama Castle to the east is desperately searching for these Fire Clan folks, it seems.{0012}
Etchu Province is in ruins because of Genmu Castle too, they say, so he must be grasping at straws.{0012}
Whoa! I'd heard the stories, but the Fire Clan really is something!{0012}
But Jipang's a big place. Can you really beat every last one of the Root Clan?{0012}

jp:
{k}ゴホッ…　{h}いらっしゃ{k}ゴホッ…
{h}お団子は{k}ゴホッ！　ゴホッ…{h}ますか？

pages.en: *cough*... Welco*cough*... Would you like*cough!* *cough*... some dumplings?

jp: {0C}また　{k}ゴホッ　ゴホッ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Come ag*cough* *cough!*{0012}

jp:
どーせ　あんたの貸し切りや
２両でええで　泊ってくかえ？

pages.en: You'll have the place to yourself anyway. 2 Ryo'll do. Staying?

jp: 宿泊と記録やね…

pages.en: Stay and save, then...

jp:
２両も持ってへん　客が来るなんて
ああ　この村の行く末を　見る思いや{12}

pages.en: A customer who hasn't even got 2 Ryo... Ah, I can see this village's future...{0012}

jp:
何のおかまいも　でけへんけど
ゆっくりしてって{12}

pages.en: We can't offer you much, but make yourself at home.{0012}

jp: 宿泊だけで　ええんやね…

pages.en: Just the stay, then...

jp: 記録だけで　ええんやね…

pages.en: Just saving, then...

jp:
そりゃそうやわな　こんな村で
泊るなんて　命が縮むだけやもんな{12}

pages.en: Well, of course. Staying in a village like this would only shorten your life.{0012}

jp:
お客さん　悪いこと言わへんから
もう　この村へは　来んほうがええよ{12}

pages.en: Take it from me, customer: don't come back to this village.{0012}
I figured... Nobody'd be crazy enough to spend the night in a village like this...{0012}

jp: えっ｜　まさか　お客さん？

pages.en: Huh! Don't tell me, a customer?
Thank you... I'm sure you'll be this shop's very last customer.{0012}
I figured... No customers would come to a dying village like this now...{0012}

jp: 「火の勇者　極楽太郎　ここに眠る」{12}

pages.en: "Here lies Gokuraku Taro, Hero of Fire"{0012}
Heh, so you're a Hero of Fire? Come to think of it, long ago there was supposedly a Hero of Fire from this village too.{0012}
They say he was a big lug with crazy strength. Want to meet him? Easy. He's been sleeping in that temple there for ages.{0012}

jp: 墓石の下でな{12}

pages.en: Under a gravestone, that is.{0012}

jp:
お　お　おはようございます…
極楽さん…　よく　眠れましたか？{12}

pages.en: G-g-good morning... Gokuraku... Did you sleep well?{0012}
Amazing, right?! They say a Hero of Fire who lived in this village long ago got drunk, mistook this rock for the Root Clan and split it!{0012}
Legends are full of tall tales like that. But it gets me that there's even a rock left to match.{0012}

jp:
南の山の向こうに　清水って巻物を
持った天狗さんが　いるらしいよ{12}

pages.en: They say past the mountains to the south lives a Tengu who has a scroll called Pure Water.{0012}
Up north there's a place called Wajima Village, see, and I hear they're putting on a pretty interesting show.{0012}
A mermaid act is the big draw, apparently. I'd love to take a peek, but the Root Clan shows up around here too.{0012}
I wish the lord of Toyama would step up and clean out those Root scum somehow.{0012}
What the heck! The sideshow in Wajima Village went bust the very day it opened! Honestly! What a wasted trip!{0012}
A little to the north is a cave called Kanaya Cave. They say it's the tomb of some ancient people.{0012}
Mind you, anything worth taking was stolen long ago, so nowadays not even grave robbers go there.{0012}
I heard a Dark Orchid showed up in Fukui. Is that true? The lord of Kanazawa is useless, as always.{0012}
The one we can count on is the lord of Toyama! He's sent his retainers all the way to this village looking for the Fire Clan.{0012}
The Fire Clan lived in this village a thousand years ago... I wonder, are there any of them still left in this world?{0012}
So you're a Hero of Fire?! To think I'd see a real Hero of Fire... It pays to live a long life.{0012}
At last, I've found you! Purple hair, no mistake! You are the Hero of Fire, Sengoku Manjimaru! Now I can face my lord!{0012}
I am a messenger of the lord of Toyama. By his order, I've been searching for the Heroes of Fire! In fact, I met Sir Kabuki as well...{0012}
He said, "If you want a favor from me, send a woman to ask," and then he went off somewhere...{0012}

jp:
卍丸殿　お願いでござる｜
ぜひ　わが殿にお会いくだされ｜{12}

pages.en: Sir Manjimaru, I beg of you! Please, by all means, meet my lord!{0012}
That Gokuraku fellow who split the rock there was twice the size of a normal man, and his strength was way off the charts.{0012}
The armor and helmets they sell in shops just wouldn't do, and even his sword had to be specially made, they say.{0012}
Oh! Gokuraku was alive?! But you must have trouble finding gear. After all, with that body of his...{0012}
For now, why not get creative and gear up with everyday things? Wear a barrel on your head, for example.{0012}
In this cold, the flowers in the field on the southeastern cape must all have withered. The Tengu must be lonely.{0012}
There's a big flower field on the southeastern cape. Past it, a Tengu lives all alone.{0012}
This temple holds the grave of Gokuraku Taro, a Hero of Fire from a thousand years ago. He was from this village, they say...{0012}
In the middle of the war with the Root, he grew so worried about his sweetheart Chiyo's illness that he fled all the way back here...{0012}

jp:
火の勇者の中にも　なかなか
人間らしい者が　おったようですな{12}

pages.en: It seems even among the Heroes of Fire, some were very human.{0012}

jp:
結局　極楽太郎の恋人は　その後すぐに
亡くなったらしいですがね{12}

pages.en: In the end, Gokuraku Taro's sweetheart died soon after, they say.{0012}
Gokuraku Taro is alive?! Impossible?! I must lay him to rest with my holy power somehow! Namu namu namu namu...{0012}
{000C}Oho, oho, so you're looking for Fire Clan companions... I'm sorry, but it's a wasted trip.{0012}
True, a thousand years ago this village had a Hero of Fire named Gokuraku Taro. His grave is still here.{0012}
Oho, oho, so Gokuraku Taro lived a thousand years thanks to a mermaid's tears... And what did a thousand years of life get him?{0012}
Welcome! It's {001E} Ryo per night.{0012}
Rest from your travels here at our inn.

jp: 宿泊と記録ですね？

pages.en: Stay and save, then?

jp: お泊りだけですね！

pages.en: Just the stay, then!

jp: 記録のみですね！

pages.en: Just saving, then!

jp: 三太の{k}プレゼント{h}だ｜{12}

pages.en: A present from Santa!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０鱗光の衣を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Gleaming Scale Robe!{0011}{0044}

jp:
あんた　ここの宿屋の　三太っていう
{k}ドラ息子{h}の噂　聞いたかね？

pages.en: Heard the rumor about Santa, the good-for-nothing son of the innkeeper here?
Are mermaids really that great? But how? Eh? Hey! I mean, they're half fish!{0012}
...did those two meet, I mean! That's what you wonder, right?{0012}
Turns out he fell head over heels for a mermaid, and when his folks objected, he ran away from home!{0012}
They say a thousand years ago, there was a man in this village who fell for a mermaid too. What goes around comes around, I guess.{0012}
Anyway, that Santa boy made up with his parents, it seems, but it's going to be rough from here on.{0012}
A human and a mermaid, after all... "Love conquers all" isn't that simple...{0012}
Ah, to be young!{0012}
Customer, listen to this! My son, Santa's his name, has run away from home!{0012}
My son, of all things, got cozy with a mermaid... without a thought for how his parents feel...{0012}
Honestly, who does he think raised him this big... It makes me want to cry.{0012}
Customer, if you know, tell me: what kind of betrothal gift would make a mermaid happy...?{0012}
I never dreamed I'd end up going to a mermaid's family to ask for my son's bride!{0012}
Phew... Just being alive brings all sorts of surprises, doesn't it?{0012}
I saw the son of this house near Ouse Cave on the eastern shore. He asked me not to tell his parents...{0012}
So that's why I'm telling you! A juicy story like this! Nobody could keep it to themselves!{0012}
I bet he's deep in there, having cozy secret trysts with his mermaid sweetheart!{0012}
While the world trembles at the Root Clan and can't even see tomorrow, the young pair pledge their future to each other...{0012}
You got me there! Oh, I give up, I give up... No use me getting embarrassed about it!{0012}

jp:
よろず屋でおます！
ご利用に　ならはりまっか？

pages.en: General store, at your service! Can I help you?
If you seek a Tengu's dwelling, walk every corner of the province without missing a spot! There is no other way.{0012}
Beyond that, when townsfolk tell you where a Tengu lives, write it in your notebook right away.{0012}
Reports say some of the Root Clan devour their comrades and add their power straight to their own.{0012}
The Root Clan... They'll use any means to win... A frighteningly pure bunch.{0012}

jp:
卍丸様｜　あえて　忠告させて
いただきとうござる｜{12}

pages.en: Lord Manjimaru! Allow me to offer you a word of warning!{0012}
I feel the Root Clan has lately begun using all sorts of strategies, not just brute force.{0012}

jp:
きっと　情報操作や　陽動作戦などで
こちらを　かく乱する戦法｜{12}

pages.en: No doubt tactics to throw us into confusion: spreading false information, feints and the like!{0012}
Unless you keep a notebook just for it and sort the information carefully, you'll surely fall into the enemy's trap!{0012}
{000C}Back in the Root Kingdom, that Kikugoro was an actor! When it comes to fighting, he's a total amateur!{0012}
Beating somebody like that's nothing to brag about! Well, keep your guard up anyway!{0012}
I don't mean to rain on your parade, but... let me give you one piece of advice!{0012}
{000C}Back in the Root Kingdom, that Kikugoro was an actor! When it comes to fighting, he's a total amateur!{0012}
Beating somebody like that's nothing to brag about! Well, keep your guard up anyway!{0012}
I'll hand you the Pure Water scroll! It's not a technique you use much, but you'll be in a fix without it!{0012}
Whether you lug it around all the time is a matter of taste, so suit yourself! I'll leave it to you!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０清水の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Pure Water scroll!{0011}{004E}
Isn't it about time you learned to make good use of the storehouse? Your scrolls are full!{0012}
{000C}Unlike the other Tengu, I can make one of the scrolls you have now a little easier to use.{0012}
Feels a bit like taking credit for someone else's work, sorry about that, but not bad for a little comfort, eh?{0012}

jp:
{0C}しつこいようだが　１回だけだぜ
さっそく　やってみるかい？

pages.en: {000C}I'll say it again: this is a one-time deal. Wanna try it now?

jp: よく　使うのを　選ぶと　いいぜ！

pages.en: Pick one you use a lot!

jp: {1A}の術でいいかい？

pages.en: The {001A} technique, then?

jp:
{10}１３０{1A}の巻物に　使う技が
１　減った｜

pages.en:
{0010}{0090}The TP cost of the {001A}
scroll dropped by 1!
Talk to me again and I'll tell you about the deep, deep link between the Dark Orchid and the Root Clan.{0012}
{000C}There oughta be five or so other oddballs like me! Finding them first before you decide is one way to go.{0012}
Cut down a Dark Orchid and the Root Clan around there just vanish. Bit of a letdown, eh?{0012}
There's a reason for that. That flower weakens the humans around it, but on the Root Clan it works like a tonic.{0012}
At night it lets out the breath Yomi exhaled. For some reason, that robs the Root Clan of their fear.{0012}

jp:
ありゃ　効くぜ！　世界中で　自分が
一番　強くなったような気に　させる{12}

pages.en: That stuff packs a punch! It makes you feel like the strongest guy in the whole world.{0012}
Otherwise, nobody in their right mind would ever fight you Heroes of Fire!{0012}
So the moment you cut the Dark Orchid... well, most of them get crushed by all the fear they'd held down, and they're done for.{0012}
The head of us Tengu was a reckless, total idiot with the odd name of Karasu...{0012}
When we escaped from over there, he went and took the rear guard, though he shouldn't have, and faced a hundred times as many pursuers...{0012}
{000C}Nobody's seen him since... I'll give you the Fire God technique that idiot Lord Karasu was so good at.{0012}

jp: {10}１３０火天の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Fire God scroll!{0011}{0050}
Looks like there's not one free slot in your scroll bag! In that case, I can't give you a new scroll!{0012}
As long as somebody'd cry if you died, don't throw your life away! Hero of Fire! Once you're dead, nothing's left!{0012}

jp:
「北　越前の国
　南　火多の国」{12}

pages.en:
"North: Echizen Province
South: Hida Province"{0012}
Hida Province is just to the south, but the Dark Orchid's roots have blocked the road.{0012}
Hey, pal! I hear you're from Hida! Go see your mom's face once in a while.{0012}
She might talk tough, but I bet she's lonely, your mom.{0012}
I'm trying to flee this province, but thanks to the roots, I can't go anywhere. Oh, it's all over...{0012}
I was going to flee to a land without the Root Clan, but now the monsters are gone from this province too.{0012}
Huh? You beat them? Wooow! Wooow! That's amazing!{0012}
The Root Clan doesn't show up in Hida Province, right?!{0012}
I wanna go to Hida too! Damn it! If only those Dark Orchid roots weren't there!{0012}
This is Tateyama Pass, on the border between Echizen and Hida.{0012}

North is Echizen Province.
South is Hida Province.{0012}
Dammit, there are Dark Orchid roots west of here, so I can't get to Omi! What a pain! Blast it!{0012}
This is Konoha Pass, on the border between Omi and Echizen.{0012}

West is Omi Province.
East is Echizen Province.{0012}

jp: 覚悟は　いいか？

pages.en: Ready?
That boat tied up on the west riverbank, is it yours? A gang of five men came piling out of it a while ago. Friends of yours?{0012}

jp:
毎度　ありがとうございます！
またのお越しを　お待ちしております{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you kindly! We look forward to your next visit!{0012}

jp:
お道具の品揃えなら　三国一の私の店を
よろしく　お願いします｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}For the best selection of items in all the land, remember my shop!{0012}
The lord here in Kanazawa is the older brother of the lord of Toyama. Between them, the brothers rule the three Koshi provinces: Echizen, Etchu and Echigo.{0012}
Over there's a great lord who acts instead of talking. Over here's a useless lord who's all talk. I wish we could trade! Honestly!{0012}

jp:
おめえか？　山に顔を　彫ってやるとか
うちの　{k}バカ殿{h}に　のせられて
根の一族を　倒しにいく命知らずは｜{12}
で　やっぱ　だめだったんだろ？

pages.en: So you're the one? The daredevil our fool lord talked into fighting the Root Clan by promising to carve your face into a mountain?{0012}
So, it didn't work out, huh?

jp: だろうぜ！　だろうぜ！{12}

pages.en: Figured! Figured!{0012}
Oh, is that so, is that so...{0012}
Is it fun lying to yourself about your own life like that?!{0012}
Not bad! I figured you for all talk. My mistake!{0012}
Oho, you're a Hero of Fire, eh? Around here, the Heroes of Fire don't have the best reputation... because, you see...{0012}

Thank you. So there are humans with kind and true hearts after all.{0012}
I'll go home to Mermaid Village with Santa here.{0012}
{000C}Damn it! You jerks! Let us out of here! We're not a sideshow!{0012}
Huh?! You're not a customer? Come to think of it, you look like a kind sort. I'm Santa, from Oshimizu Village.{0012}
Me and the mermaid girl there got kidnapped by a gang of five weird-faced guys.{0012}
This mermaid girl is the princess of Mermaid Village! She doesn't belong in a place like this!{0012}

If you've got no business here, hurry back to your seat. You don't wanna get hurt, do ya?{0012}
Hey, pal! This here's the dressing room, see, so only staff are allowed in...{0012}
We've been getting a lot of 'em lately...{0012}
Guys who come to feed the mermaid and then just go missing, see. You don't wanna end up like that, do ya? Huh?{0012}

The open-air market opened just a bit ago. They had a real bargain of a sword: Attack 68, and I think it was 96 ryo.{0012}

Here to see the mermaid?
Heh heh heh... You're a sly one, Boss Manji! Well, take your time!{0012}
Heh heh heh... After more than just a look, are you? Well, I'll be!{0012}
That's a Hero of Fire for you!{0012}
Ashimoto #3: Now here's a rare customer! So you Fire Clan are men just like us after all, eh?{0012}
Fish or women, it's the lively, firm ones that fetch the best price, eh!{0012}
Ashimoto #5: Oh! Boss Manji!{0012}

Must be the difference in skill, eh?
Well, if I get the chance, I'll teach you how to fish, Boss Manji!{0012}
For about 10,000 ryo...{0012}
Then... it's that! The difference in how we live day to day! What else could it be?{0012}
{000C}Every day we live in fear of the Root Clan, so I want to take in a show and ease my heart a little.{0012}

pages.en: We took the day off work today and treated ourselves to some fishing!{0012}
And what do you know, we caught a whopper! Must be thanks to our good deeds, day in, day out!{0012}
You never know where the gods might be watching, Manjimaru, so mind how you behave!{0012}
Oh! You're one of the Fire Clan, aren't you? No! You can't have that man! Better he stays locked up for life!{0012}
Oh no, you finally let him out of the cage... Don't come crying to me when you regret it.{0012}
I heard the sword and armor Gokuraku had on when he was caught are kept by the mermaids of the Seto Inland Sea...{0012}
That's if they haven't thrown them out yet. It was a thousand years ago, after all.{0012}
You... You're Manjimaru, the boy of the Fire Clan?! The Queen said she wants to make a deal with you.{0012}
Manjimaru... Be very careful of Princess Hamaguri of Genmu Castle. Don't underestimate her because she's a woman.{0012}
Her life force must be far beyond that of any other Root creature. I know it... I just know...{0012}
How do I know...? I can't say now. Once you've defeated Princess Hamaguri, I'll tell you.{0012}
I see... So Princess Hamaguri...{0012}
The truth is, Princess Hamaguri was a mermaid. The Root Clan tricked her with a promise to make her human, and this is what became of her...{0012}
Did you see a mermaid and a young man around here? Honestly, where has the princess gone off to?{0012}
As it is, the Queen doesn't much like the princess keeping company with a human...{0012}
I hear the princess had been kidnapped! The Queen never said a word, so I had no idea.{0012}
I hear you rescued the princess and Santa! Not bad for a Hero of Fire!{0012}

jp: あなたも　足下兄弟の関係？

pages.en: Are you with the Ashimoto Brothers too?
{000C}Then get out! No matter how much money you offer, there's not one mermaid here who'll appear in a sideshow!{0012}
{000C}Oh, then you're Santa's friend. Don't let the Queen spot you. She seems to be in a real temper today.{0012}
I hear the princess was put on show... It'd be simpler if this made her hate all humans...{0012}
From the look of her, no chance... It's because there are good people now and then, like you and Santa, that it gets complicated.{0012}
I see... So at her death, Princess Hamaguri said she wished to be reborn as an ordinary woman... She said that...{0012}
Manjimaru... Fins or legs on half your body... It's too much, having your whole life decided by something like that...{0012}
Long ago, mermaids fought on the Fire Clan's side too. I've heard one of the seven heroes carries mermaid blood.{0012}
They say the Queen trusted the Fire Clan more than anyone. Until that man in the cage came along, that is.{0012}
Drinking our tears so he alone could live long... If he weren't Fire Clan, we'd have sunk him in the sea!{0012}
Oh! Gokuraku's gone! He ran off again, didn't he?! I knew this would happen!{0012}
Manjimaru, give that big glutton behind you a message for me!{0012}
"I haven't forgiven you, but we'll watch over Chiyo's grave, so go and fight without a care!" Tell him that.{0012}

pages.en: Have you changed your mind? Will you save my daughter?
I am Yadaki, Queen of this Mermaid Village! And who might you be?!{0012}
That purple hair... Can it be that you too are of the Fire? So some still remain besides that one...{0012}
Surely you haven't come to ask me to let that monster out?! That I cannot grant.{0012}
...Or so I would like to say. But if you will grant my request, I shall release that one from his cell.{0012}
The truth is, my daughter has been carried off by humans... Most likely they mean to put her on show somewhere near Wajima Village...{0012}

さすが　火の勇者じゃ｜{12}

pages.en:
Thank you!
A true Hero of Fire!{0012}
Someone, bring that one here! Show him to our guest!{0012}
Every last one of the Fire Clan is worthless! I ask nothing more of you! Begone!{0012}
I entrust my daughter to you. And if you can, please save the young man called Santa too...{0012}
My daughter has told me of your deeds, Sir Manjimaru. As promised, I shall break the seal on this cell...{0012}
But first, a warning. The one in this cell is no noble member of the Fire Clan like you.{0012}
Of every living thing I know, he is the lowest! The worst of men! A glutton, a great liar and a lummox!{0012}
The Root Clan are far better! Still, if you say you will open it, I shall not stop you...{0012}

海の神よ｜

pages.en: O god of the sea! Protect Manjimaru!{0012}
Only a fool would go out of his way to shoulder the source of disaster.{0012}
When I look at you, it seems that someday the walls between humans, mermaids and the Fire Clan will vanish...{0012}
How strange, that I should feel that day will come... Treasure your life, Sir Manjimaru!{0012}
Nice work, pal! Now hurry and get the Queen to undo the seal on this place!{0012}
So there's Fire Clan still alive besides me! I figured they'd all kicked the bucket!{0012}
Come to think of it, sounds like the Root bunch are back and running wild again! You're young! Tough going alone, eh?{0012}
So here's a deal! How about you get me out of this cell? Not for nothing, of course!{0012}
On my honor as a man, I'll make you two promises! One: I'll smash the Root lot around here in a single blow!{0012}
And two! No matter what happens, I'll stick with you to the very end!{0012}
Well?! Not a bad deal, eh? Think it over real good.{0012}
......Oho! That smell of blood...{0012}
So there's Fire Clan still alive besides me! I figured they'd all kicked the bucket!{0012}
Come to think of it, sounds like the Root bunch are back and running wild again! You're young! Tough going alone, eh?{0012}
So here's a deal! How about you get me out of this cell? Not for nothing, of course!{0012}
On my honor as a man, I'll make you two promises! One: I'll smash the Root lot around here in a single blow!{0012}
And two! No matter what happens, I'll stick with you to the very end!{0012}
Well?! Not a bad deal, eh? Think it over real good.{0012}
The one in this cell is Gokuraku Taro, a big glutton, a good-for-nothing, the lowest of men!{0012}
That's right! Fire Clan, same as you!{0012}
Manjimaru! Don't trust Gokuraku. He'll run off when it counts, just watch.{0012}
They say if a human drinks our tears, their life grows longer by a thousand years. The one who drank those tears was Gokuraku Taro.{0012}
That man in the cage there. He got caught right after he drank them, so he's spent most of the thousand years in that cage.{0012}
Me included, mermaids normally never shed a single tear their whole lives. And he drank them...{0012}
I heard the mermaid named Chiyo died. He must have done something horrible to make her cry.{0012}
The man in that cell says his sweetheart had Fire Clan blood in her and could see the future...{0012}
And that, just before she died, she told him as her last wish, "Live a thousand years."{0012}
A cheap story, right???? If he'd told a better lie, he could've fooled us mermaids easily.{0012}
Hey, does Fire Clan blood really give you the power to see the future?{0012}
After a thousand years, that big man is getting out of his cell. Is that chance? Or was it decided a thousand years ago?{0012}
The guy in the cell, see... freakish strength is the only thing he's got going for him.{0012}

jp:
さすがに女王が　牢にかけた封印だけは
力づくじゃ　破れないみたいなのよ{12}

pages.en: Even so, the seal the Queen put on the cell is one thing he can't break by force, it seems.{0012}
We haven't heard a peep from him in about three hundred years. Maybe he's croaked in there.{0012}
They say Gokuraku has a trick where he stores "Burning Water" in his belly and breathes fire.{0012}
Use him instead of a bonfire, and you might roast a potato or two. Give it a try sometime!{0012}
Manjimaru! It's Santa, from Oshimizu Village. Sorry for all the trouble I caused you in Wajima!{0012}
There's still a gulf between mermaids and humans, but she and I are going to give it our best!{0012}
Manjimaru! Mother gave me permission to marry Santa!{0012}
It's all thanks to you! After Santa, I like you best of all, Manjimaru! Thank you so much!{0012}

pages.en: There's a Tengu's hermitage down the river to the east. Found it yet?{0012}
The Root Clan broke the bridge to the east so the people of the villages Genmu Castle crushed couldn't escape!{0012}
Then they slaughtered everyone who had nowhere left to run! Isn't that horrible?!{0012}
The pure white snow will wash clean the earth soaked with the blood of those the Root Clan killed.{0012}
On that empty ground where Genmu Castle stood, I'll build a temple to lay the dead to rest.{0012}
The ancients believed a mirage was the vapor breathed out by a giant clam.{0012}
Princess Hamaguri, the Clam Princess... true to her name, maybe she's good at making mirages?{0012}
I mean, so many castles going up in one night? That's impossible unless it's a mirage!{0012}
So Genmu Castle really was a mirage made by Princess Hamaguri.{0012}
Women are good at showing men illusions. Though they get found out soon enough.{0012}
Go through Midagahara Cave and head south, and there's a little village called Bijodaira Village.{0012}
Just like its name, it's a village of beautiful women. That one village, at least, I hope survives no matter what.{0012}
It seems the girls are back in Bijodaira Village. Good, good.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, busy with great deeds as ever, I see. Please, go on through.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru... You'll be seeing our lord...? I see... Then please, go ahead.{0012}
Oh! That hair, those clothes, that look! You are surely the honored Fire Clan!{0012}
Our lord awaits you! Come, come, please go in!{0012}
{000C}Winter's almost here. The cold is harsh in these parts. We'd better get ready for winter soon.{0012}
{000C}My, my, the Root Clan's gone before I knew it! I wonder, do the Root Clan hibernate too?{0012}

pages.en: I guess you'll understand when you're a bit older...{0012}
They push some dream on a man that can never come true, and then they go off alone...{0012}

jp: やっかいだぜ　残るほうは…{12}

pages.en: It's hard on the one left behind...{0012}

jp:
悪いことは　いわねえから
忘れちまいな　はまぐり姫のことはよ

pages.en: Take my advice and forget about Princess Hamaguri.
You'll live happier that way. Come on, let's slice that damn Dark Orchid and clear our heads!{0012}
So you're one of those big idiots too! Well, then, let's go cut down a Dark Orchid, us two big idiots!{0012}
0 steps east!{0012}
0 steps south!{0012}
0 steps west!{0012}
0 steps north!{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! By order of the lord of Toyama, I am probing the secret of Genmu Castle. The countless castles on the northern plain are all illusions!{0012}
That much I've learned... but where the real one is, I have not the faintest idea.{0012}
They say in Echigo Province to the east there is a mechanist without equal, past or present, named Denjiro.{0012}
He's famed as the best in the land at building fine devices for driving off evil.{0012}
Surely Denjiro can build a device that will help us take Genmu Castle... We can only believe he can!{0012}
So Denjiro lived up to our hopes after all!{0012}
How about that, Sir Manjimaru! We men of Koshi are quite something, aren't we? Ahem!{0012}
Another squad was sent east to Echigo to find Denjiro the mechanist, but we've heard not a single word from them.{0012}
To enter Echigo, you have to go through Unazuki Cave on the northern border... Could some accident have befallen them?{0012}
Come to think of it, long ago a princess of Kyoto who was to marry the lord of Kanazawa was said to have Fire Clan blood...{0012}
On the road to Echizen, she was carried off by an oni called Shuten-doji, they say... Her name was Princess Aya, I believe.{0012}
Hey, hey, you've gotta be kidding me! I heard this Bijodaira Village was full of pretty girls!{0012}
The world's going to pot anyway! I decided if I'm gonna die, it'll be in Bijodaira Village, and I barely made it here alive!{0012}
And there's not one pretty girl in sight! My pure, innocent heart's been trampled!{0012}
They say you tire of a beauty in three days! But I'd never tire of one! Manjimaru, won't you introduce me to someone?{0012}
But why do the girls in this village all keep muttering the same thing to themselves, like they're off in a daze?{0012}

jp:
あんたも　{k}カブキ{h}さんと同じ
火の勇者かね？　根の一族さ　必ず
ぶっ殺してくれるとね？{12}
約束できるんか♀
ほんま　約束してもらえるんか♀

pages.en: Can ye promise?! Truly promise me?!
Then go on into the shrine, and burn our grief deep into those eyes of yers!{0012}

jp:
だば　わしは　殺されても　ここば
動くわけには　いきまっしぇん！{12}

pages.en: Then I'll not budge from here, even if they kill me!{0012}
Mister Kabuki said, "What're ye doin' to my women?!" and went rushin' off.{0012}
Bless ye, bless ye! I don't know how to thank ye enough!{0012}
True, this village is called Bijodaira, the "Plain of Beauties," but as you see, there are no beauties here. Not even any young women.{0012}
When I say there aren't any, there aren't any!{0012}
It was hard to stand by and watch the girls waste away with shells stuck on their heads, unable even to eat.{0012}
I reckon a woman's most charming when she's eating her fill, full of life. Heh, listen to me. I've joined the middle-aged crowd.{0012}
"Wait for me! I'll come for you, I swear! My little sweetheart!"{0012}
......Mister Kabuki ☆☆☆{0012}
Look at this! The girls of this village! Every one of them turned into this! What good does it do anyone?!{0012}
They say Princess Hamaguri is a beauty, but she means to wipe every beautiful woman but herself off the face of the earth!{0012}
Thanks to you, the girls are back to being beauties worthy of this village's name.{0012}
Mind you, give them thirty years and they'll look like me. But that has its charms too.{0012}
We villagers decided to hide the girls here for now...{0012}
After all, if anyone saw them like this, the girls might take their own lives.{0012}
They're all girls yet to be married, so please keep what happened in this village a secret. I beg you.{0012}

jp:
{k}カブキ様…　早{h}く　早く
この貝がらを　取ってください…{12}

pages.en: Mister Kabuki... Hurry, hurry and take this shell off me...{0012}

pages.en: {000C}Well then, so long.{0012}
Miho... Oh... She was to be married so soon...{0012}
Huh? Did you hear what I just said?! No, no, we have no daughter named Miho... None, I tell you.{0012}
Thank you so much, Manjimaru! Now at last our Miho can be married off like anyone else...{0012}
...Or so I thought, but then Miho suddenly says she's waiting for a man called Kabuki, and the match looks set to fall through...{0012}
Children never know their parents' hearts, as they say. Well, as a parent, all I want is for her to be happy.{0012}
Miho... Why... Why did this happen to you... O gods... Please, save Miho... Miho...{0012}
Oh, silly me... Eh? Miho? Mi... Miho... Mihoto... I said "Mihotoke," as in, the Buddha's will be done!{0012}
Miho has a fiancé, but she's gone and fallen head over heels for a man called Kabuki...{0012}
She says Kabuki told her, "Wait for me! I'll come for you, I swear! My little sweetheart!"{0012}
That man said the very same thing to me. Don't tell Miho.{0012}
And of c-course, don't tell my husband either!{0012}
This province of Etchu is home to five whole Tengu, so folks call it the Tengu Ginza.{0012}
Seems they all like living in out-of-the-way places, like by the sea or deep in the mountains.{0012}
Right on the far side of the southern mountains, there's a little village called Jigokudani Village. A great Tengu lives there, they say.{0012}

The Dark Orchid shook the ground so hard that gas started spewing out of the valley.{0012}
The villagers all ran off. But the moment they left the village, the Root monsters ate 'em up.{0012}

jp:

できずに　ここに　いるわけさ{12}

pages.en: Our family couldn't even leave the village, so here we are.{0012}
We mean to hang on here as the last survivors of Jigokudani Village.{0012}
There's a Tengu living all alone in the valley.{0012}
But the gas makes it hard to breathe, so I can't go visit the Tengu.{0012}

pages.en: Come by whenever you want a rest.{0012}
Sorry to make you come all the way down to the bottom of this valley, but I let my guard down for a moment, and...{0012}
He's a friend of yours, isn't he? That man called Kabuki. He stole my scroll.{0012}
Heh heh heh... Imagine, stealing! That man may be too good to waste on the Fire Clan.{0012}
Still, wherever can Lady Mari be hiding? Have you no idea at all?!{0012}
Heh heh heh... Means nothing to a guy like me whose noggin was loose to begin with, but this scroll works on the clever ones.{0012}

jp:
この術が　かかった奴は　いきなり
頭ん中が　俺くれぇに　なるらしいぜ{12}

pages.en: Anyone hit with this technique suddenly gets a head about like mine, they say.{0012}
Meaning that just thinking a little about anything hard gives 'em chills, makes 'em itch all over, and even makes 'em queasy.{0012}
So try it on anybody who comes at you with sneaky tricks! Here! The Thousand Baths scroll!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０千湯の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Thousand Baths scroll!{0011}{004A}
Is your noggin loose too? With your scroll bag full, how're you gonna get a scroll?!{0012}
Truth is, I cast Thousand Baths on myself, and now it won't wear off... Heh heh heh... heh heh heh...{0012}
Honestly, do you Fire Clan know no limits...? Take my eyes off you for a moment and you've grown stronger.{0012}
What sort of person can Lady Mari be, to have given you such power?{0012}
Perhaps she's even more frightening than Yomi... They say the two fought to a draw in the war a thousand years ago.{0012}
I look forward to seeing how strong you'll grow! Now, take my Flower Path scroll!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０花道の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Flower Path scroll!{0011}{004D}
There's no point visiting a Tengu with your scroll bag still full! Remember that well!{0012}
Perhaps she's even more frightening than Yomi... They say the two fought to a draw in the war a thousand years ago.{0012}
Even the Root Clan, see, never meant to steal Jipang at the start.{0012}
But... borrowing Yomi's power was where it all went wrong... Yomi's a master at dragging out people's greed.{0012}
Just seeing Yomi makes you feel like you've gotten crazy strong...{0012}
Maybe that's why, maybe not, but the scroll I've got isn't too popular with the Root bunch.{0012}
It's the Mirage scroll! Fighting isn't the only kind of strength, right? You get it! Put it to good use!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０逃水の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Mirage scroll!{0011}{0052}

jp:
巻物が　いっぱいなのに　とりあえず
来ちまったわけだ……{12}

pages.en: Your scrolls are full, and you came anyway...{0012}
A reckless sort like you is bound to find the scroll I've got real handy...{0012}
Manjimaru... You've probably figured it out by now, but we Tengu are really Root folk. We've washed our hands of all that now, though.{0012}
You know Ihika, right? Think of us as the same kind! Not as brainy as him, though.{0012}
A thousand years ago, I got sick of the war, and your Lady Mari helped me out. That's how I came to be here!{0012}
Us giving you scrolls is our way of repaying Lady Mari, you might say!{0012}
My scroll's called Mighty King! Use it right and you're unbeatable! Though the Root lot use it too...{0012}

jp: {10}１３０力王の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Mighty King scroll!{0011}{004D}
If you want to live long, know what's in your own scroll bag! I'd give you a scroll, but it's full!{0012}
Then please rest well.{0012}
By the way...{0012}
Lord Manjimaru... Lady Mikoshi seems to be drawn to you. Please be mindful of her feelings.{0012}
Please keep it from Lady Mikoshi that I asked you this. If she ever found out...{0012}

jp:
わたくし　みこし様に
あの三又の槍で　串刺しにされまする{12}

pages.en: ...Lady Mikoshi would skewer me on that trident of hers.{0012}
Do you know the item called an Oil Jar? Use it in battle, and fire attacks become far more effective.{0012}
But it has a drawback: enemy fire attacks get stronger too, so it's tricky to know when to use it.{0012}

jp:
卍丸さん｜　男の戦いは「戦う」｜
これだけ　ありゃ　いいですよね？

pages.en: Manjimaru! A man fights with "Fight"! That's all you need, right?

jp: ですよね｜{12}

pages.en: Right!{0012}
...I see. I'll go to Kii Province too, then, and get a Tengu to teach me Winter Wither and Mud Worm.{0012}
This guy takes war too lightly. He thinks fighting's just swinging a blade around like crazy.{0012}
Sure, if there's a clear gap in strength, it's another story... but against the Root Clan, that never happens.{0012}
What are scrolls, Break and Guard for, then? Manjimaru, you're a seasoned warrior. Teach this guy!{0012}
This is the inn where a dashing member of the Fire Clan named Kabuki stayed!{0012}
Mister Kabuki said he'd defeat Genmu Castle for my sake, so I gave him meals and clothes for free.{0012}
Oh no, I don't want money. Just so long as Mister Kabuki comes back safe and makes me his wife...{0012}
Say, Genmu Castle is gone now, isn't it? So why won't Mister Kabuki come back to me?!{0012}
And I've already announced the wedding to my parents and all my relatives!{0012}
The stronger you get, the more the enemy will switch tactics and rack what little brains they have.{0012}
Take items and gear, for one. From now on, you'd best not go eating or wearing them without thinking.{0012}

jp:
知らない物は　まず　疑ってみるのが
まあ　長生きの秘訣って{k}コト{h}だよ{12}

pages.en: When you don't know what something is, doubt it first. That's the secret to a long life.{0012}
The three provinces of Echizen, Etchu and Echigo have loads of flowers that go into medicines. We're a bit famous for medicine here.{0012}
In the old days, about this time of year, apothecaries came in droves from Kyoto and Omi to pick flowers.{0012}
If you spot flowers on your travels, they might come in handy. Might be good to remember where they were, at least.{0012}
What's this? An apothecary in Sanjo brought back the legendary Resurrection Pill? Can that be true?{0012}
I'm Sinbad, the boy adventurer! I just got back safe from my adventure in Midagahara Cave!{0012}
Huh? Weren't you in Midagahara Cave, mister? I saw someone who looked just like you!{0012}
My name's Marco! My mom's not some woman who reeks of pickled radish!{0012}

jp:
本当の母ちゃんを　探す
旅に出るぜ！{12}

pages.en: I'm setting off to find my real mom!{0012}
My silly boy read some foreign storybook and now he's into dangerous games. It's a real headache.{0012}

jp:
こら馬鹿盆！　わけわかんないこと
言ってると　晩{k}メシ　抜{h}きだよ！{12}

東の平野に　根の一族の
幻夢城が　建ちやがったんだよ！{12}

pages.en: The Root Clan's Genmu Castle went up on the plain to the east!{0012}
Genmu Castle isn't just one castle, mind you! They're lined up clear to the horizon!{0012}
Thanks to that, every village around there got crushed. There are only three villages left in Etchu, this one included.{0012}
Princess Hamaguri, who conjured mirages... Like her name, her life was fleeting. It's true what they say: beauty dies young...{0012}
The women of this town, on the other hand, just go on living, bold as brass! I give up!{0012}
Midagahara Cave to the southeast is the only road to the plain where Genmu Castle stands.{0012}
But go through it, and you'll come out right in the middle of the plain full of castles. It's dangerous, so don't go.{0012}
Boys are always reckless and eager to open the door to a new world.{0012}

jp:
わしの死んだ　じいさんも　若い頃は
そうじゃった…{12}

pages.en: My late husband was just like that when he was young...{0012}

jp:
わしと　じいさんの　なれそめを
聞きたいかい？

pages.en: Would you like to hear how my old man and I met?

jp:
わしと　じいさんだけの
秘密ですじゃ…　{k}ポッ{12}

pages.en: That's a secret between just me and him... *blush*{0012}
I'm just bursting with happiness! My son's getting married soon!{0012}
The son I raised with such care since he was little is grown enough to take a bride... *sob*...{0012}

jp:
親にとって　これほど
嬉しいことは　ありません…{12}

pages.en: For a parent, there's no greater joy...{0012}
The Root Clan's gone, and my son's getting married...{0012}
Two happy events at once! Wahahaha!{0012}
My son's bride is a young lady from Bijodaira Village named Miho.{0012}
Even in Bijodaira Village, where the girls are all beauties, she's said to be the fairest in the land.{0012}
She's so sweet to us, too... I'm so happy a girl like that will be my son's wife.{0012}

jp:
卍さん　根の一族を　倒してくださって
ありがとうございました｜{12}

pages.en: Manji, thank you for defeating the Root Clan!{0012}

jp:
えっ｜　その上　息子に祝儀まで
いただけるのですか？

pages.en: What?! And you're even giving my son a wedding gift?
Thank you so much! I'll use this money to buy gifts for the guests!{0012}
100 ryo, taken! What a shameless old bat...{0012}
Oh, it's quite all right! I don't think of the Fire Clan as stingy little penny-pinchers at all.{0012}
Every day we're afraid of the Root Clan, and that's exactly why we decided to marry soon.{0012}
Once we've made our vows, Miho and I will be together, even in the next world.{0012}
Once we're married, we'll have kids by the dozen and make up for everyone the Root Clan killed! Yeah!{0012}
Have you heard of a medicine called the Resurrection Pill? It's a miracle cure handed down in these parts that heals any sickness at once.{0012}
I came from Kyoto in search of the Resurrection Pill, but it seems it's hard to make, and nobody I ask knows how. What a letdown.{0012}
I never got the Resurrection Pill, but just seeing your splendid deeds was enough for me.{0012}

jp:
へぇ　へぇ　武具でしたら　なんでも
そろとりまっせ　ご利用で？

pages.en: Yes, yes, weapons and armor, we've got 'em all! Will you be buying?

jp: へぇ　へぇ　また来ておくれ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Yes, yes, come again!{0012}
Ugh... Midagahara... An illusion... with substance...{0012}
It's there... but... ugh... when you try... to go in... the path... vanishes...{0012}

jp:
ここは　どこだ…　ううう…
道が…　道が…{12}

pages.en: Where am I... ugh... The path... the path...{0012}
I'm feeling much better now. It's all because the young lady there looked after me so devotedly.{0012}
It's not much of a thank-you, but I've decided to look after her for the rest of my life.{0012}
This man was lying collapsed at the exit of Midagahara Cave.{0012}
He must have barely escaped with his life from the plain where Genmu Castle appeared.{0012}
I'm so glad he's well again. We've decided to live together. *blush*☆{0012}

jp:
はい！　いらっしゃいまし
何か道具が　ご入り用かな？

pages.en: Yes! Welcome! Need any items?
I had a son about your age too, you know... The Root Clan got him...{0012}
No matter how strong a Hero of Fire is, take care of your life! If anything happens, come to me and I'll patch you up!{0012}
For Jipang, for justice... It's all too hard for a plain old woman like me to understand.{0012}

jp:
とりあえず　あんたのお母さんのために
あまり　無理は　しないでね…{12}

pages.en: Anyway, for your mother's sake, don't push yourself too hard...{0012}

jp: 油壷を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found an Oil Jar!{0012}

jp: 夜叉の黒衣を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Yaksha's Black Robe!{0012}

jp: 幽谷の鎧を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Secluded Vale Armor!{0012}
Hey! Manjimaru, this guy's the fake! Disguising himself as me! What a creep! Hurry up and take him out!{0012}
Damn it! Well, nothing for it now! It's my own fault for screwing up.{0012}
Cut me down right along with this fake! I'll die for justice!{0012}
H-how did you know?! I even said I'd die for justice, like a proper Hero of Fire...{0012}
You're really something, Manjimaru! Seeing through my fake at one glance! I've gotta thank you! Here, take this...{0012}

jp: この　わらわの　一太刀をね｜{12}

pages.en: ...one stroke of MY blade!{0012}
{000C}Manjimaru took a critical blow! He took 120 damage!{0012}
Gokuraku took a critical blow! He took 120 damage!{0012}

jp: {0C}卍丸は　敗走した………

pages.en: {000C}Manjimaru was routed...{0012}
Hey! Manjimaru! Cut me down if you want, but on one condition!{0012}
Don't you DARE so much as scratch this outfit! Got it?! You jerk!{0012}

jp:
もう一度　二人の話を
聞きますか

pages.en: Hear the two of them out again?

jp:
どちらの　{k}カブキ{h}を　斬りますか？
{01}左の{k}カブキ　{01}右{h}の{k}カブキ

pages.en:
Which Kabuki will you strike?
   {0001}Left Kabuki   {0001}Right Kabuki
Welcome to Genmu Castle, young Manjimaru! Never fear, this castle is real... though it is an illusion, of course.{0012}
Where does the real end, and the false begin... Can you tell? Fail to see it, and you'll lose your life!{0012}
Young Manjimaru! Let me give you a word of advice: "See with the eye of the heart!"{0012}
Young Manjimaru! Princess Hamaguri is beautiful! Lord Yomi made her with his own hands, after all. She is beautiful! And...{0012}

jp:
続きは　彼女{10}１３０に会えば　わかる
楽しみにして　いなされ｜{11}６０{12}

pages.en: As for the rest, you'll see when you meet her. Look forward to it!{0012}
Thank you for coming, traveler. You must be cold. Please, warm yourself by the fire.{0012}
I can offer only a little hospitality, but I'm making a dish that will warm you right up.{0012}
I was missing some ingredients, so the seasoning took a while, but it's nearly done.{0012}

jp:
最後に　{11}３０何の具を　入れるか
{11}６０ご存知♀{12}

pages.en: Do you know what goes in last?{0012}

jp:
おまえの肉だよ　{11}３０卍丸！
{11}５０おまえの肉を　入れて　完成だ！{12}

pages.en: Your flesh, Manjimaru! In goes your flesh, and it's done!{0012}
You look tasty, Manjimaru! Looking at that lithe body makes me want to sink my teeth in!{0012}
Welcome, traveler. This is a dream paradise where lost travelers are led.{0012}
Surrounded by lovely flowers, you'll forget all about your hard battles.{0012}
Come, come, put away your sword and pick some flowers too.{0012}

jp:
今日中に　たくさんの花を
摘まないと　いけないのです{12}

pages.en: I must pick a great many flowers before the day is out.{0012}

jp: なぜって？{12}

pages.en: Why, you ask?{0012}
Isn't it obvious?! To decorate your coffin!{0012}
Welcome, traveler. This is a deep forest from which those who wander in never return.{0012}

jp:
生きることに　疲れたものは
{11}３０この森へ　やってまいりまする{12}

pages.en: Those weary of living come to this forest.{0012}
They lie down in the sea of trees where no light reaches. The crows eat their flesh, and the insects take care of their bones...{0012}

jp: そんな　哀しい森でござります{12}

pages.en: Such is this sorrowful forest.{0012}
Come, come, traveler, stay here tonight and rest your weary body.{0012}

jp:
力を　抜いて…
{11}６０目を　閉じて…{12}

pages.en: Relax... Close your eyes...{0012}
And you'll never open your eyes again! Rot away here, Manjimaru!{0012}

jp:
まあ　こんな　海に囲まれた孤島に
よく　いらしてくださいました{12}

pages.en: My, thank you for coming all the way to this lonely island in the sea.{0012}

jp:
海は　ときによって　その姿を
変えるってこと　{11}１０ご存知♀{12}

pages.en: Did you know the sea changes its face from time to time?{0012}

jp:
ときには　おだやかな母のやさしさ…
{11}６０ときには　荒ぶる父の怒り…{12}

pages.en: Sometimes the gentle kindness of a mother... sometimes the raging fury of a father...{0012}
But to the Fire Clan, even a raging sea is nothing to fear, I'm sure.{0012}
With that courage, I'd so like you, Hero of Fire, to cross a river for me. It's nothing next to the sea.{0012}

jp: え？　{11}３０何の川かですって♀{12}

pages.en: What? Which river, you ask?{0012}

jp:
{10}１２９馬鹿野郎！　もちろん
三途の川に　決まってんじゃねーか！{12}

pages.en: You moron! The River of Three Crossings, of course! The one to the land of the dead!{0012}
When I gaze at a sky full of stars, human life seems so very small.{0012}
People's pain, their suffering, their sorrow...{0012}
Within the breath of the seemingly endless stars, such things are but a fleeting dream, like foam on water...{0012}

jp: 今　{11}３０お星様に　お願いしていたの{12}

pages.en: I was just making a wish upon the stars.{0012}

jp:
おまえが　血を流し
うめきながら　死んでゆくことをな！{12}

pages.en: A wish that you'll bleed and die groaning!{0012}

jp: 俺の祈りは　{11}３０よく通じるんだぜ{k}ェェ！

pages.en: Welcome home, Manjimaru! Mother's so happy you've come back!{0012}
I made lots of your favorite ohagi, so have some with your friends.{0012}

jp: 食べますか？

pages.en: Eat some?

jp:
卍丸の体力は　半分になった！
極楽の体力は　半分になった！

pages.en:
Manjimaru's HP was halved!
Gokuraku's HP was halved!

jp:
そう…　じゃあ　先に
お風呂に　入りなさいな{12}

pages.en: I see... Then have a bath first.{0012}

jp: 風呂に入りますか？

pages.en: Take a bath?

jp:
卍丸は　装備を　はずした！
極楽は　装備を　はずした！

pages.en:
Manjimaru took off his gear!
Gokuraku took off his gear!
You must be tired... I'll lay out your futon, so go to bed now.{0012}

jp: 寝ますか？

pages.en: Go to sleep?

jp:
卍丸は　眠ってしまった！
極楽は　眠ってしまった！

pages.en:
Manjimaru fell asleep!
Gokuraku fell asleep!

jp: {k}バカ{h}なやつだよ{10}１２９　卍丸{12}

pages.en: What a fool you are, Manjimaru.{0012}
You'd have lived a little longer if you'd stayed in that cell, but out you come, bold as you please.{0012}
That's right, I'm no lord! In truth, I'm one of the Wadatsumi Five: the Sea Cuke Monk!{0012}

jp:
牢から　出てきたことを
すぐに　後悔させてやるぜ！　死ね｜

pages.en: I'll make you regret leaving that cell right now! Die!{0012}
I thought the castle's defenses were airtight, but never did I dream the Root Clan would come from the sky...{0012}
Truly, they change shape at will... They are not to be taken lightly.{0012}
We were at our lord's side, yet we could not protect him... How shameful...{0012}
Manjimaru, I'm so ashamed! The Root Clan caught me and locked me up in this place.{0012}
I believed you would come for me.{0012}
The Root Clan said they'd disguise themselves as me and lay a trap for Manjimaru, but I wasn't worried.{0012}
After all, someone like Manjimaru would never fall for the Root Clan's petty tricks.{0012}
Oh, you DID fall for it? ...But you broke out of the trap, so you really are amazing, Manjimaru.{0012}

jp:
とりあえず　詳しい話は
天守閣で　しましょう{12}

pages.en: For now, let's talk properly in the castle keep.{0012}
Our lord worries so much for Etchu Province that he hasn't slept for many nights.{0012}
We soldiers of Toyama fought the Root Clan bravely too, but our arrows are spent and our swords broken. We've no will left to fight.{0012}
Now, no one but you of the Fire Clan can save this province. We beg you!{0012}
Come at us, Root Clan!{0012}
We may not be able to protect the whole province, but this castle, at least, we'll defend with our own strength this time!{0012}
Phew, I'm glad the Root Clan's gone...{0012}
For all my bold talk, the truth is I was terrified.{0012}
If I didn't talk tough to keep my spirits up, I'd give in to fear, you see.{0012}
Ah...! Sir Manjimaru...{0012}
Forgive me! I cannot let you pass here...{0012}
Um... Our lord is...{0012}
S-sorry... It's nothing. Nothing at all...{0012}
My lord and the lord of Kanazawa are brothers by blood.{0012}
But unlike the lord of Kanazawa, my lord values his people and wishes for a peaceful land. He is a kind-hearted man.{0012}

jp:
殿に仕えることができて
拙者も　幸せでござるよ{12}

pages.en: I'm fortunate to serve him.{0012}
Never again will we let the Root Clan near this castle! We'll protect our lord with our lives!{0012}
Is it true?! The Root Clan's really gone?!{0012}
Ahh... At last I'm free from guarding the castle day and night without rest... I can have my first bath in a month...{0012}
You are the Fire Clan, aren't you! Thank you for coming. I am the lord of Toyama.{0012}
As you know, Etchu has been trampled by Genmu Castle, and the people suffer under the Root Clan's tyranny.{0012}
Genmu Castle is a castle like a hazy shadow. It vanishes and appears, appears and vanishes...{0012}
I've sent scouts from my castle too, but its true nature remains a mystery.{0012}
I thought there was nothing for it but to borrow the Fire Clan's power, so I've been waiting for you.{0012}

jp:
この国の民のため　どうか
そのお力を　お貸しくださいませ

pages.en: For the people of this province, I beg you, lend us your strength!

jp:
おお｜　これで　きっと
この国は　救われます｜{12}

pages.en: Oh! Now this province will surely be saved!{0012}
I see... If even the Fire Clan has abandoned us, this province is finished...{0012}
Villages burned by the Root Clan, property plundered, people violated, hearts grown savage, suffering from hunger and thirst...{0012}
People eating people, plague spreading, uprisings everywhere, mountains of corpses piling up... Oh, it's terrible just to imagine!{0012}
Go through the two caves to the east and you'll find a village called Sanjo. There lives a mechanist named Denjiro.{0012}
I believe Denjiro could build a device that shows the way to Genmu Castle. Why not go to Sanjo first?{0012}

jp:
卍丸殿か
一体　何の用かな？{12}

pages.en: Sir Manjimaru? What is it you want?{0012}
You want permission to enter the gold mine? Planning to steal some gold, are we?{0012}
Only joking. But you'll never get to the gold mine now. Because...{0012}

jp:
生きて　再び　この城から
出ることは　ないからだ｜{12}

pages.en: ...you will never leave this castle alive!{0012}
Manjimaru, I have joined hands with Princess Hamaguri.{0012}
To survive, one serves the strong. Don't you think that's the law of nature?{0012}
What can two of the Fire Clan do? Think it over long and hard in there!{0012}
Manjimaru, are you okay? We've come to save you, so you're safe now!{0012}
Honestly, getting caught by the enemy! How pathetic! You're a Hero of Fire, right? Shape up!{0012}

jp:
{10}１２９ま…卍丸様を
このような目に　あわすなんて…{12}

pages.en: H-how dare you treat Lord Manjimaru like this...{0012}

jp: {10}１２９ゆ…ゆるせなーーーーーーい｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}I-I won't forgive youuuuu!{0011}{00C6}
Huh? What did I just do?{0012}

jp:
これだよ｜　　　　
お姉は　{k}カッ{h}となると　みさかいが
つかなくなるから　こわいよな…{12}

{10}１２９あらっ　いやだわ　{10}１３０卍丸様に
はしたないところを　お見せして{10}１２９

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Oh my, how embarrassing, letting Lord Manjimaru see me so unladylike.{0011}{00F3}

jp:
{10}１３０
申しわけありませんわ…{12}

pages.en: I'm terribly sorry...{0012}

jp: それでは　ご武運

pages.en: Then may fortune favor you in battle.

jp: お祈りしております｜{12}

pages.en: We'll be praying for you!{0012}
{000C}Oh! You did it! Thank you so much, Manjimaru! This province is saved!{0012}
No matter how many words I spend, I can never thank you enough.{0012}
The smiles of this province's people... that is our best thanks to you, Manjimaru.{0012}
{000C}The fate of this province is in your hands, Manjimaru.{0012}
