Ugh... I'm from Shikano Village. The moment I left the village for a walk, a tornado sprang up at the village entrance...{0012}
I can't get home, I've no family in other villages, and I'm flat broke. Look at the state of me.{0012}
Please, Manjimaru, use your power to get rid of that tornado! I beg you!{0012}
They say the monsters of Sand God Castle turn people into sand statues to decorate the castle.{0012}
Sometimes you find human-shaped chunks of sand outside the castle, failed ones, it seems. What do they think a human life is?!{0012}
The Root Clan took the priest and holed up in the village shrine! Please, save the priest!{0012}
The Root Clan took the priest and holed up in the village shrine! Please, save the priest!{0012}
The Root Clan took the priest and holed up in the village shrine! Please, save the priest!{0012}

jp:
この{k}ジパング{h}に　永遠の光を
与え続けてくだされ　卍丸様｜{12}

pages.en: Keep shining your eternal light on Jipang, Lord Manjimaru!{0012}
I have the Four Gods Key. Now is the time to put it to use.{0012}
Please, take it.{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}四神の{k}カギ{h}を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Four Gods Key!{0011}{0052}
O gods, tell me! The Heroes of Fire have come at last, and all three have full item bags...{0012}
What am I to do...{0012}
You are Sir Manjimaru of the Fire Clan, aren't you? Thank you so much for saving me.{0012}
The Root Clan brought me here to make me tell them where the Four Gods Key is.{0012}
The Root Clan seem desperate to break your momentum.{0012}
You saved me from a close call. I have the Four Gods Key. Now is the time to put it to use.{0012}
Please, take it.{0012}
There are Dark Orchid roots up ahead, so you can't get through east to Omi.{0012}
Honestly, that damn Dark Orchid puts its roots down in the worst places!{0012}
They say somewhere in Kibi Province is a castle of the oni who fled Mt. Oe. They fled a long way...{0012}
Inaba's doomed anyway, thanks to Sand God Castle.{0012}
I thought I'd escape to Omi while I still could, but the Dark Orchid roots...{0012}
...it's the wife who leads in battle! Striking her first may be the wisest plan.{0012}
Oh! The gods have truly led the Fire Clan to this land!{0012}
A thousand years ago, too, it was four Heroes of Fire who saved this land from disaster.{0012}
Now Sand God Castle has risen again, and you have come... Fate truly comes around.{0012}
If you wish to borrow the wisdom of the four heroes, go to Toyooka Village to the east.{0012}
A thousand years ago, Inaba was saved by four Heroes of Fire.{0012}
That's why, in this province, the faith that reveres the Fire Clan like gods is still deeply rooted.{0012}

jp:
その刀…　その衣…　似ておる！
古文書に書かれた　千年前の
四人の　火の勇者と　うりふたつじゃ{12}
もしや　そなたら　火の一族か？

pages.en: That sword... those clothes... They look just like them! The spitting image of the four Heroes of Fire in the old texts!{0012}
Could you be the Fire Clan?
Oh! So you are this land's saviors after all!{0012}
A thousand years ago, when Inaba was struck by the fury of Sand God Castle, it was four of the Fire Clan who saved it!{0012}
With their special powers, they made nothing of quicksand and tornadoes, and broke Sand God Castle!{0012}
Now history repeats itself! I believe you will surely bring down Sand God Castle!{0012}
{000C}Hmm, I see... What a pity...{0012}
Come quickly, Fire Clan! Before this land is destroyed!{0012}

jp: じいさまの話　聞いてくれたかね？

pages.en: Did you hear Grandpa's story?
There's more to Grandpa's story, you see.{0012}
The Fire Clan who defeated Sand God Castle angered the evil god Yomi, and their bodies were turned into hideous giant spiders.{0012}
The heroes who became spiders hid themselves away somewhere and were never seen again, they say... It's a sad story.{0012}

jp: ぜひ　聞いてやってくだされ{12}

pages.en: Do go and hear him out.{0012}
In Toyooka Village to the east, there's the grave of the Heroes of Fire from a thousand years ago!{0012}
They say the heroes' voices still speak to people with strong faith.{0012}
Inaba used to be a very beautiful land, overflowing with green.{0012}
But ever since Sand God Castle appeared, the sand's been spreading, and now the whole province is desert!{0012}

jp:
うちは　道具屋でございます
何か　お求めですか？

pages.en: This is the item shop. What can I get you?

jp:
毎度　どうも｜
また　お越しください｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Thanks a bunch! Come again!{0012}
We're proud we could tend the wounds of the Heroes of Fire! Don't lose heart, keep at it!{0012}
All we can do for the Heroes of Fire is tend your wounds...{0012}
If you're ever hurt too badly to fight, come straight back here without a second thought.{0012}
The desert sand swallows people, just like an antlion pit. Be careful when you walk outside.{0012}
The brave young men of the village set out to bring down Sand God Castle.{0012}
But only one came back alive... There, that's him. My son.{0012}
Damn it... If the Heroes of Fire from a thousand years ago were here, quicksand wouldn't scare us one bit...{0012}
Are you Fire Clan too? Then you must be friends of Lord Kabuki, who came by earlier.{0012}
Lord Kabuki took a ship west to Izumo Province to cut the Dark Orchid. All by himself! How brave!{0012}
The monster of Sand God Castle stirred up tornadoes on the border road so we couldn't escape to Izumo!{0012}
The urns of the four heroes are kept in the Four Gods shrines, at the east, west, north and south of Inaba.{0012}
The Azure Dragon Shrine in the east, the White Tiger Shrine in the west, the Black Tortoise Shrine in the north and the Vermilion Bird Shrine in the south. Those four.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, the Four Gods shrines are locked, so that unbelievers cannot enter.{0012}
The key is kept as a treasure of Wakasa Village to the south.{0012}
Before going to the Four Gods shrines, you'd best go to Wakasa Village first.{0012}
Leave this village and head south along the mountains, and you'll find Wakasa Village.{0012}
The folk there must be waiting for the Fire Clan too. Please, pay them a visit.{0012}
It seems the Dark Orchid is blooming in Izumo Province next door. The pollen blows over from there.{0012}
Our ancestors put the four heroes' bones in urns and laid them to rest at the east, west, north and south of this land.{0012}
With a prayer that they would watch over Inaba forever.{0012}
That damned Sand God Castle is guarded by quicksand. We can't even get close.{0012}
But you'll find a way, Manjimaru! We believe in you!{0012}

jp:
根の一族が　おそってきて
神社を　封鎖してしまったのじゃ｜{12}

pages.en: The Root Clan attacked and sealed off the shrine!{0012}

jp: また　どうぞ！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Come again!{0012}
They say the four heroes worshipped in this village could walk right across quicksand as if it were nothing.{0012}
Are you mister Heroes of Fire? Every night instead of lullabies, we get told stories about the heroes!{0012}
You can split the sea and knock down mountains with one finger, right?{0012}
My mom said so! Wow!{0012}

jp:
あわあわ！　怪物がやってきたじょー！
怖いじょー！{12}

pages.en: Waaah! A monster's coming! I'm scawed!{0012}
Turning the four heroes into spiders... This Yomi is a cruel god.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, please defeat the evil god Yomi along with the Root Clan, and avenge the heroes' sorrow!{0012}
Manjimaru, according to the records from a thousand years ago, the lords of Sand God Castle are a pair of monsters, husband and wife!{0012}
A thousand years ago, the Heroes of Fire fought with four, but now you're three... and one dog...{0012}
No, no, I'm not worried or anything! It's just... three, and one dog...{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! When walking in unknown lands, it's best to check your map often to confirm where you are and which way you're facing.{0012}
I've walked many provinces on my missions for years, and in the end, looking at the map was always the quickest way.{0012}
Lost? Check the map!{0012}
They say somewhere in Jipang there are two scrolls the experts love, called Tailwind and Full Bloom.{0012}
Apparently they make spells harder to break or easier to land. Not that I could ever use them well.{0012}
This is Yakuno Pass, on the border between Inaba and Omi.{0012}

East is Omi Province.
West is Inaba Province.{0012}
Y'know what? When I almost got swallowed by the sand, an oni saved me!{0012}
The oni wasn't scary like my mom says! I hate the Root Clan way more!{0012}

jp: 根の一族　こわいよー　こわいよー{12}

pages.en: The Root Clan's scary, so scary!{0012}
They say the Four Gods shrines have the keyhole and the door in separate places. It's a bother, but bear with it.{0012}
The villages of Tottori, Toyooka and Wakasa together, as one, enshrine the souls of the four heroes.{0012}
The heroes appeared in Tottori and sleep in Toyooka.{0012}
And here in Wakasa we guard the key to the shrines that hold their bones, kept in their memory.{0012}
Even the holy power of the heroes' bones, which wards off disaster, won't work... Have the Root Clan grown stronger than a thousand years ago...?{0012}
Thank you kindly! We'll pass the deeds of the Heroes of Fire down to our children's children!{0012}
The Four Gods shrines are locked so no thieves get in, see.{0012}
And there's one more trick to it: the keyhole and the door were built far apart on purpose.{0012}
It's a bit of a bother, but thanks to that, the heroes' urns stayed safe for a thousand years.{0012}
What does the Root Clan want with the Four Gods Key, anyway?!{0012}
Does something happen if you gather the urns of the Heroes of Fire?!{0012}
The people who mourned the four heroes' deaths, praying that they'd protect Inaba forever...{0012}
...laid the four heroes' urns to rest in the Four Gods shrines.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, the old texts say the lords of Sand God Castle are a married pair of ant monsters.{0012}
No doubt a mated pair, a queen ant and a male ant.{0012}
Ants are aggressive and stubborn, all of them! Sir Manjimaru, keep your wits about you!{0012}
Splendid! It seems you've cut both of Izumo's Dark Orchids! We expect great things from you yet!{0012}
So the Root Clan didn't die out in the war a thousand years ago...{0012}
And this time the Holy Swords, the key to victory, are in their hands, aren't they?{0012}
Sir Manjimaru, it's a hard fight, but this time, destroy the Root Clan so they can never rise again!{0012}
The Root Clan took the priest and holed up in the village shrine! Please, save the priest!{0012}

jp:
{0C}神主さま　助けてくれたの？
お兄ちゃんたち　強いんだね{12}

pages.en: {000C}Did you save the priest? You guys are strong!{0012}

jp: {0C}根の一族　こわいよー　こわいよー{12}

pages.en: The Root Clan's scary, so scary!{0012}
Each of the Four Gods shrines is named after one of the sacred beasts said to guard the land.{0012}
That is: the Black Tortoise of the north, the Vermilion Bird of the south, the Azure Dragon of the east and the White Tiger of the west.{0012}
The Root Clan attacking us! We can't live in peace in this village anymore!{0012}

jp:
根の一族を倒し　この国の民を
お救いくだされ　卍丸殿｜{12}

pages.en: Defeat the Root Clan and save the people of this land, Sir Manjimaru!{0012}
You must be Lord Manjimaru! We've heard all about you. Please stay the night in this village.{0012}

jp: 宿泊と記録で　ござるな？

pages.en: Stay and save, then?

jp:
{0C}確かに記録したでござる
安心して　お体をお休めください{12}
宿泊だけで　ござるな？

pages.en: Just the stay, then?

jp: {0C}では　お体をお休めください{12}

pages.en: Then please rest well.{0012}

jp: 記録だけで　ござるな？

pages.en: Just saving, then?

jp: {0C}確かに記録したでござる

pages.en: The Root Clan grows stronger by the day, it seems. Lord Manjimaru, please take the greatest care!{0012}
{000C}Well done, Manjimaru! In courage and swordsmanship alike, you are already a fine Hero of Fire.{0012}
{000C}Now our task is done. Let us sleep once more in this land.{0012}
{000C}But first, we have a gift for you. The treasures of this land, stolen by the Root Clan...{0012}
{000C}The murmur of rivers, grassland swaying in the wind, birds at play... Let us fill this land with them once more!{0012}

jp:
蜘蛛の壁画の横に
小さな鍵穴が　ある{12}

pages.en: There's a small keyhole beside the spider mural.{0012}

jp:
すでに　四神の{k}カギ{h}で
封印は　といてある{12}

pages.en: The seal has already been undone with the Four Gods Key.{0012}

jp:
{1A}は　{1A}を
鍵穴に差し込んだ！

pages.en: {001A} inserted the {001A} into the keyhole!

jp: 夜の沓を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found the Night Shoes!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}夜の沓を　手に入れた｜
影の霊薬を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Shadow Elixir!{0012}

jp: 水鏡の兜を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Water-Mirror Helm!{0012}

jp: 黒の骨壷を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found the Black Funeral Urn!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}黒の骨壷を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Black Funeral Urn!{0011}{0046}

jp: {0C}命の光が　{11}３０消えてゆく…{12}

pages.en: {000C}The lights of life are going out...{0012}
{000C}Let's hurry back to Toyooka Village. Something bad seems to be happening.{0012}

jp: 嵐の護符を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Storm Talisman!{0012}

jp: 黒蜘蛛の剣を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Black Spider Blade!{0012}

jp: 殉教の碑を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Martyr's Monument!{0012}

jp: 七福の玉を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Seven Fortunes Orb!{0012}

jp: 血の霊薬を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Blood Elixir!{0012}

jp: 朱の骨壷を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found the Red Funeral Urn!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}朱の骨壷を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Red Funeral Urn!{0011}{0048}

jp: 物を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Farewell, Manjimaru! We have fine descendants! We can entrust the future to you without a care.{0012}
Some villagers are still held captive inside Umashikano Castle.{0012}
I'm sure they'll all help you from the shadows, Lord Manjimaru, so please hear them out!{0012}
Now I'll take my leave here. I pray for your fortune in battle!{0012}
Thank you, Manjimaru. The green has returned to this land. The legend of the Fire Clan was true!{0012}
The waters run blue, the grass sprouts green, birds sing, dogs run about, and cats curl up under the kotatsu.{0012}
This is Inaba as it's meant to be. Well? Isn't it a beautiful land?{0012}
The four heroes who became spiders lent you their strength?{0012}
So even as spirits, the Fire Clan watch over this land. How grateful we are.{0012}
The souls of the Fire Clan, rising again across a thousand years...{0012}
A power that turns a desert green in an instant...{0012}
The Fire Clan may be beings beyond even the gods. It frightens me a little.{0012}
Thank you, Manjimaru. Nature is this land's treasure, a precious inheritance to hand down to our children.{0012}
We'll cherish this green, so it's never destroyed again.{0012}
Thank you so much, Manjimaru! The villagers are overjoyed that the Fire Clan legend was true!{0012}
The heroes of a thousand years ago came back to life to save this land again! How truly blessed we are!{0012}
Saved twice by the Fire Clan! We people of Inaba can never repay you.{0012}
So the four Heroes of Fire really were watching over this land.{0012}
From now on, the whole village will never fail to honor the heroes' memory.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, I hear you let one of the Sand God Castle monsters go.{0012}
The Fire Clan are not only strong, but kind to the core! Truly admirable!{0012}
Still, I hope that kindness doesn't come back to haunt you...{0012}
Now we know the four heroes live on alongside us.{0012}
We'll keep visiting and tending their grave.{0012}

jp:
卍丸殿　神はあなたに
味方しておりますぞ{12}

pages.en: Sir Manjimaru, the gods are on your side!{0012}
I never knew the green was so beautiful... I suppose you only learn how precious nature is once you've lost it.{0012}

jp: {k}ワン　ワン｜{12}

pages.en: Woof woof!{0012}
I'm supposed to be the watchman of the Four Gods shrines. If the Root Clan had stolen the urns, I could never have faced anyone again.{0012}
Thanks, Manjimaru!{0012}
Pepe of Sand God Castle fled to the south.{0012}
For somebody with the power to turn all Inaba into desert, that's pretty pathetic! Gahaha!{0012}
Manjimaru, they say the tornado outside Shikano Village is gone! I can go home to Shikano Village!{0012}
But I've gotten used to living like this. It's easier than going home and working.{0012}

jp:
砂神城の{k}ペペ{h}って野郎　半{k}ベソ{h}かいて
逃げてったぜ！　ざまあねえな{12}

pages.en: That Pepe from Sand God Castle ran off half in tears! Serves him right!{0012}
"To all travelers: coming soon to Shikano Village, the tricks of Manto the Monkey Fool!"{0012}

jp:
ただいま　調教中にて
もう　しばらく　お待ちください｜{12}

pages.en: "Now in training. Please wait a little longer!"{0012}
{000C}Heroes of Fire, please help us!{0012}
A Root Clan castle called Umashikano Castle has gone up right next to the village.{0012}
I hear you defeated the fool of Umashikano Castle. Thank you so much.{0012}
{000C}The castle's name is read "Umashikano." Call it "Baka-no-Shiro," the Fool's Castle, and you'll be killed!{0012}
They say a Tengu lives in a spot ringed by the northern mountains... You can get there by the side path from Byakko Cave.{0012}
The young men of this village were dragged off by the Root Clan as laborers when Umashikano Castle was built.{0012}
Even since the castle was finished, not one has come back... Nobody knows if they're alive or dead.{0012}
{000C}It seems the men taken to Umashikano Castle are all alive. What a relief!{0012}
{000C}Umashikano Castle stands right on the road to Izumo Province in the west.{0012}
If you're going to Izumo, you'll have to do something about that castle.{0012}
So the lord of Umashikano Castle was that Manto...{0012}
He was one of the Daimon Sect's Thirteen who attacked eastern Jipang a few years back, wasn't he? Famous for being an idiot!{0012}
{000C}You must be Lord Manjimaru of the Fire Clan.{0012}
It seems the Root Clan built Umashikano Castle sure that you would pass this way.{0012}
They seem very confident they can bury you all at Umashikano Castle.{0012}
{000C}Thank you so much. The men at Umashikano Castle will surely come home before long.{0012}
Manjimaru, thanks for beating Manto! I came back from Umashikano Castle ahead of the rest!{0012}
We figure we'll keep Umashikano Castle for ourselves, so the others stayed behind to keep fixing it up.{0012}

jp:
あなた方　火の一族は
私達の希望です｜{12}

pages.en: You, the Fire Clan, are our hope!{0012}

jp:
どうか　村長の悩みを
聞いていただけませんか？

pages.en: Would you please hear the village head's troubles?
The village head is in the back room. We're counting on you, honored Fire Clan!{0012}

jp:
そうですか…
しかたありませんね…{12}

pages.en: I see... It can't be helped...{0012}
They say lots of foreign ships come to Kobe in Naniwa, and they sell rare things you can't even get in Kyoto.{0012}
The honored Fire Clan has brought down Sand God Castle! Just as the old texts say! History has repeated itself!{0012}
I'm glad Sand God Castle is gone, but... Yomi will never forgive you for this.{0012}
I don't want the same misfortune as a thousand years ago. Please don't lose to the likes of Yomi.{0012}
They say the lord of Sand God Castle ran off south, wailing and bawling.{0012}
He must have been really sore. Serves him right!{0012}
Rumor has it a fellow called Pepe from Sand God Castle ran away from the castle.{0012}
I just hope he never comes back to this land...{0012}
I hear Sand God Castle has been destroyed. The souls of those the sand killed can surely rest in peace now.{0012}
Thank you, Sir Manjimaru. Now my son's fallen comrades are avenged.{0012}
Th-thank you... Now, even when I go to the next world, I can face my dead friends...{0012}
You did it, Manjimaru! I'm sure you'll sweep away the Root Clan!{0012}
We'll wait here in this land for good news from you, Manjimaru.{0012}
Manjimaru, they say the road west to Izumo Province is open! You're going after Lord Kabuki, right?!{0012}
Manjimaru! The tornado to the south is gone!{0012}
Now you can get to Izumo Province!{0012}
I can't see Pepe of Sand God Castle letting this lie. Be very careful.{0012}

jp:
卍丸さん　出雲へ出る道にあった
竜巻が　消えたらしいぜ！{12}

pages.en: Manjimaru, they say the tornado on the road to Izumo is gone!{0012}
I mean to lay the heroes' urns back in the four shrines.{0012}
So that they will watch over Inaba forever.{0012}
Who'd have thought you'd cross the quicksand with the help of the spider heroes!{0012}
Many Fire Clan souls stand behind you, Manjimaru.{0012}
Manjimaru, they say the tornado outside Shikano Village, far to the west, is gone.{0012}
That's the only road leading to Izumo. Why not go have a look?{0012}
The trees and the river came back, but all my friends who used to play with me are gone... *sniff*{0012}
What splendid valor! Every bit the equal of the heroes a thousand years ago!{0012}
It seems the four heroes have become spirits again and gone back to their gravestones.{0012}
I hope the world never again sees a disaster that calls those four souls back to life.{0012}
{000C}Who are you lot?! Go away! There are no young girls here!{0012}
{000C}I'm ashamed of the rude things I said to the Heroes of Fire earlier.{0012}
I thought you'd come to carry off my granddaughter, and I lost my head... Please forgive me.{0012}

jp:
{0C}わーん！　お姉ちゃんは
渡さないぞ　怪物めー｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Waaah! You can't have my sister, you monster!{0012}
{000C}When I grow up, I'm gonna be Fire Clan and protect my sister from monsters!{0012}
{000C}Stay away! There's nobody here but old ladies like me!{0012}
{000C}So you were the Fire Clan. Thank you for saving my daughter.{0012}
{000C}Thank you, Lord Manjimaru. I didn't have to bring my family grief after all.{0012}
Sake is this village's specialty. But Umashikano Castle took it all, so this brewery's bone dry.{0012}
This village's sake is a sacred brew that perks your strength right back up! I wish you could've tasted it once.{0012}
We'll make Manto work for free till the day he dies to pay for the sake he drank.{0012}
{000C}I've raised my only daughter with such care since she was a baby! As if I'd give her to a monster as a bride!{0012}
If you're taking my daughter, you'll have to kill me first!{0012}

jp:
{0C}卍丸さんは　娘の
命の　恩人ですわ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Manjimaru saved my daughter's life.{0012}

jp:
{0C}いいの…　私　お嫁に行きます
それで　この村が　救われるのなら{12}

pages.en: {000C}It's all right... I'll go as his bride, if it saves this village.{0012}

jp:
{0C}私　怪物の　お嫁に行くくらいなら
卍丸様のほうが…{k}ポッ{12}

pages.en: {000C}If I have to marry a monster, I'd rather marry Lord Manjimaru... *blush*{0012}
{000C}Whatever cruel demands the monster of Umashikano Castle makes, we can only keep quiet and obey.{0012}
There are no strong men left in the village, and on our own we could never fight the Root Clan...{0012}
{000C}To think we were obeying Manto, of all creatures...{0012}
Please don't tell the other villages about this. We'd be a laughingstock.{0012}
{000C}After the men, now the girls...{0012}
How many people must the monster of Umashikano Castle take from this village before he's satisfied?!{0012}
{000C}Manto seems to have trained hard since the Daimon Sect fell, but his brains are no better.{0012}
{000C}The monster of Umashikano Castle seems to bear a terrible grudge against the Fire Clan.{0012}
What's more, they say no one can match its brute strength. Please be very careful.{0012}
{000C}So Manto was still alive...{0012}
Any other monster I could stand, but to think we were tormented by that idiot... It makes my blood boil.{0012}
The monster of Umashikano Castle loves sake something awful. He's been guzzling this village's sake left and right!{0012}
And then he hauled every drop that was left back to his castle... I wanted you to have a drink, Manjimaru.{0012}
We'll put Manto to work and get back what he drank for free!{0012}
After sake, it's women... The monster of Umashikano Castle is a real good-for-nothing.{0012}

Seems they came all the way from Inome Village, past a cave in the southwest of Izumo Province.{0012}
But they're 100,000 ryo apiece... Who buys a hundred of those?{0012}
{000C}Hey! How long are you going to lie there sleeping?!{0012}
A real man pays back what was done to him a hundred times over! Hurry up and go settle the score!{0012}
I meant to go west to Iwami Province and made it as far as the border, but lava came spewing out...{0012}
So I never made it to Iwami. It's nothing unusual around here, but it's a nuisance.{0012}
{000C}Listen... If you ever lose to the Root Clan and you're at the end of your rope, come to me!{0012}
Don't tell my son. I'll put you up for free, with my own loving care thrown in!{0012}
Mister! Our Yukito came home all right! What happened to your dog, mister?{0012}
We promised to have a sumo match, right?! Hey, we promised, right?! You didn't forget?!{0012}
What happened to your dog, mister? He ran away from home 'cause you were mean to him, right?{0012}
Then he's just like our Yukito!{0012}
That dog you've got is big, mister! I wish our Yukito would grow that big.{0012}
Then let's have our Yukito and your dog do sumo! It's a promise!{0012}
You're the one who cut the Dark Orchid! Thank you!{0012}
I want to raise my boy to be a fine man like you. Thank you so much, Manjimaru!{0012}
On clear days you can see the Dark Orchid far off to the northwest...{0012}
He's too little to understand what's happening in this land yet, so it's fine for now... but when I think of the future...{0012}
The Heroes of Fire! Thanks to you, my illness is on the mend!{0012}

jp:
暗黒{k}ラン{h}が　出雲大社に
咲いてからというもの　体の調子が
悪うてのぉ…　{k}ゴホッ　ゴホッ…{12}
火{h}の勇者のみなさんが　せっかく
来てくださったのに　海の向こうじゃ
さすがに　暗黒{k}ラン{h}も　切れんわのぉ{12}
もう　{k}ジパング{h}も　おしまいかのぉ？

pages.en: Ever since the Dark Orchid bloomed at Izumo Shrine, I've been in poor health... *cough* *cough*...{0012}
Even you Heroes of Fire, coming all this way, can't cut a Dark Orchid across the sea, I suppose.{0012}
Is this the end of Jipang?
{000C}How cruel... *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*... Please don't say that.{0012}
{000C}Even if it's a fib, hearing the Heroes of Fire say so makes me feel stronger... *cough* *cough*... *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*...{0012}
There's a stone monument on the beach north of the village, isn't there? From there, *cough*, a thousand years ago, they pulled in the Root island, *cough* *cough*, they say.{0012}

jp: ここは茶店です　何かごようですか？

pages.en: This is a teahouse. What can I do for you?
Lava's welled up all over the road before Hasumi Village, so you can't go any further. My business is ruined...{0012}
With the lava blocking Hasumi Village, I'm thinking of going through Enkiri Cave to the south to do business in Inome Village.{0012}
But there's nothing over there but Inome Village and some temple or other, so it's not much of a market...{0012}

jp: そういや　あんたの犬　どうしたん？{12}

pages.en: By the way, what happened to your dog?{0012}
Gave me an awful fright, it did! A great herd of big mud dolls went walking off to the south!{0012}
Even if you go south, there's nothing there but Enkiri Cave. Where were they off to?{0012}
What'd you come to Shitaburu Village for? I'll tell you now, there's nothing in this village.{0012}

jp:
犬が…　犬が…
わしの犬が…{12}

pages.en: My dog... my dog... my dog...{0012}
What a shock! A herd of giant clay figures went walking right across the lava!{0012}
If I could ride one of those, I'd breeze right over the lava and home to Hasumi Village in Iwami...{0012}
I'm from Iwami Province to the west, see, and while I was away, a Root castle appeared over there, they say...{0012}
I'm worried about my family, so I meant to get home no matter what, but lava came spewing out at the border...{0012}
I heard a shop in Matsue Village has clay dolls that can walk on lava, but every time I go, they're sold out...{0012}
All right!{0012}

jp: {0C}{k}ハハハハ　ハハハ｜{12}

pages.en: Hahahaha, hahaha!{0012}
There's a little house at the foot of the western mountains. I reckon a Tengu probably lives there.{0012}
My dear dog was carried off by the Root... They're sure to eat him...{0012}
Whoa, you crossed the lava to Iwami Province?! Didn't you burn the soles of your feet?{0012}
You're Heroes of Fire, right...? They say a Root Clan castle has appeared in Iwami Province to the west...{0012}
But even the Heroes of Fire can't cross a sea of lava, so there's no getting to Iwami...{0012}
There's a ruin called the Kojindani Tomb in the mountains to the east. If you ask me, it's tied to the Fire Clan.{0012}
True or not, they say two dragons live somewhere around here and protect your clan.{0012}
{000C}I saw an army of clay automatons going into Enkiri Cave to the west!{0012}

jp:
{0C}東の火彦山の　さらに東の山すそに
天狗様が　お住まいだそうです{k}ゼ{12}

pages.en: {000C}They say a Tengu lives at the foot of the mountains even further east than Mt. Hahiko.{0012}
Hoh, so you've made it to Izumo at last! I reckon you know, but the birthplace of the Root Clan is in this province!{0012}
To the Root lot, it's like their own backyard, so they've got the lay of the land. Be extra careful.{0012}
Course, the Fire Clan had a few strongholds here too, it seems. Be a waste not to use them!{0012}
{000C}The scroll I'm keeping looks plain at first, but I reckon it's the most useful of all the scrolls! The Ten Thousand Baths scroll!{0012}

jp: {10}１３２{0C}万湯の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Ten Thousand Baths scroll!{0011}{0013}
{000C}Hoh, you lot already have a bagful of scrolls! Guess you don't need mine, then!{0012}
{000C}The Fire Clan used Mt. Hahiko to the west as a stronghold, it seems, but it fell to a Root lava attack and has stayed that way...{0012}
The other day, an outrageous parade marched past my door. What were those Clay Idol Robots?!{0012}
Weren't those your Fire Clan's ace in the hole, the only weapon you lot built that ever worked properly?{0012}
Don't you dare say anything as horrible as the Root Clan having taken them, not in front of me!{0012}
{000C}Before you start telling me things that are bad for my health, I'll hand over the scroll! The Hell scroll! Take it!{0012}

jp: {10}１３２{0C}地獄の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}Not that I'm knocking how you do things, but there's no way to cram another scroll into a full scroll bag.{0012}
{000C}So, they really did take your Clay Idol Robots, didn't they? That's bad! Better steel yourselves!{0012}
The Root folk of Yomotsu Slope must be... grateful to you, I think...{0012}
......Now, let me hand over the scroll I've got! It's called Triangle. They say it was an oni art to begin with!{0012}

jp: {10}１３２{0C}三角の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Triangle scroll!{0011}{001C}
Seems you can't carry any more scrolls... Stop by a storehouse or something and come back, won't you?{0012}
The Root folk of Yomotsu Slope must be... grateful to you, I think...{0012}
I won't say sacrifice comes with every battle... but there's always a little that just can't be helped.{0012}
Sorry, but could you get rid of both Dark Orchids at Izumo Shrine before you come? They're giving me bad dreams...{0012}
My grandpa told me somebody built that tower long, long ago to keep watch on the Root Clan.{0012}
On a clear day, you can see Izumo Shrine just fine from the top of the tower.{0012}
Thanks to you, the Root Clan's gone! Thank you kindly, Heroes of Fire!{0012}
You lot! With the Root Clan prowling about, you came all the way to Tamatsukuri Village?{0012}
It must have been a hard journey. Have a good long soak in our famous hot spring and ease your weary bodies.{0012}
I guided the doll shop folks from Matsue to the Kojindani Tomb, over the mountains to the south.{0012}
They cleaned the tomb right out of treasure, so there shouldn't be anything worth taking left.{0012}
Come to think of it, on the very bottom floor of the tomb there was a stone tablet with some gibberish written on it.{0012}
Seems the Root Clan has been gathering up dogs lately.{0012}
They say Shitaburu Village to the south doesn't have a single dog left! Creepy, isn't it?{0012}
Woof! Woof!{0012}

jp: {k}ワン！　ワン！　ワン！　ワーン！{12}

pages.en: Woof! Woof! Woof! Awooo!{0012}
They say a Tengu lives north of Izumo Shrine. Keeps three oni tamed, or so I hear.{0012}
They say the Root Kingdom was once no more than a little land within this Izumo Province. And I can't say it too loud, but...{0012}
...the Root Kingdom was a land made by convicts, they say... and a thousand years ago, they suddenly rose up in revolt.{0012}
I came from Hasumi in the west, but while I was soaking in the hot spring, lava blocked the road home to my village.{0012}
It happens a lot in this province, but it's a real fix... It'll take a year to clear, I reckon.{0012}

jp: {0C}また　どうぞ{12}

pages.en: Come again!{0012}
Heaven help us... Sending a huge island back and forth like that... The gods must have time on their hands.{0012}
Did you know? They say the land where the Root Clan was born lies north of this Izumo Province.{0012}
Maybe the northern land suddenly drifting off across the sea has something to do with that.{0012}
What?! The room in the watchtower opened?! So, what was the loot?!{0012}
There's a room in the watchtower that's locked, so nobody can get in! They say it won't open no matter what!{0012}
You can see a treasure chest inside. There's bound to be treasure in it! Being able to see it makes it all the more maddening!{0012}

jp: {k}ヘッ　ヘクション｜{12}

pages.en: Ah... ah-choo!{0012}
Who was it?! Who said Tamatsukuri Village was paradise, crawling with naked women?!{0012}
Listen! I've been camped out here a whole month, and the only ones who've come in are you lot and some old biddies!{0012}
Ah... ah-choo!{0012}
Who was it?! Who said Tamatsukuri Village was paradise, crawling with naked women?!{0012}
Listen! I've been camped out here half a month, and nobody's come in but old biddies!{0012}
I saw it, I tell you! Clay dolls lined up in a column like a school outing, marching off to the southwest!{0012}
What d'you suppose they were? They tramped right on through the boiling lava like it was nothing!{0012}
A peeping tom has planted himself in the hot spring, so I haven't had a bath in about a month... I'm so itchy...{0012}
Do I smell?{0012}
A peeping tom has planted himself in the hot spring, so I haven't had a bath in half a month... Now it's a contest of who gives up first!{0012}
Ahh... my Mister Kabuki! Fighting again today for me, for justice and for Jipang... Ooh la la.{0012}
Could it be you're Heroes of Fire too, like Mister Kabuki Danjuro? Mister Kabuki said...{0012}
"My little sweetheart! I fight for you, for justice and for Jipang!" and with that, he set off west!{0012}
Hero of Fire! Look! This here's my baby! Thanks to you, we're all well!{0012}
I beg you, Hero of Fire! Get rid of the Root Clan before the baby in my belly comes out!{0012}
Otherwise I'll be so worried... I won't have the heart to bring a healthy baby into the world! Please!{0012}

jp: {k}ホギ{h}ゃ！　{k}ホギ{h}ゃ！　{k}ホギ{h}ゃ！{12}

pages.en: Waah! Waah! Waah!{0012}

jp:
{0C}残念ですが今日は曇っていて
出雲大社は見えません{12}

pages.en: {000C}Sorry, it's cloudy today, so you can't see Izumo Shrine.{0012}

jp:
望遠鏡があります
のぞいてみますか？

pages.en: There's a telescope. Take a look?

jp:
{k}カギ{h}のかかった扉がある
丸いへこみがある{12}

pages.en: There's a locked door. It has a round hollow in it.{0012}

jp: {0C}何も見つからなかった…{12}

pages.en: Nothing here...{0012}
You're Fire Clan... We're Root Clan... If you want to kill us, go ahead...{0012}
We haven't long to live anyway...{0012}
We're the dregs... In this land, those unfit for battle aren't worth keeping alive.{0012}
So, to be of at least some use to Lord Yomi's revival, we're here having our lives sucked out by the Dark Orchid.{0012}
If we run, our own kind will kill us... Heh heh heh... What were we even born for...{0012}

jp:
ここが　根の一族の　出身の地
黄泉平と　知ってて来たのかえ？

pages.en: Did you know this is Yomotsu Slope, the birthplace of the Root Clan, when you came?
You must have thought it was a den of monsters. Sorry to disappoint you.{0012}
Only the soldiers have their bodies tampered with... though nearly everyone is a soldier.{0012}
We're the Root Clan, but as you can see, we're ordinary people, no different from those in the outside world...{0012}
And like the outside world, we wish someone would cut the Dark Orchid...{0012}
Going, are you, Fire Clan boy? Let me give you a word of advice. These stairs of Izumo Shrine...{0012}
...they say they connect to the next world. The ones you've beaten might be waiting there to greet you.{0012}
You're Fire Clan?! Have you found Lady Mari, who gave birth to you lot, yet?{0012}
However strong you are, you'll never beat Lord Yomi on your own.{0012}
Even a thousand years ago, in the end, it was more or less settled by Lord Yomi and Lady Mari striking each other down.{0012}
I hear the three Doctors dug Lord Yomi up from under Tanba Province and are bringing him back to life.{0012}
We're only kept alive so the Dark Orchid can drain our life force...{0012}
My body wastes away day by day, my spirit withers... but I can't escape...{0012}
If I run, my own kind will kill me. Please, Hero of Fire! Cut the Dark Orchid!{0012}
The Fire Clan...? There are still survivors... Will the Root Clan lose again...?{0012}
Well, if that is fate, so be it...{0012}
If it's the Dark Orchid you want, it's at Izumo Shrine... Climb the stairs at the back of the village. I won't stop you.{0012}

jp: 泊まってきな　火の一族｜

pages.en: Stay the night, Fire Clan!

jp: {0C}ありがとうよ…{12}

{0C}けっ……　度胸がねぇな
寝込みを　おそったりしないよ{12}

pages.en: {000C}Tch... No guts. I wouldn't jump you in your sleep.{0012}
{000C}Shall I tell you something interesting, Hero of Fire?{0012}
The moment you cut the Dark Orchid, everyone in this village will vanish from this world...{0012}
{000C}The three Doctors altered our bodies that way, so we'd guard the Dark Orchid from you with our lives!{0012}
Hee hee hee... Surprised you a little, did I?{0012}
But don't let it bother you. We'd only end up as fertilizer for the Dark Orchid or as subjects for experiments anyway.{0012}
{000C}Once you cut the Dark Orchid, we're no use anymore... we disappear. So gather your information while you can.{0012}

jp: 村雲の剣を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Murakumo Blade!{0012}
{000C}Do you remember a man named Nameless No. 18...? Yes, that's the one. He gave you trouble on Mt. Oe.{0012}
Born a Root, I figured none of them would live long... so I chose not to give them names.{0012}
{000C}He was my eighteenth child. Now the only one still alive is the first I ever bore...{0012}
That child had no name either, but Lord Yomi gave him one...{0012}
You'll meet him somewhere someday, I expect. A grand name: Wise King Goten. Remember it, if you can.{0012}
Long ago, all sorts of experiments were done here... Crossing animals of different kinds... Testing the effects of magic...{0012}
You Fire Clan are strong and never give up, so to win, they went to some pretty brutal lengths, it seems.{0012}
Nowadays they don't need to bother with all that. They're all born monsters anyway...{0012}
Thanks to you running away, the Root Clan escaped the finishing blow in the war a thousand years ago.{0012}
Mind you, if Ihika hadn't run off mid-battle, we could have finished off the Fire Clan.{0012}
Hohohoho... What goes around comes around, as they say.{0012}

jp: 月の霊薬を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Moon Elixir!{0012}
{000C}A Hero of Fire, is it...{0012}
An old man's tale runs a bit long. Will you hear it?
{000C}This place was once an island where convicts were exiled... Our ancestors were criminals...{0012}
With almost nothing to eat, they ate each other's flesh, and somehow survived...{0012}
Many died here, hating the people of the outside world.{0012}
{000C}When everyone on the island was ready to sell their souls to demons just to get out... Lord Yomi descended...{0012}
Lord Yomi said: "Take what you desire!" And so the Root Kingdom was born.{0012}
{000C}Very well, then...{0012}

jp: 式神の符を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found a Spirit Familiar Talisman!{0012}

jp: 対岸に　渡し舟が見える{12}

pages.en: There's a ferry boat on the far bank.{0012}

jp: {k}シロ{h}がやってきました{12}
{0C}{k}シロ{h}がいなくなった！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Shiro is gone!{0012}
No... it's nothing...{0012}
{000C}There's no turning back for us now, is there...{0012}
{000C}Manjimaru... Shiro will be all right. Shiro will surely come back. And...{0012}
{000C}...he will save us twice.{0012}
{000C}I'll be taking your dog. Don't worry. I just love animals.{0012}
{000C}I left the dog's collar in that wicker basket, so remember him and stew in your regret.{0012}
{000C}If you simply must have your dog back, come to Inugami Temple. You're welcome anytime.{0012}
{000C}I'm sure Shiro would love that too. Well then, ta-ta!{0012}

jp: {0C}{k}シロ{h}の首輪を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Found Shiro's Collar!{0012}

pages.en: Inugami Temple
This is Hamada Village...{0012}
Manjimaru, please defeat the Root Clan and lift the sorrow from this village...{0012}
Ah... Tsuwano's lively bustle is gone now... If only the Root Clan weren't here...{0012}
Head west from here, and you'll find the castle town of Tsuwano!{0012}
I bet Gokuraku worked up a good sweat and lost some weight, eh?{0012}
They say there's something like a shrine on Mt. Sabime to the west.{0012}
Apparently, inside it's all lava, a place like Hell.{0012}
I... urk... hah, hah... can never be Mister Kabuki's bride now... can I... Urk... uh... uh...{0012}
Huh?! You know Mister Kabuki?{0012}
I'm waiting for him here. After all, we pledged our future together...{0012}
Be sure to tell Mister Kabuki: Kiku is training to be a bride and will wait for him forever!{0012}
Urrrgh... Bleeegh! Ptoo! Ptoo! Hurk... urgh...{0012}
Hah, hah... S-sorry you had to see that...{0012}
They say there's a terribly greedy, pig-like creature in the Darkness Castle that's appeared in this province.{0012}
Urrrgh! Bleh! Blegh! Hurk! Hurk! Hurrrk... Hah... hah... urk... blehhh!{0012}
Urrrgh! Bleh! Blegh! Hurk! Hurk! Hurrrk... Hah... hah... urk... blehhh!{0012}
Urrrgh! Bleh! Blegh! Hurk! Hurk! Hurrrk... Hah... hah... urk... blehhh!{0012}
S-somehow, at least our family was spared...{0012}
But... but... *sob*... I've no will left to live...{0012}
Welcome! Our pick of the day: cheap, light and sturdy pigskin goods!{0012}
We only started making them lately, but the quality's guaranteed. Come on, have a look!{0012}
Pigs aren't just good eating! You can make all kinds of tools from the leftover hide and bones. Real handy!{0012}
There's a little hut on the eastern shore. Is that a pigsty too, I wonder... Or maybe it's a Tengu's hermitage.{0012}
Rumor says Darkness Castle has appeared in the southwest of this province.{0012}
Does that mean the Root Clan is finally starting to attack the villages around here?{0012}
I wonder if my daughters who married into Tsuwano are safe... I'm worried...{0012}
Ahh, that felt good! I gave that couple what for again today!{0012}
From now on I'll throw stones at them at least once every single day!{0012}
Listen to this! The people in this house have no blood or tears in them!{0012}
Everyone in town is suffering because of Nikusuke, and they're happily helping him!{0012}
Is that so? Nikusuke finally got what was coming to him?{0012}
Manjimaru, I'm thinking I'll become a monk now, to pray for those who died.{0012}
Oh, no, no, no... How long is this going to go on?{0012}
You're in the way, pal! If I stand around here, I'll end up Nikusuke's dinner too!{0012}
Why? Well, 'cause I've got to deliver three pigs to Nick by the end of the day!{0012}
I really don't want to do this, but if I don't, he says he'll turn my wife and kids into pigs.{0012}

jp:
{k}ブヒ　ブヒー　{h}いよいよ　{k}ブブー

The Ashimoto Brothers have finally turned over a new leaf!{0012}

You came all the way here through Enkiri Cave? Nothing happened in there?{0012}

I've heard a legend that long ago, in Izumo, the Fire Clan hauled in the Root island.{0012}
They say the two ropes they used are still lying asleep on some mountain somewhere.{0012}

Why...?! Why did my mom and dad have to be killed?! I can't go on living...{0012}
My grandpa's gone completely senile lately... But people are sad things, aren't they?{0012}
When I show him the teacup and chopsticks he always used, he comes back to his senses, just for that moment...{0012}
Masako!{0012}
Isn't supper ready yet?! *burp* You want me to starve to death?! *burp* *burp*...{0012}

The dogs' howling has stopped, but the dogs the Root Clan toyed with and killed won't come back...{0012}
Every night, I hear a dog's sorrowful howling from the west...{0012}
To me it sounds like a dog crying, "Help me, help me," and I can't bear it...{0012}
Thanks to your deeds, the evil darkness over Iwami Province has been swept away! We're truly grateful!{0012}
Far to the west, beyond the mountains, an evil darkness is spreading! There must be a Root castle there.{0012}

I hear countless dead dogs were dumped behind Inugami Temple.{0012}

Every last dog has vanished! There's a rumor the Root Clan is gathering dogs at Inugami Temple...{0012}
I hope nothing terrible happens...{0012}

"A man's dream! A palace of pleasure! To Takarazuka Village by the fast, safe Ferry Box! (Fare: free)"{0012}
Come on, sir, hop on this Ferry Box, and you'll step out in heaven on earth, Takarazuka Village! And the fare's free!{0012}
Thank you for getting rid of the Dark Orchid. Now this land will have peace.{0012}
You must be the Heroes of Fire! This is Arima Village, the northern gateway to Naniwa Province. Welcome!{0012}
The Dark Orchid that bloomed in this land has seized Sumiyoshi Shrine in the southeast! Please lend us your strength!{0012}

pages.en: I don't like the lord of Himeji. He's dumb.{0012}
Go a long way south and you'll reach Himeji Town. But Dark Orchid roots block the entrance, so you can't get in.{0012}
Kobe Village is south of Takarazuka Village. To get to Takarazuka, I think the Ferry Box there is fastest and handiest.{0012}
Ooh! The famous Hero of Fire! Isn't it Mister Man!{0012}
Do drop by Takarazuka sometime! A fellow like you is sure to be a hit, I guarantee it!{0012}
Manjimaru! I heard Saburo, the Hero of Fire from a thousand years ago, was about my age. Is that true?{0012}
If it is, that's amazing, right? How'd he mow down the Root Clan with such a small body?{0012}
I came from Kobe. Change from the Underground Steam to the Ferry Box, and let's see, it takes about five minutes.{0012}
Here in Naniwa Province there are four burial mounds bearing Saburo's name.{0012}
They say this Saburo was a Hero of Fire born in this land a thousand years ago.{0012}

pages.en: {000C}Do come again!{0012}
For us folks in business, honestly, there's nothing more welcome than this.{0012}
Come rain, come spears, come the Root Clan, this Ferry Box gets you to Takarazuka Village safe and sure!{0012}
The lord of Himeji took every last man in Takarazuka for his army, so now Takarazuka is nothing but women.{0012}
Sorry to the men of Takarazuka, but to us men from other villages, Takarazuka is paradise on earth now.{0012}
That husband of mine pours most of his wages into those vixens of Takarazuka Village, and when that's not enough, he even runs up debts...{0012}
So we just get poorer and poorer... Maybe I'll leave this house and go work in Takarazuka Village myself!{0012}
Everyone's talking about the women of Takarazuka, but believe it or not, I was a famous beauty around here once.{0012}
That's right! Everyone used to call me this!{0012}
"The White Lily of Arima"!... How it takes me back... But now... Oh! My! A head of white hair!{0012}
Believe it or not, back in the day I was the prettiest girl in Takarazuka.{0012}
In those days the men swarming around me used to praise me as "the Lovely Rose"...{0012}
But now, would you believe it! Everyone calls me "the Lousy Crone"!{0012}

jp: {k}コ…　コケー｜　コ　コ　ココー｜{12}

pages.en: Co... cock-a! Co, co, cooo!{0012}

jp: {k}コ　コケクッコー｜　コココ…{12}

pages.en: Co, cock-a-doodle-doo! Co-co-co...{0012}
Naniwa Province has lots of ways to get around, so traveling is super easy!{0012}
Riding them is super simple, but if I may explain anyway: "Walk in through the open door!" That's all!{0012}
"Hot spring paradise! Wash off all the road grime you like! To Arima Village hot springs, the Ferry Box is super handy! (Fare: free)"{0012}
Now, what shall I buy first? This village even has a shop just for ladies' goods, and the quality's good.{0012}
*sniff* *sniff*... Oh, no! You saw me looking so silly...{0012}
When I think of Dad and the others, sometimes I just want to cry...{0012}
...But I can't afford to say that! Now, to work! To work! Money! Money!{0012}
Why, you're Mister Man of the Fire Clan! I could tell at a glance.{0012}
That clever face, that healthy body, those passionate eyes burning with justice, that one-of-a-kind hairstyle nobody could copy...{0012}
Truly, a hero has a shine ordinary folk don't! I think I'm going to be dazzled! ☆☆{0012}
Some foreign ship, a southern barbarian ship they call it, came into Kobe Village to the south, so we get blond hair and blue eyes here too.{0012}
They spend freely, and they'll be going home sooner or later, so there's no messy aftermath. Lovely customers.{0012}
When we get called, we sometimes make a house call to Kobe on the Underground Steam.{0012}
With a travel surcharge, of course! And the Underground Steam gets you there in two minutes or so, so it's sweet work.{0012}

jp:

pages.en: This is heaven...{0012}
My journey ends here.{0012}
My lady pestered me, so I came shopping, see. They've got kimonos and all sorts you can't buy anywhere else.{0012}
You'll buy something for the young lady with you too, eh, pal? Women sure do eat money, don't they?{0012}
Mind you, to us connoisseurs, the woman you've fed the most money looks the prettiest... Gehehehehe...{0012}

pages.en: {000C}Thank you kindly!{0012}
Welcome, welcome to Takarazuka Village! This is where gentlemen come to wash their cares away! Enjoy yourselves to the full!{0012}
Welcome, welcome to Takarazuka Village! Here every gentleman's dream comes true, noble, samurai or farmer!{0012}
But only as far as your purse allows! ☆{0012}
My brother and I owned three storehouses in Kobe until just recently.{0012}
From our youth we worked twice as hard as anyone, and sometimes even took on dirty jobs gladly... and what we had to show for it was those storehouses.{0012}
We sold them off cheap! And with that money we bought this house! We'll spend the rest of our lives here, mad for women!{0012}
Got a problem with that?
{000C}Hush! A brat who hasn't lived half as long as us! You'll understand one day!{0012}

jp: {0C}{k}ガハハハハハハ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Gahahahahahaha!{0012}
Our granddad said the ones who founded Kobe Village are the folks who live under Kobe Village.{0012}
Locals call them the people of Ihika. A mysterious bunch, they are.{0012}
They told us all the village men died fighting the Root Clan... My husband won't be coming home either...{0012}
Well then, I'll steel myself and go as far as I have to! After all, I'm still alive!{0012}
At the parties we smile, because it's business, but behind the scenes, the women of this village are all crying...{0012}
The lord of Himeji took the village men for soldiers, so we women have to earn our living on our own...{0012}
The lord of Himeji Castle is an outrageous man. He had one of Saburo's mounds dug up just for fun.{0012}
He took our men along as diggers, and then pressed them straight into his army.{0012}
The truth is, I have an embarrassing secret I can't tell a soul...{0012}
Do you want to know?

jp: {0C}{k}ホント{h}に？

pages.en: {000C}Really?
{000C}Ohohoho... I'm a man. I didn't want to be a soldier, so I dressed up as a woman for a bit, and now I'm hooked.{0012}
{000C}Ohohoho... Well, a woman's worth more with a secret or two.{0012}

Oh! My brother! Big brother Ebisumaru! Long time no see, desu!{0012}
My friend, Mister Manjimaru! This is my big brother Ebisumaru, captain of southern barbarian ship, desu!{0012}
Me, the sea of Jipang scary, yes... Monster, it sink my ship... Me, can't go home to my country...{0012}
Before monster whirlpool sink ship, me see old tomb on Awaji Island... That surely the monster's lair, yes...{0012}

Manjimaru, thanks to you, this land was saved! Thank you so much!{0012}
Here in Naniwa Province there are four mounds named for Lord Saburo! The Belly, Chest, Hand and Foot Mounds ring the bay!{0012}
My ancestors, who crossed the seven seas and fell short of their dreams at the eastern edge of the world! Rest in peace. Amen!{0012}
You must be the Heroes of Fire. The Ihika folk underground were looking for you. Sorry for the trouble, but please go see them.{0012}
How about it?! This Kobe! The finest port town in Jipang! People and cultures from all over the world gather here!{0012}
Me, on the way to come to this port, I go sightsee Naruto Tornado in southern sea, desu!{0012}
Leaving Kobe Port to East Cape, from ship I see they build Oriental Jipang Castle, desu yo!{0012}

pages.en: {000C}Personal business after the shop closes, okay? You get it, right?{0012}
The folks who live under this village are real good sorts, see. They built the Underground Steam and the Ferry Box for us.{0012}
Nobody asked them, and they did it for free, rolling up their sleeves for others! That's admirable spirit these days!{0012}
Long ago, this Kobe Village was written with the character for "head," read "kobe." The Ihika folk gave it that name, they say.{0012}
At some point only the sound "kobe" stayed and the characters changed. Mind you, it's an odd name, isn't it?{0012}
I like the Ihika old-timers! They teach me all sorts of things! It's just...{0012}
...the look in their eyes when they say "Want me to swap your arms?" or "Want me to change your legs?" is kinda scary.{0012}
Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Earn some cash and off to Takarazuka! Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Off to Takarazuka!{0012}
I'm not earning money to go to Takarazuka Village like that guy! I'm saving up to get on a ship!{0012}
Across the great ocean, out into the world! It's sooo much bigger than this tiny Jipang!{0012}
Off to dreamy Takarazuka Village!{0012}
Sakai Village to the southeast and this Kobe Village are locked in a fierce rivalry over foreign trade.{0012}
Upstart Sakai Village is catching up with Kobe day by day, so the merchants here are getting pretty nervous.{0012}
We won't lose to the likes of Sakai! Spain, America, China, the Tagalogs, Russia, bring it on!{0012}
When a flying castle showed up after the sea castle, I thought we were done for, but that's the Heroes of Fire for you!{0012}
Duke Pepe, that's the guy.{0012}
This was before the Dark Orchid bloomed, but the lord of Himeji dug up Saburo's Foot Mound to the northeast and got something out of it, they say.{0012}
Honestly, why is it that people in power, the moment they've got a little to spare, start on nothing but nonsense?{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, is it! I'm a ninja of Iga Village!{0012}
We're continuing our search... but there's no Root castle to be found in this province. All that's left is the sea... S-surely not...{0012}
The Sandayu sisters are also working for you, Lord Manjimaru, somewhere here in Naniwa Province. You'll meet them before long!{0012}
Me, I see it... Ship me ride, it get swallowed by whirlpool... That time...{0012}
In the whirlpool, I see a roof... Me, not seeing things, no!{0012}
Sakai Village buy for more, more higher! Why Kobe Village no good?{0012}
You are hero of justice? You teach justice to this man! Justice, always on my side!{0012}
Whenever this guy's losing an argument, he suddenly can't understand a word we say! Honestly! It makes my head spin!{0012}
The Seikaiha Blade they sell at the armory here gets exported overseas too! Over there it's sold as...{0012}
...the "Blue Wave Sword." Changing the name doesn't change how strong it is, though.{0012}
That Underground Steam is mighty handy! But what makes it go, I wonder?{0012}
Hey, pal! You're Manjimaru, aren't you? The Ihika Village folks were looking for you. Said they had something important to tell you!{0012}
Thanks to you cutting the Dark Orchid, I can go peddling in Himeji again! Thanks a lot!{0012}
Himeji Town to the west has a castle, so it's a juicy town for a peddler.{0012}
But Dark Orchid roots have planted themselves right at the town entrance, so you can't get into Himeji Town.{0012}
I wonder how the people of Himeji are getting by? Do they have enough to eat?{0012}
So you're the one who cut the Dark Orchid at Sumiyoshi Shrine! You saved the lives of us merchants!{0012}
A Dark Orchid bloomed at Sumiyoshi Shrine, they say... What a thing to do to our god of business!{0012}
If I had a boat, I'd sail south down the bay right now and storm Sumiyoshi Shrine myself!{0012}
I consider myself one of the Ihika. Let me tell you something good. Listen while bowing to me.{0012}
The password for Saburo's mounds is "Deroren."{0012}
Try pressing the B Button at the likely-looking spot to the right of the entrance.{0012}
You there! I'm busy too, you know. I don't spend every single day going "Deroren, Deroren."{0012}
And of course I'm not doing Up Up Down Down Left Right Left Right B A either.{0012}
"I love you! Manjimaru!"{0012}
A man called Pepe asked me to say that when you came.{0012}
Well, surprised?
"I love you! Manjimaru!"{0012}
Yes or no, a man called Pepe asked me to say that to you.{0012}
Are you the Heroes of Fire? A thousand years ago, this village had a Hero of Fire too, Lord Saburo.{0012}
Lord Saburo was shorter than most, but he made up for it with courage and wisdom, they say. We're proud of him.{0012}

jp: 甘露丸　を見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Sweet Dew Pill!{0012}
There are Dark Orchid roots here. You can't go north from here.{0012}
If you're going to Tanba, you'd better go by the pass to the west.{0012}
Go south down this pass, and you'll see Arima Village. They've got a thing called the Ferry Box there.{0012}
The tornado to the north is gone! All right, now I can go home to Kanoko Village!{0012}
Manjimaru! I showed her a man's pride! My wife said to charge you for the treatment, but I begged her with tears in my eyes!{0012}
Truth is, I married in, see. My wife runs this inn too.{0012}
Honestly, I don't think we should take money from folks like you, fighting for Jipang.{0012}
But I married in... so please understand. Still, if you're ever hurt too badly to fight, Manjimaru, I'll show my man's pride.{0012}
So be sure to come back to this inn! That's a promise!{0012}
This is Sasayama Pass, on the border between Tanba and Naniwa.{0012}

North is Tanba Province.
South is Naniwa Province.{0012}
Want to cross the pass? No, no! There are Dark Orchid roots up ahead. You can't get through!{0012}
The folks of Nara Village to the east are working hard, building a temple to house a huge Buddha, it seems.{0012}
The Root Clan's gone from Ise now, right?!{0012}
I meant to flee to Ise, but the roots are in the way, so I can't get any further.{0012}
I don't know who made it, but a Great Buddha suddenly appeared in Nara, they say. That's... a blessing, I suppose?{0012}
If you cut the Dark Orchid in Naniwa, I think the roots up ahead will disappear too...{0012}
This is Ikoma Pass, on the border between Naniwa and Ise.{0012}

East is Ise Province.
West is Naniwa Province.{0012}
Naniwa Province is split by the bay into the north, with Himeji and Kobe, and the east, centered on Sakai.{0012}
It's quite tangled, so if you lose track of where you are, check the map at once!{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! Today, I wish to speak with you man to man, frankly!{0012}
Are you ready?

pages.en: They seem to be building something enormous.{0012}
I knew it! The castle on the northern cape was tied up with the Root Clan... I had a narrow escape...{0012}
A carpenter buddy of mine is building some weird castle on the northern cape. He asked me to join in too...{0012}
...but it stank to high heaven, so I turned him down.{0012}
Xie xie! Xie xie! Thanks to you, banzai for China! Next time I give you panda!{0012}
You are on side of justice, yes? You make Naruto whirlpool go away, yes? Too dangerous, no can sail ship!{0012}
Mister Manjimaru, me is survivor of Ebisumaru's ship... Only me and Hoteimaru, we are saved...{0012}
Me is very, very angry!! Right Hand Garnin, you absolutely, absolutely beat him!{0012}

jp: すごいっすねぇ　速鳥は｜{12}

pages.en: That Hayatori's amazing!{0012}
It's Manjimaru! Welcome to Sakai Village! Mister Hoteimaru and the others are waiting in the storehouse in the back!{0012}
Now that's one big cart!!{0012}
In the storehouse out back, a southern barbarian rounded up craftsmen and they're rushing to build some huge cart or other.{0012}
After Mister Manji leave Kobe, I carry the Ihika boy and girl to Sakai on my ship, desu!{0012}

jp:
{k}ホテイ丸{h}が書いた
速鳥の図面がある{12}

pages.en: {000C}Nothing happened.{0012}
Let's go! Mister Manjimaru! At Mister Saburo's Chest Mound, there is Hayatori power-up device, desu!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}再び　{k}ホテイ丸{h}が　仲間に加わった｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Hoteimaru rejoined the party!{0011}{006B}

Mister Manjimaru, with your hand,
please push! Red button, push, push!{0012}
Ohh! My friend, Mister Manjimaru! How are you, desu ka?{0012}
Me, I never think Heroes of Fire lose your life over such little thing!{0012}
I believe "see you again," so I make present for Mister Manjimaru, and I wait, desu!{0012}
The Hayatori planning you show me, Mister Manjimaru, I remember very hard, and I write it down, desu!{0012}
Sakai's money and Ihika's brain, they very help me! And now it is finish, desu!{0012}

Mister Manjimaru, with your hand,
please push! Red button, push, push!{0012}
{000C}To build the Hayatori my ancestors designed a thousand years ago with my own hands... it's like a dream!{0012}
It's all thanks to Mister Hoteimaru remembering the Hayatori blueprints without a single mistake. Wonderful, desu!{0012}

jp:

pages.en: {000C}To turn the Hayatori into its sea form, go to the water's edge and use the Wave Spirit Engine.{0012}
To change it back to its land form, come ashore, then use the Wave Spirit Engine.{0012}
Hear about the other Spirit Engines too?

jp:
{0C}がんばってくださいね｜
卍丸さん｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Good luck, Manjimaru!{0012}
{000C}The Tide Spirit Engine changes the Hayatori from its surface form to its undersea form, and back again.{0012}
Naturally, it can only be used on or under the sea, so be careful.{0012}
Hear about the other Spirit Engines too?
{000C}The Wind Spirit Engine switches the Hayatori between its land form and its flying form.{0012}
By the way, the Hayatori can't take off from or land on the sea. That's its one small inconvenience...{0012}
Hear about the other Spirit Engines too?
It seems the Steel Castle's propulsion system was built based on the Hayatori.{0012}
Thank you for taking our ancestors' technology back from the enemy! Lord Saburo must be overjoyed!{0012}
Ah, the day has finally come when the Hayatori dances in the sky! Ihika technology has conquered even gravity!{0012}
The Hayatori isn't complete yet... Sadly, we haven't drawn out even half its power...{0012}
In Lord Saburo's Chest, Foot and Hand Mounds, there should be three Spirit Engines that will make the Hayatori grow...{0012}
Hello, hello, hello! Me is fine Jipang person, desu! My name is Gonzalez Yamada, desu!{0012}
I married this man! I wore a frilly thing called a "wedding dress" and became a "June bride"!{0012}
It was a funny sort of wedding, but his friends and the villagers all blessed us, so I was happy.{0012}
I helped the two Ihika folks build a mechanical cart called the Hayatori... but there were loads of parts I couldn't make heads or tails of...{0012}
It gave me no end of trouble, but I stuck at it out of craftsman's pride! When it was done, I cried for joy!{0012}

jp:
なんだと｜　速鳥は…
陸の上を　走るだけじゃねぇのか｜{12}

pages.en: What?! The Hayatori doesn't just run on land?!{0012}
Anyway, I put the Hayatori together just the way the two Ihika folks told me...{0012}
But there's lots of gadgetry on it I still can't imagine a use for... It does run on land, right???{0012}

jp:
どーも　どーも　どーも
{k}イラハリ　{h}でーす！　はい　{k}プリーズ？
　{01}ＯＫ　{01}ＮＯ

pages.en:
Hello, hello, hello!
Welcome, desu! Yes, please?
   {0001}OK   {0001}NO

jp:
{0C}どーも　どーも　どーも
{k}ドチラ{h}まで？　{k}イイ{h}お天気ね｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}Hello, hello, hello! Where you going? Nice weather!{0012}
I hear you cut that ridiculously huge Dark Orchid! Not bad! That's a Hero of Fire for you!{0012}
A Dark Orchid bloomed at Sumiyoshi Shrine to the north, and the merchants around here are hopping mad that the god of commerce got trampled.{0012}
I couldn't believe my eyes when Sakai's merchants, famous for being tightfisted, gladly put up a fortune to build that mechanical tank!{0012}
That Hayatori can fly too?! With you lot, anything goes!{0012}
Rumor says the lord of Himeji stole a treasure called the Wind Spirit Engine from Saburo's Foot Mound and is keeping it hidden...{0012}
Honestly, grave robbing! That's no thing for a great lord who rules a province to be doing!{0012}
If you defeat the Makai Castle, my friend Ebisumaru surely will be happy, desu!{0012}
Oh my God! My friend Ebisumaru's ship, it wash up on the beach in pieces!{0012}
Ebisumaru also, God has called him... Mister Manjimaru! Surely you will avenge him, desu!{0012}

jp: そば団子を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Buckwheat Dumpling!{0012}
Thank you so much for cutting the Dark Orchid! They say Himeji Town has been freed too!{0012}
You must be the Heroes of Fire! I am a shrine maiden in service at Sumiyoshi Shrine...{0012}
Our Sumiyoshi Shrine has been conquered by the Dark Orchid... Please, by all means, lend us your strength!{0012}
Thank you kindly for getting our Sumiyoshi back! We'll never forget this as long as we live!{0012}
Planting such a flower in our precious Sumiyoshi without so much as a by-your-leave!{0012}
Manjimaru! We're counting on you! Take the Hayatori and give the Root Clan one real hard wallop!{0012}
Don't you go wasting the money we put up!{0012}
Thanks to you, the southern barbarian ships will come again! Now we can do business like before!{0012}
A Hayatori built with money we saved up sweating blood? No way it can lose!{0012}
I don't know what this Makai Castle is, but it's a nuisance to us too! Go get 'em! But can the Hayatori dive under the sea?{0012}
So the castle on the northern cape was a Root Clan castle... No wonder they were dressed so oddly.{0012}
There was a half-built castle on the northern cape. Some lord must be building a castle to stand against the Root Clan.{0012}
Though I can't help feeling it's a bit late for that...{0012}

jp:
がんばりなされよ！　わこうど！
応援しとりますぞ｜{12}

pages.en: Keep at it, young ones! I'm rooting for you!{0012}
I hear you got roughed up badly in Saburo's Belly Mound, but I bet you haven't learned and you'll go to the other mounds too...{0012}
Heh heh heh... Ah, to be young! Saburo's Chest Mound is south of Sumiyoshi! Saburo's Hand Mound is far north of Sumiyoshi!{0012}
Keep at it, young ones! I'm rooting for you!{0012}

jp: 巨大な暗黒{k}ラン{h}が　咲いている{12}

pages.en: A giant Dark Orchid is in bloom.{0012}
Manjimaru stood before the Dark Orchid.{0012}
Manjimaru gripped the Holy Sword Torii-do Saburo and focused his spirit!{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０卍丸は　聖剣　鳥居堂三郎　で
６本目の暗黒{k}ラン{h}を　撃破した｜
残り　あと　１本｜

pages.en:
{0010}{0090}Manjimaru destroyed the sixth Dark Orchid with the Holy Sword Torii-do Saburo!
Only one more to go!{0011}{00CD}
Thank you so much! Once Sumiyoshi Shrine is restored, the merchants of Kobe and Sakai will be delighted!{0012}
Set Kobe's and Sakai's merchants competing, and the donations pour right in. They hate to lose, you see.{0012}
Give me half a year, and I'll rebuild the shrine finer than before!{0012}
Sigh... Thanks to this Dark Orchid, the venerable Sumiyoshi Shrine is on the verge of collapse... What am I to do...{0012}
Hm? What? Are you the Heroes of Fire everyone's been talking about?!{0012}
Please, I beg you, hurry and chop down this Dark Orchid and save my shrine!{0012}
You are of the same Fire Clan as Lord Saburo, who sealed away the Root Clan a thousand years ago.{0012}
You will surely be able to defeat the Root!{0012}
Thank you, Heroes of Fire! Please keep joining forces to save Jipang!{0012}
This land has four ancient tombs called Saburo's Mounds.{0012}
Near this Sumiyoshi Shrine, too, there's the Hand Mound to the north and the Chest Mound to the south.{0012}
Thank you so much! It seems my daughter's illness was the Dark Orchid's doing after all.{0012}
She's completely cured! These days the Heroes of Fire do more good than a second-rate god!{0012}
I have a sick daughter at home. I want to cure her, so I've been coming to make a hundred visits...{0012}
But with the shrine in this state, I'm so worried my prayers won't do any good...{0012}
To make that Steel Castle his own! Lord Manjimaru is amazing!{0012}
With the Steel Castle's instant-travel mechanism, you can go anywhere you like now, Kibi Province or Aki Province!{0012}
I heard the Steel Castle has shown itself in other provinces too...{0012}
That castle must have a terrible power to move to faraway lands in an instant...{0012}
Ohh, will all of Jipang end up like Himeji?{0012}
This is Himeji, the pride of Naniwa's castle towns.{0012}
But now there's no trace of its old bustle... All the men were drafted.{0012}
Even if the Steel Castle is defeated, the men who died in battle won't come back.{0012}
It would have been better if we'd all died too... *sob*...{0012}
N-no... that army defeated?! There's nothing left that can stand against the Steel Castle! What are we to do?!{0012}
Our lord resolved to destroy the Steel Castle, gathered Naniwa's strongest men and raised an army.{0012}
Thank you, Manjimaru. The men who died can rest in peace now.{0012}

jp:
五万人　皆殺しとは…
あまりにも　むごすぎる…{12}

pages.en: Fifty thousand men, slaughtered to the last... It's far too cruel...{0012}
There are no young men in this town, are there? Our lord took them into the castle to make his army.{0012}
Nobody left but doddering old men and snot-nosed brats. What a dull town.{0012}
The men who died in battle will surely watch over Himeji.{0012}
So we won't shame them, we'll work hard and make Himeji a fine town!{0012}

jp:
鋼鉄城は　悪魔の城だわ！
私たち人間に　かないっこないのよ！{12}

pages.en: The Steel Castle is a devil's castle! We humans don't stand a chance!{0012}
They say the army our lord raised numbers fifty thousand all told.{0012}
They're massing to wipe out the Steel Castle in one blow. The call to march must be coming soon.{0012}
So that no one suffers misfortune like ours again, please, Lord Manjimaru, strike down the Root Clan with your power!{0012}
Curse you, Root Clan! Heaven will never forgive such merciless slaughter!{0012}
Go on, boast of your strength while you can! But heaven's punishment will fall, and the day of your ruin will come!{0012}
Even so great an army... can it truly stand against the Steel Castle...?{0012}
No, no... I mustn't think such worrying thoughts. Getting old turns you into a worrier. It's a nuisance.{0012}
Thank you so much, Lord Manjimaru. That's a weight off my heart.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, please help us! Himeji has no future but to rely on you.{0012}
The sight of samurai marching in armor, so gallant, always has such a fierce beauty.{0012}
I'm sure they'll scatter the Steel Castle to the winds!{0012}
You avenged us, didn't you?{0012}
May the spirits of the fifty thousand fallen be with you, Lord Manjimaru.{0012}

jp:
ひどい…　根の一族は　なんてひどいの
五万もの人を　皆殺しにするなんて…{12}

pages.en: Horrible... the Root Clan is so horrible! Slaughtering fifty thousand people...{0012}
Have you heard the rumor about our lord? They say he took ancient relics out of one of the mounds in Naniwa.{0012}
Ride the Steel Castle and you can go anywhere in Jipang! Handy for Tengu hunting, too!{0012}
The Steel Castle's destructive power is tremendous... But I saw something even more terrifying...{0012}
That giant castle vanished! And then it appeared in the sky over Kibi Province, beyond the mountains!{0012}
...O-oh, my! Now it's floating in the eastern sky! Can that castle move between provinces in an instant?!{0012}
Robbing a mound that enshrines a Hero of Fire's spirit! Our lord is asking for divine punishment.{0012}
I hope no terrible calamity comes back to haunt us someday...{0012}

jp: お助けくだされ　卍丸殿！{12}

pages.en: Please help us, Lord Manjimaru!{0012}

jp: ここは　姫路城でござる{12}

pages.en: This is Himeji Castle.{0012}

jp: どうぞ　お入りくだされ{12}

pages.en: Please, come in.{0012}

jp: 火の一族が　何用でござるかな{12}

pages.en: What business has the Fire Clan here?{0012}

jp:
なんで　町の人たちは
みんな　泣いてるのかな{k}ァ？{12}

pages.en: Why is everybody in town crying?{0012}

jp:
{k}エーン　エーン
{h}お腹　へったよー！{12}

pages.en: Waaah, waaah! I'm hungry!{0012}

jp:
娘は　まだ幼くて
戦争というものを　知らないのです{12}

pages.en: My daughter is still little. She doesn't know what war is.{0012}
Dark Orchid roots have cut off the roads, so we can't even buy food. We haven't eaten anything for days...{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, please avenge us on that Steel Castle, which took from us what we held most dear.{0012}

jp:
やはり…　勝ち目のない
いくさじゃったか…{12}

pages.en: So... it was a war we could never win after all...{0012}
Destroy the Steel Castle in one blow, he says?! What a foolish lord! Can't he see this is a Root trap?{0012}
He gathered a great army of fifty thousand, then the roots cut off his supply lines. The food's run out, and the soldiers are reeling.{0012}
Attack now, and it's plain as day they'll be cut to pieces!{0012}

jp:
うそだい　うそだい
父ちゃんが　死んだなんて…{12}

pages.en: That's a lie, that's a lie! My dad's not dead...{0012}

jp: 早く　父ちゃん　帰ってこないかな～{12}

pages.en: My dad's really strong! I hope he hurries and beats the Steel Castle!{0012}
My son will surely grow up to be a bigger man than his father and protect Himeji.{0012}

jp:
ううう…　とても　息子に言えないわ
お父さんが　死んだなんて…{12}

pages.en: Ohh... I can't bring myself to tell my son that his father is dead...{0012}
My son adores his father, and says he wants to be a soldier like him when he grows up.{0012}
For this child's sake, I hope he comes home safe...{0012}
In war, it's always the women and children who get hurt.{0012}
If only a peaceful world without strife would come soon...{0012}

jp:
根の一族に殺された
孫が　不{k}ビン{h}でならぬ…{12}

pages.en: My poor grandson, killed by the Root Clan...{0012}
Our lord is terribly vain. He thinks that if everyone just does as he says, everything will go his way.{0012}
But will that thinking work on the Root Clan, I wonder...{0012}
But... where on earth did the Root Clan hide Lady Mari...?{0012}
Hide her someplace half-baked and you lot would sniff her out sooner or later... A place that's totally safe would be...{0012}
Thinking hard for the first time in ages has given me a headache...{0012}
Well, if it were me... I'd probably eat her.{0012}
You went to the trouble of finding a Tengu, but with your scroll bag full, it's no use! Come back later!{0012}
I heard a little something... It seems Lady Mari, the Fire Clan's last hope, has fallen into the Root Clan's hands...{0012}
What a mess this has turned into... What're you gonna do?! However strong you are, you don't stand a chance against Yomi!{0012}
Now there's nothing for it but to stop Yomi's revival, no matter what... Hurry, Heroes of Fire!{0012}
I'll hand over the Violet Lightning scroll I've been guarding! It's a hit-or-miss technique, but it should hold up fine in a real fight!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}紫電の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Got the Violet Lightning scroll!{0011}{0048}
Any fool who comes visiting a Tengu with a full scroll bag gets none of my scrolls!{0012}
Kinu, was it? I heard she was Shuten-doji's daughter, so I figured she'd be some fearsome brute of a woman...{0012}
She's a hundred times better than the usual dames! And I don't know what happened, but she's got a fine face, like she's shaken something off!{0012}
{000C}Deheheheh... Found yourself a fellow you like, have you?{0012}
Hey, Manjimaru! Try giving this girl all sorts of scrolls! Kinu as she is now can handle anything!{0012}
Take my Star Slumber scroll along too! Of course Kinu can use it!{0012}

jp: {0C}{10}１３０星寝の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Star Slumber scroll!{0011}{004C}
That bunch who supposedly wiped out the oni of Mt. Oe in Omi Province... rumor says they're Root agents.{0012}
Their boss is the supreme commander of a Root castle called Hakugin Castle that's appeared south of Hiroshima, they say.{0012}
Can't be too careful! Going by how he attacked Mt. Oe, he's got to be a real maniac!{0012}
{000C}Up against someone like that, you'll have it rough... Let this help a bit! I'm giving you the Star Slumber scroll!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}星寝の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}{0010}{0090}Got the Star Slumber scroll!{0011}{004C}
{000C}Deheheheh... Found yourself a fellow you like, have you?{0012}
Hey, Manjimaru! Try giving this girl all sorts of scrolls! Kinu as she is now can handle anything!{0012}
And of course, Kinu can use my Star Slumber scroll too!{0012}
I handed you the Star Slumber scroll, but... seems none of you can use it.{0012}
This technique's a good one... but it's picky about who uses it...{0012}
Come to think of it, what about that Kinu girl? She ought to be able to use it...{0012}
Kinu, was it? I heard she was Shuten-doji's daughter, so I figured she'd be some fearsome brute of a woman...{0012}
She's a hundred times better than the usual dames! But hey... with a gloomy face like that, no fellow will come near... And besides...{0012}
She can't use the Star Slumber scroll I gave you either. This technique's a good one... but it's picky about who uses it...{0012}
Well, they say a woman in love becomes a whole new person. Maybe she'll be able to use it someday.{0012}
{0010}{0090}Hyeee! Help me, pleeease!{0011}{007F}
Mister Manjimaruuu!{0012}

jp: 脳波{k}ヘルム{h}を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Brainwave Helm!{0012}
Welcome to the Steel Castle, young Manjimaru! First the sea, now the sky... you do work hard, don't you?{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}さて　{11}３５この城の細工を　説明しよう｜{12}

pages.en: Now, let me explain this castle's little tricks!{0012}
Step on these tiles, and you may lose the use of your techniques, or your HP may drop.{0012}
I've prepared several kinds, so step on them yourself and find out what they do. And another thing...{0012}
Duke Pepe begged us most earnestly, so we're in the middle of remodeling his body.{0012}
He's a bit different from the Pepe of yesterday, so look forward to it! You'll meet him soon!{0012}

jp: 烈火の鎧を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found the Raging Fire Armor!{0012}

jp: 沈黙の兜を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: Found a Helm of Silence!{0012}
Ohh, my friend, Mister Manjimaru! You come to save me, thank you! Thank you very much!{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０{0C}{k}ワタシ　{h}お礼に　卍丸{k}サン{h}に
{k}ビッグ　プレゼント　{h}あります{k}デース{12}

pages.en: To thank you, I have big present for Mister Manjimaru, desu!{0012}
This Steel Castle, desu!!{0012}
While I am captured here, I steal this castle's driving technique!{0012}

jp:
{10}１３１{0C}{k}ワタシ　{11}５{h}これから　{11}１０鋼鉄城の{11}５{k}キャプテン
{11}５{h}やらさして　{11}５もらい{k}マースデース｜{12}

pages.en: From now, I will be captain of Steel Castle, desu desu!{0012}
And this calls the Steel Castle: the Electronic Flag, desu!{0012}
A summer gift for Mister Manjimaru, desu!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}卍丸は　電子の手旗を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Manjimaru got the Electronic Flag!{0011}{0067}

jp: {0C}卍丸の道具袋に　空きがありません{12}

pages.en: {000C}Lord Manjimaru is a true hero.{0012}
{000C}So you are the famed Manjimaru of the Fire Clan?{0012}
Your labors end here. Leave the Root Clan to my army!{0012}

jp: 見事な　いくさぶりでございました{12}

pages.en: A splendid battle it was.{0012}
{000C}Ah, if only we'd left it to the Fire Clan from the start...{0012}
Look, Lord Manjimaru! Now begins the great battle that will decide the realm! It's the end of the Steel Castle!{0012}
This war has taught me well: every man has his own measure.{0012}
I'm not cut out for war. From now on, I'll build a peaceful town where the people can live in safety.{0012}
That is the only atonement I can make to the women.{0012}
