お救いくださいませ{12}

pages.en: Please, I beg you, save Himeji.{0012}
{000C}...It seems your bags are full. Sort out your belongings and come again.{0012}
N-no... it can't be... My... my army... wiped out...{0012}
Wh-what am I to do... They're sure to attack this castle too...{0012}
{000C}I'm a fool! I should never have meddled with the Root Clan so rashly! I should have relied on the Fire Clan!{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, I beg you! Lend me your strength! Yes, I'll hand over this treasure!{0012}
{000C}Oh! You must be Manjimaru of the Fire Clan! Welcome!{0012}
What?! You've come for the thing I dug out of Saburo's Foot Mound?{0012}
No, no! I found it! It's my treasure! Fire Clan or not, I won't hand it over!{0012}
{000C}Never mind that! Look! Watch my elite army in action!{0012}
I've just given the order to march! They'll soon clash with the Steel Castle!{0012}
Behold my power! The power of my army!{0012}
{000C}My army will destroy the Root's demon castle, which I thought only the Fire Clan could defeat! Wahaha!{0012}
Come, Lord Manjimaru, let us watch my army's grand moment from a spot with a better view!{0012}
{000C}The Fire Clan has such wonderful power. I can't help admiring you... *blush*{0012}
{000C}Lord Manjimaru, please help us!{0012}
Borrow the strength of the Tengu who lives on the beach beyond the northern mountains too, and protect Himeji!{0012}
{000C}It's no use trying to get the treasure Father dug out of the mound.{0012}
No matter how much I beg, he won't give it to me. He seems to treasure it terribly.{0012}

jp: 米拾預り証を　見つけた！{12}

pages.en: {000C}Found a Rice Deposit Slip: 10!{0012}
Here in this land, our ancestors met a child of the Fire Clan.{0012}
He was smaller than any of the Fire Clan they had ever seen, weaker, and clumsy with techniques, they say. But...{0012}
His will to win was beyond anything... He asked our ancestors to remodel his body in ways never tried even by the Root.{0012}
And so he gained the power to stand among the seven Heroes of Fire. Yes! He was Saburo!{0012}
Do your best, Heroes of Fire! The future of this land is in your hands!{0012}
Th-the Fire Clan?!{0012}
The elders often tell us of the heroic deeds of Lord Saburo, the Hero of Fire from a thousand years ago, but this is the first time in my life I've seen the real thing!{0012}
Come, come in! Everyone has been waiting so eagerly for you to arrive!{0012}

jp: 山彦の巻物を　見つけた｜{12}

pages.en: Found the Echo scroll!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}山彦の巻物を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: Found a Cat Elixir!{0012}
Lord Saburo's end was a fierce one, they say... He blew himself up, taking thirty thousand Root soldiers with him...{0012}
I heard his body was torn apart so badly that even our ancestors' technology couldn't restore it...{0012}
The Ihika brought Lord Saburo's remains back here to Naniwa and laid them to rest with care in four mounds.{0012}
The Root Clan, who found Yomi under the earth of Tanba Province, probably found Lady Mari at the same time...{0012}
Just as we fear Yomi's revival, the Root Clan must fear Lady Mari's revival above all!{0012}
To keep her from ever meeting the Heroes of Fire, they will try to seal Lady Mari somewhere utterly out of reach...{0012}
{000C}Yes... for instance...{0012}
If it were me...{0012}
To Yomi...{0012}
I'd have Yomi swallow her...{0012}
So that the Ihika bloodline would not die out, our ancestors split into several groups and fled the Root Kingdom a thousand years ago, they say.{0012}
And I hear some of those who reached Naniwa crossed the border again and fled into Ise Province.{0012}
Had I known you would ride the Hayatori in Lord Saburo's place, I'd have left Torii-do standing...{0012}
Our ancestors were building an all-purpose war machine called the Hayatori for Lord Saburo, they say. But...{0012}
With Lord Saburo's death, the plan was abandoned... and the Hayatori was buried with his remains, I hear.{0012}
Even now, the secrets of the all-purpose war machine Hayatori must sleep in the four mounds, along with Lord Saburo.{0012}
Designed by our ancestors, and finished by our hands, their descendants: the Hayatori! Wonderful! Wonderful!{0012}
It seems the Hayatori our ancestors designed was a war machine that could run on water and under water just as it did on land.{0012}
The records say the blueprints for the all-purpose war machine Hayatori were laid in Saburo's Belly Mound on Awaji Island.{0012}
If you bring us those blueprints, I think even we could somehow build the Hayatori.{0012}
All we wish is to go on living in peace with the people of this village.{0012}
Our Ihika ancestors set a simple mechanism at the entrance of Lord Saburo's tombs to protect them.{0012}
No one who doesn't know the password can set a single foot inside. Let me tell you the password.{0012}
"Deroren"... In the Ihika tongue, it's a beautiful word meaning "hope for tomorrow."{0012}
Kobe was originally land our ancestors received from the Fire Clan. Back then, it was a nameless village...{0012}
After Lord Saburo's head was buried here, the village was named "Kobe," which means "head."{0012}
Over the years only the sound "kobe" remained and the name's characters changed, but the people's love for Lord Saburo hasn't.{0012}

jp:
なるほど！　海に潜んでおりましたか…
とにかく　ご無事で　なによりでした{12}

pages.en: I see! So it was lurking in the sea... In any case, I'm so glad you're safe.{0012}
All this land has is a Dark Orchid. There's no sign of a Root castle anywhere now...{0012}
But it's surely lurking somewhere! Be careful! They're plotting something!{0012}
We're proud that the two from our village who went to Sakai Village were of use to you, Lord Manjimaru.{0012}
After you went to Awaji Island, Lord Manjimaru, two from this village set off for Sakai Village on another southern barbarian ship.{0012}
If you're going to Awaji Island, home of the Belly Mound, one of Saburo's mounds, you'd best get a ride on a southern barbarian ship.{0012}

jp:
卍丸殿は　まるで　三郎様の
生まれ変わりのようじゃ！{12}

pages.en: Lord Manjimaru is like Lord Saburo reborn!{0012}
If you go into Saburo's mounds, be careful. There should be mechanisms to keep intruders out.{0012}
But knowing the Ihika's nature, they're sure to have made a device somewhere that shuts them off easily, too.{0012}
I've been waiting for you, young Manjimaru! Welcome to Makai Castle!{0012}
How do you like riding the Hayatori? Our Ihika science is something, isn't it?{0012}
Oh, yes, the Hayatori blueprints you lost are in our hands now. We've studied them thoroughly.{0012}
I mean to fit an improved version of the Hayatori's propulsion to the castle we're building. I expect I'll be able to show it to you someday.{0012}
That is, of course, if you make it out of this castle alive...{0012}
Good luck, young Manjimaru!{0012}

So you beat Garnin of the Right, and splendidly! I'm so glad to see you getting stronger and stronger!{0012}
I don't want anyone but me to hurt you. You understand, don't you?{0012}
Anyway, today I've come to invite you to the grand unveiling of my new castle.{0012}
I love you.{0012}
Hyeee! Help me, pleeease! Mister Manjimaruuu!{0012}
A Tengu lives at the foot of the northern mountains. If you haven't visited yet, be sure to go.{0012}
M... Mama... Come back to me! If you can't, at least stop taking my money!{0012}

pages.en: Is it true Dad and the others were all killed by the Root castle, and died for nothing?
{000C}You! Even if they died for nothing, at a time like this you tell the family they died nobly! Idiot!{0012}

pages.en: While you're dancing, you can forget all your troubles and sorrows!{0012}
Hey! Dance and sing! I've got money! Hey! Hey! Hey, hey!{0012}
Hey! Spend it, spend it! We'll take all the money you've got! Hey! Hey! Hey, hey!{0012}
Invincible Manjimaru, with a Steel Castle that flies to any province in an instant! Nothing to fear now!{0012}

pages.en: The Ihika folk underground were looking for you all again!{0012}
"I love you! Manjimaru!"{0012}
That man Pepe's last request was for me to say this to you when you came.{0012}
Well, surprised?
{000C}"Even in death, I love you! Manjimaru!"{0012}
Yes or no, it was Pepe's last wish that I say this to you.{0012}

Oni came over from the San'in side, built themselves a castle called Yagui Castle, and now they live up in the northern mountains.{0012}
Seems some friends of theirs are in Nagato Province too. Well, none of my business.{0012}
Kyoto's in a terrible state, they say, and there's a rumor a Root castle is lurking in the north of this province too...{0012}
{000C}You're the only ones we can count on now! Won't you say "Leave it to me!"? Even if it's a lie!{0012}
{000C}You're the only ones we can count on now! Won't you say "Leave it to me!"? Even if it's a lie!{0012}
Travelers! Welcome to Kurashiki Village! It's nothing but storehouses, but make yourselves at home!{0012}
If you're headed for Aki Province, go a little north, then walk a long way west, and you'll reach Fukuyama Village. Past that is Aki Province.{0012}
I've seen that girl with you somewhere... Come to think of it, she's the spitting image of a beauty I met up in the mountains a while back!{0012}
The other day, a girl called Kinu asked me which way Nagato was, so I told her west, and right before my eyes...{0012}
...she vanished... First time in my life a ghost ever asked me for directions. My legs gave out!{0012}
There's supposed to be a village called Kajin somewhere in this Kibi Province. You folks ever been?{0012}
This Kurashiki Village has so many storehouses that there are one or two whose tenants nobody knows.{0012}
Even I, born and raised in Kurashiki, have never once seen some of them open. This Azo Storehouse here is one.{0012}
So! What treasure was in the Azo Storehouse? Why, I've had my eye on it since I was a kid!{0012}
You, sir, by the look of you, aren't in any respectable line of work, are you? Oh, never mind, that's neither here nor there.{0012}
Whoever got it, however they got it, goods or money, once it's in a storehouse in this village, it's perfectly safe!{0012}
Who rents a storehouse and what's inside: as long as we're paid, it vanishes from our heads at once.{0012}

jp:
この倉が有名な　開かずの鶴姫倉さ
この倉の借り主の名を　教えようか？

pages.en: The never-opened Tsuruhime Storehouse. Who rents it?
{000C}I'm telling only you, so don't you breathe a word to anyone!{0012}
It's Tsuruhime...{0012}
{000C}And here I was going to tell you it's rented by Lady Tsuruhime, queen of the mermaids of Senkaigu in the sea of Aki Province...{0012}
The peace of Jipang rests on your shoulders, Heroes of Fire! We're rooting for you!{0012}
On the eastern tip of the southern peninsula there lives a Tengu, oh, so merciful. Don't forget to visit!{0012}
You must be Manjimaru of the Fire Clan. Welcome to Okayama Town, and thank you for coming.{0012}
Is it true there's an oni castle in this Kibi Province, led by an oni called Ura?{0012}

jp:
北の山向うに　根の一族の城が
あるという噂を　聞いたんだが…{12}

pages.en: I heard a rumor there's a Root Clan castle beyond the mountains to the north...{0012}
Cross the bridge to the west and go up the river, and there's a cave called Tsukuriyama Cave.{0012}
They say past that cave there's an oni castle called Yagui Castle.{0012}
Looks like Kyoto is the place for the final battle. Give it your all, Manjimaru!{0012}
A few days ago, a noble lady named Aya came to town.{0012}
She's looking for her daughter, they say. In times like these, parents and children torn apart is nothing rare, though.{0012}

jp:
山あいにあった　根っ子が消えて
北のほうに　行けるようになったよ{12}

pages.en: The roots in the mountains are gone, so now we can go north.{0012}
Isn't Aya the woman who was carried off from Kyoto by Shuten-doji? Lots of people say they've seen her lately...{0012}
The one who was taken to Mt. Oe and, rumor had it, died striking him down in the end... So she was alive!{0012}
Oh, Kinu, you look somehow prettier! Did something nice happen?{0012}

jp:
暗黒{k}ラン{h}は　いったい
何本あるのかしら♀{12}

pages.en: How many Dark Orchids are there, anyway?!{0012}
Tch! I swiped the drawstring pouch the old man in that house always treasures...{0012}
...and all that was in it was a pair of stinky dentures!{0012}
They say a Root Clan castle has gone up in Aki Province next door. I hope the people there are all right...{0012}

jp: がんばってね　お兄ちゃん{12}

pages.en: Good luck, mister!{0012}
There's a weird rumbling from the north! I bet it's the Root Clan!{0012}

jp:
あ～あ　外に　出れなくて
退屈だなあ{12}

pages.en: Huh? The lady behind you looks like Auntie Aya who came the other day!{0012}
*Cough* *cough*! Some murky black pollen keeps blowing in from the west!{0012}
A Dark Orchid bloomed in Kyoto?! That's Jipang's holiest ground, protected by countless gods and Buddhas!{0012}
Were the seven Dark Orchids cut so far just a prelude?!{0012}

jp:
北のほうは　溶岩が多いから
歩くときは　気をつけなきゃ{k}ダメ{h}だよ{12}

pages.en: There's lots of lava up north, so be careful where you walk!{0012}
Welcome to Osafune, village of swordsmiths! In this village, cheap swords like the Famed Hoemaru Blade or the Divine Thunder Blade are an embarrassment!{0012}
Go a long way west from this village, and there's a place called Kurashiki Village.{0012}
There are about ten storehouses there, and two of them have never been opened since way back, they say.{0012}
They say a Root castle called Hakugin Castle has appeared in Aki Province next door.{0012}
Everything there's frozen over, and around Hiroshima it's freezing cold, like winter's come back!{0012}
I hear you brought down Hakugin Castle in Aki Province!{0012}
Not bad!{0012}
There really are look-alikes in this world. The other day I saw a woman who looked just like the girl with you!{0012}
Mind you, she was a good twenty years older. But they looked as alike as mother and daughter.{0012}
Long ago, a swordsmith came to the village, and he taught swordsmithing to this Osafune.{0012}
They say that man had trained in a place called Kajin.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! I have seen thousands of battles in my time...{0012}
And I have come to understand!{0012}
Battles take many turns, but when they end, one of two things remains: life or death!{0012}
Lord Manjimaru, for Jipang's sake, always fight the battle that keeps you alive! I beg you!{0012}
Lord Manjimaru... I have heard that your father died in this land...{0012}

They never got to know a single happy thing... so why did they have to die...?{0012}
Tell me, Manjimaru! What... what can I do for them?{0012}
Never, ever will I forgive the Root Clan!!!{0012}

pages.en: {0010}{0090}He learned the sword art Matsumushi Slash!{0011}{003E}
Nobody believes me, but I've seen a mermaid out off the south coast... Nah, you don't have to believe me.{0012}
But someday I want to meet a mermaid again and be friends with her. Nah, go ahead and laugh.{0012}
On the peninsula south of this village there's a shrine called Kameyama Shrine, where you can pray for long life.{0012}
With the Root Clan around, these parts have gotten dangerous, so I haven't been able to go pray for half a year.{0012}

jp:
亀山神社の　{k}ミコ{h}さんの占いは
よぉ　当ると評判なんじゃ！{12}

pages.en: The shrine maiden's fortunes at Kameyama Shrine are famous for coming true!{0012}
Ever since an ice castle called Hakugin Castle appeared south of Hiroshima, it's like midwinter has come back!{0012}
With weather like this at this time of year, there'll be no harvest to speak of. Folks will be starving by year's end...{0012}
Thanks to you, Lord Manjimaru, the fields and rice paddies look like they'll recover! Thank you so much! I love you!{0012}
Long ago, they say, a young samurai raced across this Seto Inland Sea on the back of a giant turtle. Kind of dashing, isn't it?{0012}
With the Fire Clan's power, I'm sure you can overcome anything! Do your best!{0012}

jp: {k}クシュン！　クシュ…　クシュン｜{12}

pages.en: Achoo! Achoo... achoo!{0012}

jp: {k}ワワン｜　ワン｜　ワン｜　ワワン｜{12}

pages.en: Woof woof! Woof! Woof! Woof woof!{0012}
They say the hidden fortunes of every famous rich man in these provinces are gathered in Kurashiki Village in Kibi Province.{0012}
You see, as long as they're paid, they'll rent a storehouse to anybody, without asking what's going in it.{0012}
A thousand years ago, Lord Yoshitsune, Hero of Fire, rode a giant turtle and raced freely across the Seto Inland Sea, they say...{0012}
That turtle is this shrine's sacred body: Lord Benkei of Mt. Kameyama.{0012}
Lord Benkei... Lord Benkei has come back to life! His noble form from a thousand years ago has returned to the Seto Inland Sea! Now all will be well!{0012}
I've come to pray for long life. This Kameyama Shrine honors a giant turtle. They do say a turtle lives ten thousand years, and a crane a thousand.{0012}
Whoa! I know they say turtles live ten thousand years, but a turtle from a thousand years ago still alive?!{0012}
As you can see, half the town's frozen, so by our lord's kindness, the townsfolk are sleeping in the castle.{0012}
Some time back, I heard there's a village of monsters called Kajin Village in the west of Kibi Province.{0012}
Most of the townsfolk took shelter in the castle, so there are lots of empty houses. It's not safe, so we're standing guard.{0012}
Not that anyone could get into a frozen house to steal anything anyway. Brr, it's cold!{0012}
I'm glad the ice from Hakugin Castle melted, but now it's suddenly this hot... Armor's hot enough to kill you.{0012}
What a pain... this ice! Step on it and you can't stop! I fall down a hundred times a day!{0012}
What a pain... this heat! It's so hot I get dizzy! I fall down a hundred times a day!{0012}
They say there's an oni castle in Kibi Province! Seems they came all the way from Mt. Oe in Omi!{0012}
Two women who looked awful out of place among the Root folk went into Hakugin Castle, towering over the sea to the north!{0012}
You young folks smashed the Root castle out at sea, didn't you? Thank you kindly! Thank you kindly!{0012}
A Root Clan Dark Orchid has bloomed smack in the middle of Nagato Province to the west.{0012}
On windy days the pollen blows over, and it gives me headaches and makes me queasy. It gets me down...{0012}
They cut the Dark Orchid in Nagato, and now it's Kyoto?! It's all up to the Heroes of Fire now!{0012}
Listen! Ever since that castle called Hakugin Castle appeared offshore, we can't catch a single fish!{0012}
It got me so sore I thought I'd at least help myself to Hakugin Castle's treasure, but I slipped on the ice and couldn't get near...{0012}
They say the lord of Hiroshima has decided to build a huge torii gate on the island where Hakugin Castle stood, to honor Princess Aya's spirit.{0012}
And he's renaming the island Miyajima, the Shrine Island! Isn't that splendid!{0012}
Welcome to Iwakuni Village! Please stay the night here.{0012}
To get to Nagato Province, it's best to cross Nishiki Pass to the north and head west.{0012}
In Hiroshima Town, just north of Hakugin Castle, half the town is frozen, they say. This village will freeze soon too...{0012}
Thank you, Lord Manjimaru! Your burning passion melted the ice of Hakugin Castle! Amazing!{0012}

jp:
待っとったぞ｜
さあ　どの巻物の　技の数を
減らしてほしいんじゃ？{12}
今すぐ　やるか？　それとも
少し考えてからにするか？　どうする？

a bit first? What'll you do?

pages.en: {0016}Choose carefully!

jp: {0C}ほんとうにいいな？

pages.en: {000C}You're really sure?
{000C}Hurry up and decide! Stop dawdling! Even while we stand here, Yomi may be reviving!{0012}
I've come here from Kibi Province to the east, by way of Fukuyama Village.{0012}
On the road I saw a lady who looked like the girl with you being hauled off by a suspicious band.{0012}
The Root lot are searching high and low for something called the Aoba Flute, see. And the oni have it, they say.{0012}
If the oni had just handed it over, but they wouldn't, so the Root Clan burned down the oni capital in Omi, they say.{0012}
Come to think of it, there's been a creepy rumbling in northern Kibi lately. Could be the Root Clan again...{0012}
The oni chased out of Mt. Oe in Omi by the Root Clan went and fled over here, of all places...{0012}
They can flee where they like, but I can't shake the feeling those oni brought the Root Clan with them.{0012}
Legend says that Mt. Kameyama, by Kameyama Shrine, was really a living giant turtle until a thousand years ago...{0012}
His name was... Benkei, I believe! A strong-sounding name, eh? Well, it's just a legend.{0012}
You brought Benkei of Kameyama back to life?! The real thing beats the legend by a mile!{0012}

jp: {k}クウーン　クゥーン{12}

pages.en: *Whine* *whine*...{0012}
I have some small skill in fortune-telling. Let me read your fortunes.{0012}
I have some small skill in fortune-telling. Let me read your fortunes.{0012}
I saw a faint light being swallowed by a vast darkness...{0012}
To break the curse on Lord Benkei, who is sealed in Mt. Kameyama to the east, you need a thing called the Aoba Flute...{0012}
But where that flute is, we have no idea... Only...{0012}
We have heard tell that the oni took it from the Root a thousand years ago.{0012}
Ahh... If only we had the Aoba Flute... Play it before Mt. Kameyama, and Lord Benkei would surely come back to life!{0012}
I've heard that somewhere in the wide sea of Aki Province, there's a temple called Senkaigu, built by mermaids.{0012}
With Lord Benkei's help, finding Senkaigu should be easy.{0012}
I've heard there's a mermaid village somewhere in this province.{0012}
They say one of the Heroes of Fire from a thousand years ago came from that village...{0012}
Oh! You've come to! Don't worry about what I spent treating you; our lord gave me the money.{0012}
Our lord told me the Heroes of Fire are Jipang's treasure, so I'm to look after them whenever they come back beaten.{0012}
I'd have done it even without his orders, but he gave me money for medicine and all, so that's a comfort.{0012}
Mister Hero of Fire! The one blooming in Nagato Province next door is the seventh and last Dark Orchid, right?{0012}
We just have to hang on till you cut the last Dark Orchid, right? Beat it for sure!{0012}
We just have to hang on till you cut the last Dark Orchid, right? Beat it for sure!{0012}
Kinu, was it? You seem to have found a man you love. Your skin has a woman's glow now.{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! Fighting for this land is all very well, but fighting for one woman is what makes a man too!{0012}
Maybe I'm imagining things, but... I can't shake the feeling the Root Clan still has some trump card hidden...{0012}
The Root Clan is sure to make one last stand, but you'll be fine, Manjimaru! I believe in you!{0012}
Hang in there, young'uns! I'm leaving this land's future to you, lock, stock and barrel!{0012}
...is what the old lady next door said! Good luck, Manjimaru!{0012}

jp:
月並みなお礼の言葉は　他の人から
耳に{k}タコ{h}ができるほど　聞いただろ？
だから　おいらは　何も言わないよ{12}
別に　いいだろ？

pages.en: You must've heard the same old thank-yous from everybody else till your ears hurt, right? So I won't say anything.{0012}
That's fine, isn't it?

jp: {0C}さすがは　火の勇者だ｜{12}

pages.en: {000C}That's a Hero of Fire for you!{0012}

jp: {0C}あ　り　が　と　う　{12}

pages.en: In the east of Aki Province there's a shrine called Kameyama Shrine, dedicated to a turtle. Old folks go there to pray for long life.{0012}
Mt. Kameyama by the shrine is just like its name: a mountain like a great big turtle. It almost looks alive.{0012}
Bless us... bless us... The turtle of Mt. Kameyama really was alive! I can't let him outlive me!{0012}
Ayaki Castle, was it? It doesn't seem tied to the Root, but there's an oni castle in Nagato Province, they say.{0012}
Dark Orchids, Hakugin Castle... and now oni too... Whatever it is, I wish they'd stop wrecking our land as they please!{0012}

jp:
卍丸さん　じきに平和になるんじゃろ？
あんたを信じて　待っててええんか？

pages.en: Manjimaru, peace will come soon, right? Can I trust you and wait?
{000C}Thank you. Even knowing it's just comfort, it makes an old man happy. Keep at it!{0012}
{000C}Anyway, while I'm still alive, I want a world without fighting...{0012}
It was a good while back, but a fisherman buddy of mine made a big fuss about finding a mermaid island far out to the east.{0012}
Huh? That fisherman buddy?{0012}
He drowned in the bath and died.{0012}
Looking out to sea, I sometimes see a Root ship anchored at the southernmost edge of the ice around Hakugin Castle...{0012}
What are they doing out there, anyway... Maybe there's some unexpected secret way into Hakugin Castle.{0012}
Thanks to you risking your lives to wreck Hakugin Castle, we can go fishing like before! Thanks!{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０手間のかかる　お嬢ちゃんだぜ
鬼でも　人でも　いいじゃねえかよ{12}

pages.en: What a handful that girl is. Oni or human, what does it matter?{0012}
If we don't hurry, the castle'll come down. Can't be helped. Guess I'll go fetch her.{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０{0C}女ひとりのために　命を捨てるとは
俺にふさわしい　死に方だぜ

pages.en:
{0010}{0090}Throwing my life away for a woman...
Now that's the way for me to die.{0011}{00A2}

心配じゃ{11}１０　わしも行ってくるわ{12}

pages.en: I'm not easy leaving it all to Kabuki. I'll go too.{0012}

pages.en: Manjimaru, you stay here. Nobody but you can use the Holy Sword.{0012}

{11}２０おまえひとりでも　やれるな{12}

pages.en: There's just one Dark Orchid left. You can manage it on your own, eh?{0012}

{0C}そのとき　聖剣が
卍丸に　語りはじめた{12}

pages.en:
{000C}Just then, the Holy Sword
began to speak to Manjimaru.
Manjimaru! I am the Holy Sword Jakouin Matsumushi!{0012}
Do you still not understand that you alone can hold Kinu's soul close?{0012}
Manjimaru! Save Kinu! I beg you, as one born a Hero of Fire, and as a woman like her!{0012}
When Kinu opens her heart, the bond between the four of you will grow stronger still.{0012}

jp: 青葉の笛は　壊れてしまった{12}

pages.en: The Aoba Flute broke.{0012}

jp: {1A}は青葉の笛をふいた{12}

pages.en: {001A} played the Aoba Flute.{0012}

jp: 亀の形をした山がある{12}

pages.en: There's a mountain shaped like a turtle.{0012}
Young Manjimaru! Is your heart colder than the ice of this Hakugin Castle...? To come storming into Hakugin Castle...{0012}
Surely you haven't forgotten that Kinu and Aya are both in my hands? Or will you leave your friends to die?{0012}
Well, do your best not to anger the lord of this castle, Hyakkanmaru. He's quick-tempered, and sadly...{0012}
...hopelessly fond of women! And both of them are beauties... I won't answer for what happens.{0012}

{0016}{0004}Murakami
Cave
Ah! You are the Heroes of Fire! We've been waiting for you! Welcome to our Senkaigu!{0012}
We always pray for lasting peace on the Seto Inland Sea! Do your best, Lord Manjimaru!{0012}
This Senkaigu has old ties to the Mermaid Village of Echizen. I hear our present queen, Lady Tsuruhime, comes from Echizen too.{0012}
You'll have much to talk over with Lord Gokuraku, I expect...{0012}
Lord Gokuraku! I understand how you feel, but don't forget the greater cause for a woman's sake, as you did a thousand years ago.{0012}
It's told that a thousand years ago, Lord Yoshitsune, one of the Heroes of Fire, forged one of the Holy Swords here at Senkaigu.{0012}
Sadly, the forge has crumbled with the passing years, and there's no way to rebuild it...{0012}
Omi Province was once home to the Fire Clan's capital, but one of the Root generals sank it beneath the water...{0012}
I've heard the Capital of Fire had two temples, Jakouin and Dairei-in, where two of the Holy Swords were forged.{0012}
If even one of those two temples could be used, you could surely forge a new Holy Sword.{0012}
I've heard there's a temple called the Iroha Shrine in the northwest of Kibi Province.{0012}
They say that at the Iroha Shrine too, like our Senkaigu, there were once people who helped the Fire Clan forge a Holy Sword.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! I entrust this land's future to you! May Lady Mari protect you!{0012}
By Kameyama Shrine to the north there's a large mountain. In truth, that mountain is a giant turtle called Benkei, transformed...{0012}
Benkei helped the Heroes of Fire in the war a thousand years ago, so the Root sealed him into a mountain.{0012}
Break Benkei's seal, and you can race freely across this Seto Inland Sea. Lord Manjimaru! Please bring Benkei back!{0012}
Even the ice barrier guarding Hakugin Castle can't be perfect against an approach from the sea. We pray for your success!{0012}
With your courage, you can surely beat even Yomi! Peace is just around the corner!{0012}
South of Kibi there's a village called Kurashiki. Kurashiki Village has long made its living renting out storehouses.{0012}
In one of those storehouses are kept some things our queen, Lady Tsuruhime, brought from Echizen.{0012}

jp:
倉敷村の倉は　私たち人魚以外に
鬼族の者たちも　使っているそうです{12}

pages.en: They say Kurashiki Village's storehouses are used by the oni as well as by us mermaids.{0012}
Come to think of it, all the gear Lord Gokuraku wore a thousand years ago was made by a mermaid named Chiyo, they say.{0012}
Above all, the sword called the Chiyo Sword was the finest blade ever made by anyone outside the Fire Clan, I hear.{0012}
If only we had the Aoba Flute, we could breathe life back into Benkei of Mt. Kameyama... but the flute is lost...{0012}
If the great turtle Benkei came back, he could be of help to you, Lord Manjimaru...{0012}
Rumor says the oni of Mt. Oe stole the Aoba Flute from the Root... But they also say Mt. Oe fell to the Root...{0012}
I've heard an eerie rumbling keeps coming from the mountains in northern Kibi Province. I hope nothing bad happens.{0012}
They say a man called Hyakkanmaru guards Hakugin Castle! Please, be very careful!{0012}
I pray from my heart that Lady Mari's protection is always upon you all.{0012}
I am called Tsuru! Welcome, welcome to Senkaigu! You are most welcome, honored Fire Clan!{0012}
Gokuraku Taro! It's been a long time! I've heard of your deeds, from Echizen till now!{0012}
It seems you've mended your ways. The you of today, I think, may have Chiyo's keepsakes back.{0012}
{000C}But it seems none of you can carry another item... Won't you clear out one thing?{0012}
{000C}Now, take this key! Go now and open the storehouse in Kurashiki Village in Kibi!{0012}

jp: {10}１３０{0C}鶴姫の{k}カギ{h}を　手に入れた｜

pages.en: {000C}Gokuraku! Show off that mighty strength of yours to the full, and don't shame the Chiyo Sword! Now, go!{0012}
Everyone is waiting for your deeds!{0012}
{000C}Gokuraku! Show off that mighty strength of yours to the full, and don't shame the Chiyo Sword! Now, go!{0012}
Everyone is waiting for your deeds!{0012}
First, I must thank you. My name is Benkei!{0012}
A thousand years ago, I lent my strength to you folk of the Fire and fought the Root... and then Yomi turned me to stone.{0012}
A thousand years was long, I'll grant you... but I don't regret one bit of it.{0012}
Once the Root Clan was gone from Jipang, the Seto Inland Sea I watched from here was so peaceful and beautiful.{0012}
So... I'll lend you my strength as many times as it takes! Even if I'm turned to stone again! I love this Seto Sea!{0012}
If there's anything you want of me, Benkei, just hop on my back, no need to be shy! I'll take you anywhere on this sea!{0012}
Kinu! You know who this woman is, don't you? Yes, your mother, Aya!{0012}
Surprised you a little, did I? I, Deron, kept her, thinking she'd come in handy one day.{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０これ以上{11}１０　わが根の一族の
邪魔だてを　すると　{11}５どうなるか…

pages.en: {0010}{0090}If you keep getting in the Root Clan's way, what will happen...?{0011}{00AB}
A clever girl like you understands, doesn't she?{0012}
Weighing your one and only mother in this world against Jipang... that's your freedom.{0012}

jp:
{10}１３０{11}２０　おまえたち　火の一族の
好きな言葉じゃろ？
{10}１３０{0C}自由｜
{10}１３０　いい言葉じゃ！

pages.en: {0010}{0090}Such a lovely word!{0011}{002D}
Damn it! At this rate, the fields I sweated blood over will be ruined! I could cry!{0012}
The lord of Hakugin Castle out at sea is a fat slob called Hyakkanmaru... and they say he's crazy for women like no one else...{0012}
Hyakkanmaru's bound to come storming in here soon... and do things to me... Just thinking about it makes me sick...{0012}
I'm thinking of fleeing over Nishiki Pass to Nagato in the west, but there's a Dark Orchid blooming over there, isn't there...{0012}
It's a tiger at the front gate and a wolf at the back... The future's pitch black...{0012}
I go to Kameyama Shrine every year without fail to pray for long life, but in this cold, I think my time's near...{0012}
How long will this go on? I'd like the shrine maiden at Kameyama Shrine to tell my fortune.{0012}
My house was frozen solid, so by the lord's kindness, I've been allowed to shelter in this castle...{0012}
When will the town be back to normal...? At this rate, I'll never get home again...{0012}
The ice from Hakugin Castle spreads further every day... Is Iwakuni Village to the south suffering too? I'm worried about my folks back home...{0012}

jp:
寒いよー｜　焚き火がしたいよー｜
このへんの物　燃やしていいかなぁ？

pages.en: I'm cold! I want a bonfire! Can I burn the stuff around here?
{000C}Better do something about Hakugin Castle before I run out of patience, if you don't want trouble!{0012}
The samurai the lord sent to scout Hakugin Castle say the ice around it is so slippery they couldn't get near.{0012}
Hiroshima's stores have run dry too, so we've asked the lord of Okayama for help.{0012}
I want to believe that by now some storehouses in Kurashiki Village in Kibi have been opened and the supplies packed...{0012}
The relief supplies from Okayama have only just arrived. It'd be rude to send them back, so we'll keep them!{0012}
The enemy general's name is Hyakkanmaru! Matchless in strength, and he wields ice sorcery too... We can't hope to win...{0012}

jp:
よくぞ白銀城を　討ってくださった！
このご恩は　一生　忘れませぬぞ！{12}

pages.en: You brought down Hakugin Castle! We'll never forget this as long as we live!{0012}
What are we to do?! It's only a matter of time before the whole town is buried in ice!{0012}
I saw two women being dragged into Hakugin Castle! They'll be sacrificed, I suppose...{0012}
Our lord has decided to build a shrine on the island where Hakugin Castle stood, for Lady Kinu's mother and father.{0012}
That's about all we can do in return for what you've done... Please don't think ill of us.{0012}
I sent a letter to Okayama in Kibi begging for help, but I hear an oni castle went up in Kibi recently...{0012}
I can't sleep at night, worrying whether my messenger reached Okayama safely...{0012}
They say only one Dark Orchid is left, but the Root Clan can never be taken lightly. Please be very careful!{0012}
The Dark Orchids you cut before, Sir Manjimaru, always seemed to spring up at shrines and temples...{0012}
But Nagato's Dark Orchid appeared deep inside a cave called Akiyoshi Cave.{0012}
Has the Root Clan changed tactics and picked a place that's easier to defend...? Don't let your guard down!{0012}
In any case, you're our only hope, Sir Manjimaru! Win this land lasting peace with your own arm!{0012}
On our lord's orders I tried again and again to sneak into Hakugin Castle, but the ice was in the way, and I never got in...{0012}
You can get right up close to Hakugin Castle easily, but... how do I put it... you just go sliiiiiding...{0012}
They say the shrine to be built on the little island offshore where Hakugin Castle stood has been named Itsukushima Shrine.{0012}
The Heroes of Fire...?! With our strength, we can't even get into Hakugin Castle! Please, lend us your strength!{0012}
Thank you so much for saving the people of Hiroshima, no, all of Aki Province!{0012}
To comfort the spirits of Lady Kinu's father and mother, we've decided to build a shrine on the site of Hakugin Castle.{0012}
That's all we're able to do. Please forgive us.{0012}
Lord Manjimaru... Our lord tried all sorts of things to bring down Hakugin Castle... but it seems he's at his wits' end...{0012}
At this rate, this town is sure to perish... Please, with the Heroes of Fire's power, defeat Hakugin Castle! I beg you!{0012}
Thank you so much! Thanks to you, Lord Manjimaru, the people of this land are saved!{0012}
Truly, I'd like you to stay in this castle forever, Lord Manjimaru, by my side...{0012}
Lord Manjimaru! Please take good care of Lady Kinu.{0012}
An eerie rumbling comes from beyond the mountains to the north. Could something be there?{0012}

The oni of that Ayaki Castle are the last of the Mt. Oe band from Omi Province...{0012}

They say an oni castle called Ayaki Castle went up before anyone knew it, on the peninsula at the southwest tip of this province...{0012}

Lord Manjimaru cut the Dark Orchid in Akiyoshi Cave, so the only worry left is the oni of Ayaki Castle.{0012}

I doubt prayers from the likes of me will work, but I've been asking the Buddha to make the Dark Orchid wither.{0012}

I'm sorry...{0012}

pages.en: May Lady Mari's light always be upon you...{0012}
Our ancestors learned how to forge blades and use fire from the Fire Clan, and made swords together with them, they say.{0012}
At the height of that craft, even Holy Swords could be made in this land. But now...{0012}
A thousand years of peace have robbed us of Kajin of our swordmaking skill. It's truly a shame.{0012}
We don't have the skill to make a new Holy Sword now... Sorry, after you came all this way...{0012}
......That's it! There IS someone who can make a Holy Sword! You still don't see who?!{0012}
You! Sir Manjimaru! The Fire blood runs thick in you! You can surely do it!{0012}
You've finally made the eighth Holy Sword your own! Now, hurry to Kyoto!{0012}
To make a Holy Sword, three conditions must be met.{0012}
First, a sacred place: the Iroha Shrine, Housuiin, Dairei-in... the seven temples where the Holy Swords were made!{0012}
If even one of them escaped destruction, that would do... The second condition is the hammer to forge the blade!{0012}
The last condition is a sword to be the Holy Sword's base! And it must be a sword made by the Fire Clan...{0012}
There are likely no such swords left, other than the seven Holy Swords...{0012}
The final battle at last! Everything rests on you, Sir Manjimaru! I pray for your fortune in battle!{0012}
The seven temples where the Holy Swords were made are probably all in ruins... If any temple can still be used...{0012}
...it can only be one of the two temples of the Capital of Fire, sunk in the lake of Omi Province: Jakouin, or Dairei-in...{0012}
With the Dragon Bead you took from Wise King Goten, you should be able to bring back the Capital of Fire! Hurry to Omi Province!{0012}

jp:
もはや　敵は　{k}ヨミ{h}のみ｜
この{k}ジパング{h}に　恒久の平和を｜{12}

pages.en: Now the only enemy left is Yomi! Bring lasting peace to Jipang!{0012}
So there really were eight Dark Orchids! The Dark Orchids were the eight-headed Orochi of Izumo legend!{0012}
Now it seems the only way is for Sir Manjimaru to forge a new Holy Sword with his own hands!{0012}
A Holy Sword is made by pouring in the soul of the one who forges it... With every blow, your life wears away.{0012}
But you must not be afraid! Just put your whole soul into forging the sword! One of the Fire Clan can do it!{0012}
That's the blood of the Fire Clan for you! You've forged a splendid Holy Sword!{0012}
Defeat Yomi, and surely Lady Mari will show herself! Bring peace to Jipang!{0012}
To make a Holy Sword, you must equip a special hammer called the Fire Hammer, and then forge the blade!{0012}
The Fire Hammer should be at the Iroha Shrine, north of this Kajin Village!{0012}
About the sword that becomes the Holy Sword's base...{0012}
Could it be that your father left a sword in your keeping?{0012}
Long ago, Holy Swords could be made at the Iroha Shrine north of this village too, but...{0012}
I heard the forge collapsed back when my grandfather was alive... It can't be repaired now...{0012}
The Capital of Fire awakened from its eternal sleep, and a Holy Sword forged once again...{0012}
You can surely defeat Yomi! I believe in you!{0012}
To make a new Holy Sword, you need a sword to be its base...{0012}
And not just any sword. It's no use unless it was forged by the hands of the Fire Clan...{0012}
You! Do you have one in mind? Its attack power can be low! Haven't you got some sword handed down in your family?{0012}
Sir Manjimaru! I believe you can defeat Yomi, even without Lady Mari's power!{0012}
East of this village there's a cave called Kokujo Cave. Go through it, and the Root Clan's mightiest warrior...{0012}
...Wise King Goten, lives in Hell Castle, I hear... Please, guard your lives well!{0012}
Do you have the Fire Hammer? Do you have a sword to be the Holy Sword's base? Do you have the Dragon Bead?{0012}
Once you have all three, hurry to Lake Biwa! The Capital of Fire awaits you, Sir Manjimaru!{0012}
Jipang's fate depends on what you do! We believe in you, Sir Manjimaru!{0012}
Have you heard the name Wise King Goten?{0012}
He's the Root Clan's mightiest warrior, the very one who buried Omi's Capital of Fire under the water in an instant a thousand years ago!{0012}
They say the Dragon Bead that Wise King Goten holds can command water at will.{0012}
Get that Dragon Bead, and you should be able to raise the Capital of Fire back into the sunlit world!{0012}
Visit the tower in the middle of Lake Biwa! From there, the spirits of fire will guide you.{0012}
My divination says Lady Mari is inside Yomi's belly...{0012}
I believe you can beat Yomi and rescue Lady Mari, Lord Manjimaru!{0012}
Oh, you are the Fire Clan! This is Kajin Village. Welcome!{0012}
We heard an eighth Dark Orchid has bloomed in Kyoto. There may be something we can do to help.{0012}
To cut the eighth Dark Orchid, a new Holy Sword must be made, somehow!{0012}
With the Holy Sword you made, Lord Manjimaru, we believe Yomi can be defeated!{0012}
{000C}Lord Yomi will soon be revived! When that happens, victory goes to us, the Root Clan!{0012}
{000C}Put the other way, to win, you must defeat us and cut this last Dark Orchid!{0012}
{000C}Come, Manjimaru! Defeat us if you can! But we will not simply lie down and lose!{0012}
{000C}For this day, we experimented again and again, using the Root Clan as material! The answer lies within our own bodies!{0012}
{000C}Behold! This is the utmost form human power can achieve! The ultimate life form!{0012}
Here you are, Manjimaru! Quick as ever! You always arrive faster than we expect!{0012}
{000C}We scattered seven Dark Orchids across the land to buy time, and you mocked all our labors!{0012}
{000C}Thanks to you, Lord Yomi's revival is a little behind schedule... But we hold a trump card!{0012}
{000C}With a little help from the people of Kyoto we've gathered in this hall, we'll make up the delay in one stroke!{0012}
{000C}Lord Yomi! Feast to your heart's content on the despair of human hearts! Now, let the festival of blood begin!{0012}

{000C}There's nothing to fear! The nightmare of a thousand years ago happened only because four Heroes of Fire were together...{0012}
{000C}Luckily, this Kabuki fellow's whereabouts are unknown! With only three of them, they could never tow an island!{0012}
